KEYWORD.NAME: PREFERRED_DGEMM_LIBRARY

ITEM.NAME: SPLA
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: SPLA library

ITEM.NAME: BLAS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: BLAS library

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the DGEMM library to be used. If not available, the BLAS routine is used. This keyword affects some DGEMM calls in the WFC code and turns on their acceleration with SpLA. This keyword affects only local DGEMM calls, not the calls to PDGEMM (see keyword FM%TYPE_OF_MATRIX_MULTIPLICATION).

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_CHECK_DIAG
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Check that the orthonormality of the eigenvectors after a diagonalization fulfills the specified numerical accuracy. A negative threshold value disables the check.

KEYWORD.NAME: ELPA_KERNEL

ITEM.NAME: AUTO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Automatically selected kernel

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the kernel to be used when ELPA is in use

KEYWORD.NAME: ELPA_NEIGVEC_MIN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Minimum number of eigenvectors for the use of the eigensolver from the ELPA library. The eigensolver from the ScaLAPACK library is used as fallback for all smaller cases

KEYWORD.NAME: ELPA_QR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: For ELPA, enable a blocked QR step when reducing the input matrix to banded form in preparation for the actual diagonalization step. See implementation paper for more details. Requires ELPA version 201505 or newer, automatically deactivated otherwise. If true, QR is activated only when the the size of the diagonalized matrix is suitable. Print key PRINT_ELPA is useful in determining which matrices are suitable for QR. Might accelerate the diagonalization of suitable matrices.

KEYWORD.NAME: ELPA_QR_UNSAFE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: For ELPA, disable block size limitations when used together with ELPA_QR. Keyword relevant only with ELPA versions 201605 or newer. Use keyword with caution, as it might result in wrong eigenvalues with some matrix orders/block sizes when the number of MPI processes is varied. If the print key PRINT_ELPA is active the validity of the eigenvalues is checked against values calculated without ELPA QR.

KEYWORD.NAME: DLAF_NEIGVEC_MIN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Minimum number of eigenvectors for the use of the eigensolver from the DLA-Future library. The eigensolver from the ScaLAPACK library is used as fallback for all smaller cases

KEYWORD.NAME: PREFERRED_FFT_LIBRARY

ITEM.NAME: FFTSG
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Stefan Goedecker's FFT (FFTSG), always available, will be used in case a FFT library is specified and not available.

ITEM.NAME: FFTW3
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: a fast portable FFT library. Recommended. See also the FFTW_PLAN_TYPE, and FFTW_WISDOM_FILE_NAME keywords.

ITEM.NAME: FFTW
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Same as FFTW3 (for compatibility with CP2K 2.3)

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the FFT library which should be preferred. If it is not available, use FFTW3 if this is linked in, if FFTW3 is not available use FFTSG. Improved performance with FFTW3 can be obtained specifying a proper value for FFTW_PLAN_TYPE. Contrary to earlier CP2K versions, all libraries will result in the same grids, i.e. the subset of grids which all FFT libraries can transform. See EXTENDED_FFT_LENGTHS if larger FFTs or grids that more precisely match a given cutoff are needed, or older results need to be reproduced. FFTW3 is often (close to) optimal, and well tested with CP2K.

KEYWORD.NAME: FFTW_WISDOM_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The name of the file that contains wisdom (pre-planned FFTs) for use with FFTW3. Using wisdom can significantly speed up the FFTs (see the FFTW homepage for details). Note that wisdom is not transferable between different computer (architectures). Wisdom can be generated using the fftw-wisdom tool that is part of the fftw installation. cp2k/tools/cp2k-wisdom is a script that contains some additional info, and can help to generate a useful default for /etc/fftw/wisdom or particular values for a given simulation.

KEYWORD.NAME: FFTW_PLAN_TYPE

ITEM.NAME: ESTIMATE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Quick estimate, no runtime measurements.

ITEM.NAME: MEASURE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Quick measurement, somewhat faster FFTs.

ITEM.NAME: PATIENT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Measurements trying a wider range of possibilities.

ITEM.NAME: EXHAUSTIVE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Measurements trying all possibilities - use with caution.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: FFTW can have improved performance if it is allowed to plan with explicit measurements which strategy is best for a given FFT. While a plan based on measurements is generally faster, differences in machine load will lead to different plans for the same input file, and thus numerics for the FFTs will be slightly different from run to run. PATIENT planning is recommended for long ab initio MD runs.

KEYWORD.NAME: EXTENDED_FFT_LENGTHS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use fft library specific values for the allows number of points in FFTs. The default is to use the internal FFT lengths. For external fft libraries this may create an error at the external library level, because the length provided by cp2k is not supported by the external library. In this case switch on this keyword to obtain, with certain fft libraries, lengths matching the external fft library lengths, or larger allowed grids, or grids that more precisely match a given cutoff. IMPORTANT NOTE: in this case, the actual grids used in CP2K depends on the FFT library. A change of FFT library must therefore be considered equivalent to a change of basis, which implies a change of total energy.

KEYWORD.NAME: FFT_POOL_SCRATCH_LIMIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Limits the memory usage of the FFT scratch pool, potentially reducing efficiency a bit

KEYWORD.NAME: ALLTOALL_SGL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: All-to-all communication (FFT) should use single precision

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: No callgraph gets written

ITEM.NAME: MASTER
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Only the master process writes his callgraph

ITEM.NAME: ALL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: All processes write their callgraph (into a separate files).

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: At the end of the run write a callgraph to file, which contains detailed timing informations. This callgraph can be viewed e.g. with the open-source program kcachegrind.

KEYWORD.NAME: CALLGRAPH_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the callgraph file, which is written at the end of the run. If not specified the project name will be used as filename.

KEYWORD.NAME: SEED
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial seed for the global (pseudo)random number generator to create a stream of normally Gaussian distributed random numbers. Exactly 1 or 6 positive integer values are expected. A single value is replicated to fill up the full seed array with 6 numbers.

KEYWORD.NAME: SAVE_MEM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Some sections of the input structure are deallocated when not needed, and reallocated only when used. This reduces the required maximum memory

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Alias for ScaLAPACK

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Allows to switch between scalapack pxgemm and COSMA pxgemm. COSMA reduces the communication costs but increases the memory demands. The performance of Scalapack's pxgemm on GPU's depends crucially on the BLOCK_SIZES. Make sure optimized kernels are available.

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Configuration options for the DBCSR library.

KEYWORD.NAME: MM_STACK_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Size of multiplication parameter stack. A negative value leaves the decision up to DBCSR.

KEYWORD.NAME: MM_DRIVER

ITEM.NAME: AUTO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Choose automatically the best available driver

ITEM.NAME: BLAS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: BLAS (requires the BLAS library at link time)

ITEM.NAME: MATMUL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Fortran MATMUL

ITEM.NAME: SMM
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Library optimised for Small Matrix Multiplies (requires the SMM library at link time)

ITEM.NAME: XSMM
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: LIBXSMM

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Select which backend to use preferably for matrix block multiplications on the host.

KEYWORD.NAME: AVG_ELEMENTS_IMAGES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Average number of elements (dense limit) for each image, which also corresponds to the average number of elements exchanged between MPI processes during the operations. A negative or zero value means unlimited.

KEYWORD.NAME: NUM_MULT_IMAGES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Multiplicative factor for number of virtual images.

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_MPI_ALLOCATOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use MPI allocator to allocate buffers used in MPI communications.

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_MPI_RMA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use RMA for MPI communications for each image, which also corresponds to the number of elements exchanged between MPI processes during the operations.

KEYWORD.NAME: NUM_LAYERS_3D
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of layers for the 3D multplication algorithm.

KEYWORD.NAME: N_SIZE_MNK_STACKS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of stacks to use for distinct atomic sizes (e.g., 2 for a system of mostly waters).

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_COMM_THREAD
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: During multiplication, use a thread to periodically poll MPI to progress outstanding message completions. This is beneficial on systems without a DMA-capable network adapter e.g. Cray XE6.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOCK
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Default block size for turning dense matrices in blocked ones

KEYWORD.NAME: COMM_THREAD_LOAD
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If a communications thread is used, specify how much multiplication workload (%) the thread should perform in addition to communication tasks. A negative value leaves the decision up to DBCSR.

KEYWORD.NAME: MULTREC_LIMIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Recursion limit of cache oblivious multrec algorithm.

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_MEMPOOLS_CPU
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Enable memory pools on the CPU.

KEYWORD.NAME: TAS_SPLIT_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Parameter for hybrid DBCSR-TAS matrix-matrix multiplication algorithm: a TAS matrix is split into s submatrices with s = N_max/(N_min*f) with f given by this parameter and N_max/N_min the max/min occupancies of the matrices involved in a multiplication. A large value makes the multiplication Cannon-based (s=1) and a small value (> 0) makes the multiplication based on TAS algorithm (s=number of MPI ranks)

KEYWORD.NAME: THREAD_BUFFERS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of transfer-buffers associated with each thread and corresponding stream.

KEYWORD.NAME: AVOID_AFTER_BUSY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If enabled, stacks are not processed by the acc-driver after it has signaled congestion during a round of flushing. For the next round of flusing the driver is used again.

KEYWORD.NAME: MIN_FLOP_PROCESS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Only process stacks with more than the given number of floating-point operations per stack-entry (2*m*n*k).

KEYWORD.NAME: STACK_SORT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sort multiplication stacks according to C-access.

KEYWORD.NAME: MIN_FLOP_SORT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Only sort stacks with more than the given number of floating-point operations per stack-entry (2*m*n*k). Alternatively, the stacks are roughly ordered through a binning-scheme by Peter Messmer. (Depends on ACC%STACK_SORT)

KEYWORD.NAME: PROCESS_INHOMOGENOUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If enabled, inhomogenous stacks are also processed by the acc driver.

KEYWORD.NAME: BINNING_NBINS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of bins used when ordering the stacks with the binning-scheme.

KEYWORD.NAME: BINNING_BINSIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Size of bins used when ordering the stacks with the binning-scheme.

SECTION.NAME: FM_DIAG_SETTINGS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section defines a set of heuristic rules which are used to calculate the optimal number of CPUs, M, needed to diagonalize a full matrix distributed on N processors (FM type). If M &lt N, the matrix is redistributed onto M processors before it is diagonalized. The optimal value is calculate according to M = ((K+a*x-1)/(a*x))*a, where K is the size of the matrix, and {a, x} are integers defined below. The default values have been selected based on timings on a Cray XE6. Supports diagonalization libraries SL and ELPA (see keyword ELPA_FORCE_REDISTRIBUTE).

KEYWORD.NAME: PARAMETER_A
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Parameter used for defining the rule which determines the optimal number of CPUs needed to diagonalize a full distributed matrix. The optimal number of CPUs will be an integer multiple of this variable.

KEYWORD.NAME: PARAMETER_X
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Parameter used for defining the rule which determines the optimal number of CPUs needed to diagonalize a full distributed matrix. The optimal number of CPUs will be roughly proportional to this value.

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_FM_REDISTRIBUTE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Controls printing of information related to this section. For each diagonalized matrix, prints the size of the matrix, the optimal number of CPUs, as well as notifies if the matrix was redistributed. Useful for testing.

KEYWORD.NAME: ELPA_FORCE_REDISTRIBUTE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Controls how to perform redistribution when ELPA is used for diagonalization. By default, redistribution is always performed using the defined rules. By turning off this keyword, matrices are redistributed only to prevent crashes in the ELPA library which happens when the original matrix is distributed over too many processors.

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Configuration options for the grid library, which performs e.g. the collocate and integrate of the GPW method.

KEYWORD.NAME: BACKEND

ITEM.NAME: AUTO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Let the grid library pick the backend automatically

ITEM.NAME: REFERENCE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Reference backend implementation

ITEM.NAME: CPU
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Optimized CPU backend

ITEM.NAME: DGEMM
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Alternative CPU backend based on DGEMM

ITEM.NAME: GPU
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: GPU backend optimized for CUDA that also supports HIP

ITEM.NAME: HIP
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: HIP backend optimized for ROCm

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Selects the backed used by the grid library.

KEYWORD.NAME: VALIDATE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: When enabled the reference backend is run in shadow mode and its results are compared with those from the selected backend. If the two results differ by too much then the calculation is aborted.

KEYWORD.NAME: APPLY_CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: When enabled the cpu backend apply a spherical cutoff on the top of the cube. There is a performance penalty using it in combination with the cpu backend but it is on by default for the regtests

SECTION.NAME: TEST
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Tests to perform on the supported libraries.

KEYWORD.NAME: MEMORY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Set the maximum amount of memory allocated for a given test (in bytes)

KEYWORD.NAME: COPY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tests the performance to copy two vectors. The results of these tests allow to determine the size of the cache of the CPU. This can be used to optimize the performance of the FFTSG library. Tests are repeated the given number of times.

KEYWORD.NAME: MATMUL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tests the performance of different kinds of matrix matrix multiply kernels for the F95 INTRINSIC matmul. Matrices up to 2**N+1 will be tested.

KEYWORD.NAME: DGEMM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tests the performance of different kinds of matrix matrix multiply kernels for the BLAS INTRINSIC DGEMM. Matrices up to 2**N+1 will be tested.

KEYWORD.NAME: FFT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tests the performance of all available FFT libraries for 3D FFTs Tests are repeated the given number of times.

KEYWORD.NAME: ERI
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tests the performance and correctness of ERI libraries

KEYWORD.NAME: CLEBSCH_GORDON
CLEBSCH
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tests the Clebsch-Gordon Coefficients. Tests are repeated the given number of times.

KEYWORD.NAME: MPI
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tests mpi, quickly adapted benchmark code, will ONLY work on an even number of CPUs. comm is the relevant, initialized communicator. This test will produce messages of the size 8*10**requested_size, where requested_size is the value given to this keyword

KEYWORD.NAME: MINIMAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tests validity of minimax coefficients for approximating 1/x as a sum of exponentials. Checks numerical error against tabulated error, testing the given number of different Rc values.

KEYWORD.NAME: LEAST_SQ_FT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tests accuracy of the integration weights gamma_ik from Kaltak, Klimes, Kresse, JCTC 10, 2498 (2014), Eq. 30. Printed is the L1-error (=minimax error for a given range and a given number of grid points. The input parameter is the given number of different Rc values.

SECTION.NAME: RS_GRID
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Set options that influence how the realspace grids are being distributed in parallel runs.

ITEM.NAME: AUTOMATIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use heuristic rules to decide between distributed and replicated

ITEM.NAME: DISTRIBUTED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Force a distributed setup if possible

ITEM.NAME: REPLICATED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Force a replicated setup

KEYWORD.NAME: DISTRIBUTION_LAYOUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the number of slices in the x, y and z directions. -1 specifies that any number of slices is OK. If a given distribution can not be satisfied, a replicated grid will result. Also see LOCK_DISTRIBUTION.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_DISTRIBUTED_LEVEL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the multigrid-level of a grid is larger than the parameter, it will not be distributed in the automatic scheme.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOCK_DISTRIBUTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Expert use only, only basic QS deals correctly with a non-default value. If the distribution is locked, a grid will have the same distribution as the next finer multigrid (provided it is distributed). If unlocked, all grids can be distributed freely.

KEYWORD.NAME: MEMORY_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: A grid will only be distributed if the memory usage for that grid (including halo) is smaller than a replicated grid by this parameter.

KEYWORD.NAME: HALO_REDUCTION_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Can be used to reduce the halo of the distributed grid (experimental features).

SECTION.NAME: ERI_MME
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for the calculation of periodic electron repulsion integrals (ERI) using the Minimax-Ewald (MME) method. Note: N_MINIMAX is the only parameter to be tuned for accuracy, all other parameters can be left to default. MME method is faster than numerical GPW.

KEYWORD.NAME: N_MINIMAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of terms in minimax approximation of reciprocal space potential.

KEYWORD.NAME: CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: User-defined energy cutoff to be used only if DO_CALIBRATE_CUTOFF is set to .FALSE.

KEYWORD.NAME: SUM_PRECISION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Terms in lattice sums are ignored if absolute value smaller than this value.

KEYWORD.NAME: DO_CALIBRATE_CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether the energy cutoff shall be calibrated to minimize upper bound error estimate.

KEYWORD.NAME: DO_ERROR_ESTIMATE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether the error due to minimax approx. and cutoff shall be estimated

KEYWORD.NAME: DEBUG
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: debug mode (consistency of summation methods is checked).

KEYWORD.NAME: DEBUG_TOLERANCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: tolerance for rel. numerical error in debug mode.

KEYWORD.NAME: DEBUG_NSUM_MAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: restrict debug mode for non-ortho cells to this number of summands. Sums with more terms are not checked.

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION:
CP2K Basis Set Standard Format:
``` Element symbol Name of the basis set Alias names nset (repeat the following block of lines nset times) n lmin lmax nexp nshell(lmin) nshell(lmin+1) ... nshell(lmax-1) nshell(lmax) a(1) c(1,l,1) c(1,l,2) ... c(1,l,nshell(l)-1) c(1,l,nshell(l)), l=lmin,lmax a(2) c(2,l,1) c(2,l,2) ... c(2,l,nshell(l)-1) c(2,l,nshell(l)), l=lmin,lmax . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . a(nexp-1) c(nexp-1,l,1) c(nexp-1,l,2) ... c(nexp-1,l,nshell(l)-1) c(nexp-1,l,nshell(l)), l=lmin,lmax a(nexp) c(nexp,l,1) c(nexp,l,2) ... c(nexp,l,nshell(l)-1) c(nexp,l,nshell(l)), l=lmin,lmax
nset : Number of exponent sets n : Principle quantum number (only for orbital label printing) lmax : Maximum angular momentum quantum number l lmin : Minimum angular momentum quantum number l nshell(l): Number of shells for angular momentum quantum number l a : Exponent c : Contraction coefficient ```

SECTION.NAME: MOTION
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section defines a set of tool connected with the motion of the nuclei.

SECTION.NAME: GEO_OPT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section sets the environment of the geometry optimizer.

KEYWORD.NAME: TYPE

ITEM.NAME: MINIMIZATION
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Performs a geometry minimization.

ITEM.NAME: TRANSITION_STATE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Performs a transition state optimization.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify which kind of geometry optimization to perform

KEYWORD.NAME: OPTIMIZER
MINIMIZER

ITEM.NAME: BFGS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Most efficient minimizer, but only for 'small' systems, as it relies on diagonalization of a full Hessian matrix

ITEM.NAME: LBFGS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Limited-memory variant of BFGS suitable for large systems. Not as well fine-tuned but can be more robust.

ITEM.NAME: CG
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: conjugate gradients, robust minimizer (depending on the line search) also OK for large systems

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify which method to use to perform a geometry optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the maximum number of geometry optimization steps. One step might imply several force evaluations for the CG and LBFGS optimizers.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_DR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the maximum geometry change between the current and the last optimizer iteration.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_FORCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the maximum force component of the current configuration.

KEYWORD.NAME: RMS_DR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the root mean square (RMS) geometry change between the current and the last optimizer iteration.

KEYWORD.NAME: RMS_FORCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the root mean square (RMS) force of the current configuration.

KEYWORD.NAME: STEP_START_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The starting step value for the GEO_OPT module.

KEYWORD.NAME: KEEP_SPACE_GROUP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Detect space group of the system and preserve it during optimization. The space group symmetry is applied to coordinates, forces, and the stress tensor. It works for supercell. It does not affect/reduce computational cost. Use EPS_SYMMETRY to adjust the detection threshold.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_SYMMETRY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Accuracy for space group determination. EPS_SYMMETRY is dimensionless. Roughly speaking, two scaled (fractional) atomic positions v1, v2 are considered identical if |v1 - v2| < EPS_SYMMETRY.

KEYWORD.NAME: SYMM_REDUCTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Direction of the external static electric field. Some symmetry operations are not compatible with the direction of an electric field. These operations are used when enforcing the space group.

KEYWORD.NAME: SYMM_EXCLUDE_RANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Range of atoms to exclude from space group symmetry. These atoms are excluded from both identification and enforcement. This keyword can be repeated.

KEYWORD.NAME: SPGR_PRINT_ATOMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Print equivalent atoms list for each space group symmetry operation.

SECTION.NAME: LBFGS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the limited memory BFGS (LBFGS) optimization

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_H_RANK
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum rank (and consequently size) of the approximate Hessian matrix used by the LBFGS optimizer. Larger values (e.g. 30) will accelerate the convergence behaviour at the cost of a larger memory consumption.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_F_PER_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of force evaluations per iteration (used for the line search)

KEYWORD.NAME: WANTED_PROJ_GRADIENT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion (overrides the general ones): Requested norm threshold of the gradient multiplied by the approximate Hessian.

KEYWORD.NAME: WANTED_REL_F_ERROR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion (overrides the general ones): Requested relative error on the objective function of the optimizer (the energy)

KEYWORD.NAME: TRUST_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Trust radius used in LBFGS. Not completely in depth tested. Negativ values means no trust radius is used.

SECTION.NAME: CG
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the conjugate gradient optimization

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_STEEP_STEPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of steepest descent steps before starting the conjugate gradients optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_LIMIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Cosine of the angle between two consecutive searching directions. If the angle during a CG optimization is less than the one corresponding to to the RESTART_LIMIT the CG is reset and one step of steepest descent is performed.

KEYWORD.NAME: FLETCHER_REEVES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Uses FLETCHER-REEVES instead of POLAK-RIBIERE when using Conjugate Gradients

SECTION.NAME: LINE_SEARCH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the line search during the conjugate gradient optimization

KEYWORD.NAME: TYPE

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: take fixed length steps

ITEM.NAME: 2PNT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: extrapolate based on 2 points

ITEM.NAME: 3PNT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: extrapolate based on on 3 points

ITEM.NAME: GOLD
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: perform 1D golden section search of the minimum (very expensive)

ITEM.NAME: FIT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: perform 1D fit of a parabola on several evaluation of energy (very expensive and more robust vs numerical noise)

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: 1D line search algorithm to be used with the CG optimizer, in increasing order of robustness and cost.

SECTION.NAME: 2PNT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the line search for the two point based line search.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ALLOWED_STEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Max allowed value for the line search step.

KEYWORD.NAME: LINMIN_GRAD_ONLY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use only the gradient, not the energy for line minimizations (e.g. in conjugate gradients).

SECTION.NAME: GOLD
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the line search for the gold search.

KEYWORD.NAME: INITIAL_STEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial step size used, e.g. for bracketing or minimizers. Might need to be reduced for systems with close contacts

KEYWORD.NAME: BRACK_LIMIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Limit in 1D bracketing during line search in Conjugate Gradients Optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: BRENT_TOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tolerance requested during Brent line search in Conjugate Gradients Optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: BRENT_MAX_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of iterations in brent algorithm (used for the line search in Conjugated Gradients Optimization)

SECTION.NAME: BFGS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the BFGS optimization

KEYWORD.NAME: TRUST_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Trust radius used in BFGS. Previously set to 0.1. Large values can lead to instabilities

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_MODEL_HESSIAN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Uses a model Hessian as initial guess instead of a unit matrix. Should lead in general to improved convergence might be switched off for exotic cases

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_RAT_FUN_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Includes a rational function optimization to determine the step. Previously default but did not improve convergence in many cases

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_HESSIAN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Controls the reading of the initial Hessian from file.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the name of the file used to read the initial Hessian.

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Most efficient minimizer, but only for 'small' systems, as it relies on diagonalization of a full Hessian matrix

ITEM.NAME: LBFGS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Limited-memory variant of BFGS suitable for large systems. Not as well fine-tuned but can be more robust.

ITEM.NAME: CG
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: conjugate gradients, robust minimizer (depending on the line search) also OK for large systems

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify which method to use to perform a geometry optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the maximum number of geometry optimization steps. One step might imply several force evaluations for the CG and LBFGS optimizers.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_DR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the maximum geometry change between the current and the last optimizer iteration.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_FORCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the maximum force component of the current configuration.

KEYWORD.NAME: RMS_DR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the root mean square (RMS) geometry change between the current and the last optimizer iteration.

KEYWORD.NAME: RMS_FORCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the root mean square (RMS) force of the current configuration.

KEYWORD.NAME: STEP_START_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The starting step value for the ROT_OPT module.

KEYWORD.NAME: KEEP_SPACE_GROUP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Detect space group of the system and preserve it during optimization. The space group symmetry is applied to coordinates, forces, and the stress tensor. It works for supercell. It does not affect/reduce computational cost. Use EPS_SYMMETRY to adjust the detection threshold.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_SYMMETRY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Accuracy for space group determination. EPS_SYMMETRY is dimensionless. Roughly speaking, two scaled (fractional) atomic positions v1, v2 are considered identical if |v1 - v2| < EPS_SYMMETRY.

KEYWORD.NAME: SYMM_REDUCTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Direction of the external static electric field. Some symmetry operations are not compatible with the direction of an electric field. These operations are used when enforcing the space group.

KEYWORD.NAME: SYMM_EXCLUDE_RANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Range of atoms to exclude from space group symmetry. These atoms are excluded from both identification and enforcement. This keyword can be repeated.

KEYWORD.NAME: SPGR_PRINT_ATOMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Print equivalent atoms list for each space group symmetry operation.

SECTION.NAME: LBFGS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the limited memory BFGS (LBFGS) optimization

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_H_RANK
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum rank (and consequently size) of the approximate Hessian matrix used by the LBFGS optimizer. Larger values (e.g. 30) will accelerate the convergence behaviour at the cost of a larger memory consumption.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_F_PER_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of force evaluations per iteration (used for the line search)

KEYWORD.NAME: WANTED_PROJ_GRADIENT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion (overrides the general ones): Requested norm threshold of the gradient multiplied by the approximate Hessian.

KEYWORD.NAME: WANTED_REL_F_ERROR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion (overrides the general ones): Requested relative error on the objective function of the optimizer (the energy)

KEYWORD.NAME: TRUST_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Trust radius used in LBFGS. Not completely in depth tested. Negativ values means no trust radius is used.

SECTION.NAME: CG
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the conjugate gradient optimization

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_STEEP_STEPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of steepest descent steps before starting the conjugate gradients optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_LIMIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Cosine of the angle between two consecutive searching directions. If the angle during a CG optimization is less than the one corresponding to to the RESTART_LIMIT the CG is reset and one step of steepest descent is performed.

KEYWORD.NAME: FLETCHER_REEVES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Uses FLETCHER-REEVES instead of POLAK-RIBIERE when using Conjugate Gradients

SECTION.NAME: LINE_SEARCH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the line search during the conjugate gradient optimization

KEYWORD.NAME: TYPE

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: take fixed length steps

ITEM.NAME: 2PNT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: extrapolate based on 2 points

ITEM.NAME: 3PNT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: extrapolate based on on 3 points

ITEM.NAME: GOLD
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: perform 1D golden section search of the minimum (very expensive)

ITEM.NAME: FIT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: perform 1D fit of a parabola on several evaluation of energy (very expensive and more robust vs numerical noise)

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: 1D line search algorithm to be used with the CG optimizer, in increasing order of robustness and cost.

SECTION.NAME: 2PNT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the line search for the two point based line search.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ALLOWED_STEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Max allowed value for the line search step.

KEYWORD.NAME: LINMIN_GRAD_ONLY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use only the gradient, not the energy for line minimizations (e.g. in conjugate gradients).

SECTION.NAME: GOLD
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the line search for the gold search.

KEYWORD.NAME: INITIAL_STEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial step size used, e.g. for bracketing or minimizers. Might need to be reduced for systems with close contacts

KEYWORD.NAME: BRACK_LIMIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Limit in 1D bracketing during line search in Conjugate Gradients Optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: BRENT_TOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tolerance requested during Brent line search in Conjugate Gradients Optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: BRENT_MAX_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of iterations in brent algorithm (used for the line search in Conjugated Gradients Optimization)

SECTION.NAME: BFGS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the BFGS optimization

KEYWORD.NAME: TRUST_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Trust radius used in BFGS. Previously set to 0.1. Large values can lead to instabilities

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_MODEL_HESSIAN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Uses a model Hessian as initial guess instead of a unit matrix. Should lead in general to improved convergence might be switched off for exotic cases

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_RAT_FUN_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Includes a rational function optimization to determine the step. Previously default but did not improve convergence in many cases

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_HESSIAN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Controls the reading of the initial Hessian from file.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the name of the file used to read the initial Hessian.

SECTION.NAME: RESTART
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of Hessian Restart file

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: CELL_OPT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section sets the environment for the optimization of the simulation cell. Two possible schemes are available: (1) Zero temperature optimization; (2) Finite temperature optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: OPTIMIZER
MINIMIZER

ITEM.NAME: BFGS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Most efficient minimizer, but only for 'small' systems, as it relies on diagonalization of a full Hessian matrix

ITEM.NAME: LBFGS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Limited-memory variant of BFGS suitable for large systems. Not as well fine-tuned but can be more robust.

ITEM.NAME: CG
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: conjugate gradients, robust minimizer (depending on the line search) also OK for large systems

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify which method to use to perform a geometry optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the maximum number of geometry optimization steps. One step might imply several force evaluations for the CG and LBFGS optimizers.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_DR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the maximum geometry change between the current and the last optimizer iteration.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_FORCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the maximum force component of the current configuration.

KEYWORD.NAME: RMS_DR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the root mean square (RMS) geometry change between the current and the last optimizer iteration.

KEYWORD.NAME: RMS_FORCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the root mean square (RMS) force of the current configuration.

KEYWORD.NAME: STEP_START_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The starting step value for the CELL_OPT module.

KEYWORD.NAME: KEEP_SPACE_GROUP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Detect space group of the system and preserve it during optimization. The space group symmetry is applied to coordinates, forces, and the stress tensor. It works for supercell. It does not affect/reduce computational cost. Use EPS_SYMMETRY to adjust the detection threshold.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_SYMMETRY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Accuracy for space group determination. EPS_SYMMETRY is dimensionless. Roughly speaking, two scaled (fractional) atomic positions v1, v2 are considered identical if |v1 - v2| < EPS_SYMMETRY.

KEYWORD.NAME: SYMM_REDUCTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Direction of the external static electric field. Some symmetry operations are not compatible with the direction of an electric field. These operations are used when enforcing the space group.

KEYWORD.NAME: SYMM_EXCLUDE_RANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Range of atoms to exclude from space group symmetry. These atoms are excluded from both identification and enforcement. This keyword can be repeated.

KEYWORD.NAME: SPGR_PRINT_ATOMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Print equivalent atoms list for each space group symmetry operation.

KEYWORD.NAME: TYPE

ITEM.NAME: GEO_OPT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Performs a geometry optimization (the GEO_OPT section must be defined) between cell optimization steps. The stress tensor is computed at the optimized geometry.

ITEM.NAME: MD
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Performs a molecular dynamics run (the MD section needs must defined) for computing the stress tensor used for the cell optimization.

ITEM.NAME: DIRECT_CELL_OPT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Performs a geometry and cell optimization at the same time. The stress tensor is computed at every step

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify which kind of method to use for the optimization of the simulation cell

KEYWORD.NAME: EXTERNAL_PRESSURE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the external pressure (1 value or the full 9 components of the pressure tensor) applied during the cell optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: KEEP_ANGLES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Keep angles between the cell vectors constant, but allow the lenghts of the cell vectors to change independently. Albeit general, this is most useful for triclinic cells, to enforce higher symmetry, see KEEP_SYMMETRY.

KEYWORD.NAME: KEEP_SYMMETRY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Keep the requested initial cell symmetry (e.g. during a cell optimisation). The initial symmetry must be specified in the &CELL section.

KEYWORD.NAME: CONSTRAINT

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Fix nothing

ITEM.NAME: X
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Fix only x component

ITEM.NAME: Y
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Fix only y component

ITEM.NAME: Z
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Fix only z component

ITEM.NAME: XY
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Fix x and y component

ITEM.NAME: XZ
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Fix x and z component

ITEM.NAME: YZ
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Fix y and z component

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Imposes a constraint on the pressure tensor by fixing the specified cell components.

KEYWORD.NAME: PRESSURE_TOLERANCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the Pressure tolerance (compared to the external pressure) to achieve during the cell optimization.

SECTION.NAME: LBFGS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the limited memory BFGS (LBFGS) optimization

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_H_RANK
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum rank (and consequently size) of the approximate Hessian matrix used by the LBFGS optimizer. Larger values (e.g. 30) will accelerate the convergence behaviour at the cost of a larger memory consumption.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_F_PER_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of force evaluations per iteration (used for the line search)

KEYWORD.NAME: WANTED_PROJ_GRADIENT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion (overrides the general ones): Requested norm threshold of the gradient multiplied by the approximate Hessian.

KEYWORD.NAME: WANTED_REL_F_ERROR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion (overrides the general ones): Requested relative error on the objective function of the optimizer (the energy)

KEYWORD.NAME: TRUST_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Trust radius used in LBFGS. Not completely in depth tested. Negativ values means no trust radius is used.

SECTION.NAME: CG
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the conjugate gradient optimization

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_STEEP_STEPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of steepest descent steps before starting the conjugate gradients optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_LIMIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Cosine of the angle between two consecutive searching directions. If the angle during a CG optimization is less than the one corresponding to to the RESTART_LIMIT the CG is reset and one step of steepest descent is performed.

KEYWORD.NAME: FLETCHER_REEVES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Uses FLETCHER-REEVES instead of POLAK-RIBIERE when using Conjugate Gradients

SECTION.NAME: LINE_SEARCH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the line search during the conjugate gradient optimization

KEYWORD.NAME: TYPE

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: take fixed length steps

ITEM.NAME: 2PNT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: extrapolate based on 2 points

ITEM.NAME: 3PNT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: extrapolate based on on 3 points

ITEM.NAME: GOLD
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: perform 1D golden section search of the minimum (very expensive)

ITEM.NAME: FIT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: perform 1D fit of a parabola on several evaluation of energy (very expensive and more robust vs numerical noise)

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: 1D line search algorithm to be used with the CG optimizer, in increasing order of robustness and cost.

SECTION.NAME: 2PNT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the line search for the two point based line search.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ALLOWED_STEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Max allowed value for the line search step.

KEYWORD.NAME: LINMIN_GRAD_ONLY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use only the gradient, not the energy for line minimizations (e.g. in conjugate gradients).

SECTION.NAME: GOLD
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the line search for the gold search.

KEYWORD.NAME: INITIAL_STEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial step size used, e.g. for bracketing or minimizers. Might need to be reduced for systems with close contacts

KEYWORD.NAME: BRACK_LIMIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Limit in 1D bracketing during line search in Conjugate Gradients Optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: BRENT_TOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tolerance requested during Brent line search in Conjugate Gradients Optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: BRENT_MAX_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of iterations in brent algorithm (used for the line search in Conjugated Gradients Optimization)

SECTION.NAME: BFGS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the BFGS optimization

KEYWORD.NAME: TRUST_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Trust radius used in BFGS. Previously set to 0.1. Large values can lead to instabilities

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_MODEL_HESSIAN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Uses a model Hessian as initial guess instead of a unit matrix. Should lead in general to improved convergence might be switched off for exotic cases

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_RAT_FUN_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Includes a rational function optimization to determine the step. Previously default but did not improve convergence in many cases

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_HESSIAN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Controls the reading of the initial Hessian from file.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the name of the file used to read the initial Hessian.

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of Hessian Restart file

SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: SHELL_OPT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section sets the environment for the optimization of the shell-core distances that might turn to be necessary along a MD run using a shell-model potential. The optimization procedure is activated when at least one of the shell-core pairs becomes too elongated, i.e. when the assumption of point dipole is not longer valid.

KEYWORD.NAME: OPTIMIZER
MINIMIZER

ITEM.NAME: BFGS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Most efficient minimizer, but only for 'small' systems, as it relies on diagonalization of a full Hessian matrix

ITEM.NAME: LBFGS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Limited-memory variant of BFGS suitable for large systems. Not as well fine-tuned but can be more robust.

ITEM.NAME: CG
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: conjugate gradients, robust minimizer (depending on the line search) also OK for large systems

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify which method to use to perform a geometry optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the maximum number of geometry optimization steps. One step might imply several force evaluations for the CG and LBFGS optimizers.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_DR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the maximum geometry change between the current and the last optimizer iteration.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_FORCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the maximum force component of the current configuration.

KEYWORD.NAME: RMS_DR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the root mean square (RMS) geometry change between the current and the last optimizer iteration.

KEYWORD.NAME: RMS_FORCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the root mean square (RMS) force of the current configuration.

KEYWORD.NAME: STEP_START_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The starting step value for the SHELL_OPT module.

KEYWORD.NAME: KEEP_SPACE_GROUP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Detect space group of the system and preserve it during optimization. The space group symmetry is applied to coordinates, forces, and the stress tensor. It works for supercell. It does not affect/reduce computational cost. Use EPS_SYMMETRY to adjust the detection threshold.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_SYMMETRY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Accuracy for space group determination. EPS_SYMMETRY is dimensionless. Roughly speaking, two scaled (fractional) atomic positions v1, v2 are considered identical if |v1 - v2| < EPS_SYMMETRY.

KEYWORD.NAME: SYMM_REDUCTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Direction of the external static electric field. Some symmetry operations are not compatible with the direction of an electric field. These operations are used when enforcing the space group.

KEYWORD.NAME: SYMM_EXCLUDE_RANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Range of atoms to exclude from space group symmetry. These atoms are excluded from both identification and enforcement. This keyword can be repeated.

KEYWORD.NAME: SPGR_PRINT_ATOMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Print equivalent atoms list for each space group symmetry operation.

SECTION.NAME: LBFGS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the limited memory BFGS (LBFGS) optimization

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_H_RANK
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum rank (and consequently size) of the approximate Hessian matrix used by the LBFGS optimizer. Larger values (e.g. 30) will accelerate the convergence behaviour at the cost of a larger memory consumption.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_F_PER_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of force evaluations per iteration (used for the line search)

KEYWORD.NAME: WANTED_PROJ_GRADIENT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion (overrides the general ones): Requested norm threshold of the gradient multiplied by the approximate Hessian.

KEYWORD.NAME: WANTED_REL_F_ERROR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion (overrides the general ones): Requested relative error on the objective function of the optimizer (the energy)

KEYWORD.NAME: TRUST_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Trust radius used in LBFGS. Not completely in depth tested. Negativ values means no trust radius is used.

SECTION.NAME: CG
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Provides parameters to tune the conjugate gradient optimization

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_STEEP_STEPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of steepest descent steps before starting the conjugate gradients optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_LIMIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Cosine of the angle between two consecutive searching directions. If the angle during a CG optimization is less than the one corresponding to to the RESTART_LIMIT the CG is reset and one step of steepest descent is performed.

KEYWORD.NAME: FLETCHER_REEVES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Uses FLETCHER-REEVES instead of POLAK-RIBIERE when using Conjugate Gradients

SECTION.NAME: MD
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section defines the whole set of parameters needed perform an MD run.

KEYWORD.NAME: ENSEMBLE

ITEM.NAME: NVE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: constant energy (microcanonical)

ITEM.NAME: NVT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: constant temperature and volume (canonical)

ITEM.NAME: NPT_I
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: constant temperature and pressure using an isotropic cell

ITEM.NAME: NPT_F
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: constant temperature and pressure using a flexible cell

ITEM.NAME: MSST
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: simulate steady shock (uniaxial)

ITEM.NAME: MSST_DAMPED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: simulate steady shock (uniaxial) with extra viscosity

ITEM.NAME: HYDROSTATICSHOCK
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: simulate steady shock with hydrostatic pressure

ITEM.NAME: ISOKIN
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: constant kinetic energy

ITEM.NAME: REFTRAJ
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: reading frames from a file called reftraj.xyz (e.g. for property calculation)

ITEM.NAME: LANGEVIN
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: langevin dynamics (constant temperature)

ITEM.NAME: NPE_F
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: constant pressure ensemble (no thermostat)

ITEM.NAME: NPE_I
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: constant pressure ensemble using an isotropic cell (no thermostat)

ITEM.NAME: NVT_ADIABATIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: adiabatic dynamics in constant temperature and volume ensemble (CAFES)

ITEM.NAME: NPT_IA
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: NPT_I ensemble with frozen atoms in absolute coordinate

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The ensemble/integrator that you want to use for MD propagation

KEYWORD.NAME: STEPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The number of MD steps to perform, counting from step_start_val.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_STEPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The number of MD steps to perform, counting from step 1

KEYWORD.NAME: TIMESTEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The length of an integration step (in case RESPA the large TIMESTEP)

KEYWORD.NAME: STEP_START_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The starting step value for the MD

KEYWORD.NAME: TIME_START_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The starting timer value for the MD

KEYWORD.NAME: ECONS_START_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The starting value of the conserved quantity

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMPERATURE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The temperature in K used to initialize the velocities with init and pos restart, and in the NPT/NVT simulations

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMP_TOL
TEMP_TO
TEMPERATURE_TOLERANCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The maximum accepted deviation of the (global) temperature from the desired target temperature before a rescaling of the velocites is performed. If it is 0 no rescaling is performed. NOTE: This keyword is obsolescent; Using a CSVR thermostat with a short timeconstant is recommended as a better alternative.

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMP_KIND
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Compute the temperature per each kind separately

KEYWORD.NAME: SCALE_TEMP_KIND
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: When necessary rescale the temperature per each kind separately

KEYWORD.NAME: COMVEL_TOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The maximum accepted velocity of the center of mass. With Shell-Model, comvel may drift if MD%THERMOSTAT%REGION /= GLOBAL

KEYWORD.NAME: ANGVEL_TOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The maximum accepted angular velocity. This option is ignored when the system is periodic. Removes the components of the velocities that project on the external rotational degrees of freedom.

KEYWORD.NAME: ANGVEL_ZERO
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Set the initial angular velocity to zero. This option is ignored when the system is periodic or when initial velocities are defined. Technically, the part of the random initial velocities that projects on the external rotational degrees of freedom is subtracted.

KEYWORD.NAME: ANNEALING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the rescaling factor for annealing velocities. Automatically enables the annealing procedure. This scheme works only for ensembles that do not have thermostats on particles.

KEYWORD.NAME: ANNEALING_CELL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the rescaling factor for annealing velocities of the CELL Automatically enables the annealing procedure for the CELL. This scheme works only for ensambles that do not have thermostat on CELLS velocities.

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMPERATURE_ANNEALING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the rescaling factor for the external temperature. This scheme works only for the Langevin ensemble.

KEYWORD.NAME: DISPLACEMENT_TOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keyword sets a maximum atomic displacement in each Cartesian direction. The maximum velocity is evaluated and if it is too large to remain within the assigned limit, the time step is rescaled accordingly, and the first half step of the velocity verlet is repeated.

KEYWORD.NAME: INITIALIZATION_METHOD

ITEM.NAME: DEFAULT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Assign random velocities and then scale according to TEMPERATURE

ITEM.NAME: VIBRATIONAL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Initialise positions and velocities to give canonical ensemble with TEMPERATURE, using the method described in PRL 96, 115504 (2006)

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keyword selects which method to use to initialize MD. If velecities are not set explicitly, DEFAULT optioin will assign random velocities and then scale according to TEMPERATURE; VIBRATIONAL option will then use previously calculated vibrational modes to initialise both the atomic positions and velocities so that the starting point for MD is as close to canonical ensemble as possible, without the need for lengthy equilibration steps. See PRL 96, 115504 (2006). The user input atomic positions in this case are expected to be already geometry optimised. Further options for VIBRATIONAL mode is can be set in INITIAL_VIBRATION subsection. If unspecified, then the DEFAULT mode will be used.

SECTION.NAME: LANGEVIN
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the set of parameters to run a Langevin MD. The integrator used follows that given in the article by Ricci et al. The user can define regions in the system where the atoms inside undergoes Langevin MD, while those outside the regions undergoes NVE Born Oppenheimer MD. To define the regions, the user should use THERMAL_REGION subsection of MOTION%MD.

KEYWORD.NAME: GAMMA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Gamma parameter for the Langevin dynamics (LD)

KEYWORD.NAME: NOISY_GAMMA
NOISYGAMMA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Imaginary Langevin Friction term for LD with noisy forces.

KEYWORD.NAME: SHADOW_GAMMA
SHADOWGAMMA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Shadow Langevin Friction term for LD with noisy forces in order to adjust Noisy_Gamma.

SECTION.NAME: MSST
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for Multi-Scale Shock Technique (MSST) which simulate the effect of a steady planar shock on a unit cell. Reed et. al. Physical Review Letters 90, 235503 (2003).

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMPERATURE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Barostat initial temperature. If not set, the ensemble temperature is used instead.

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMP_TOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum oscillation of the Barostat temperature imposed by rescaling.

KEYWORD.NAME: VIRIAL
KEYWORD.USAGE: VIRIAL (XYZ | X | Y | Z | XY| XZ | YZ)
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: For NPT_F only: allows the screening of one or more components of the virial in order to relax the cell only along specific cartesian axis

SECTION.NAME: VELOCITY
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The velocities for BAROSTAT used for restart

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify velocities of the system

SECTION.NAME: MASS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The masses for BAROSTAT used for restart

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify masses of the system

SECTION.NAME: THERMOSTAT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Specify thermostat type and parameters controlling the thermostat.

KEYWORD.NAME: TYPE

ITEM.NAME: SAME_AS_PARTICLE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use the same kind of thermostat used for particles.

ITEM.NAME: NOSE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Uses the Nose-Hoover thermostat.

ITEM.NAME: CSVR
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Uses the canonical sampling through velocity rescaling.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the thermostat used for the constant temperature ensembles.

SECTION.NAME: NOSE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: paramameters of the Nose Hoover thermostat chain

KEYWORD.NAME: YOSHIDA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: order of the yoshida integrator used for the thermostat

KEYWORD.NAME: MTS
MULTIPLE_TIME_STEPS
MULT_T_STEPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: number of multiple timesteps to be used for the NoseHoover chain

SECTION.NAME: COORD
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The positions for NOSE HOOVER used for restart

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify positions of the system

SECTION.NAME: VELOCITY
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The velocities for NOSE HOOVER used for restart

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify velocities of the system

SECTION.NAME: MASS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The masses for NOSE HOOVER used for restart

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify masses of the system

SECTION.NAME: FORCE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The forces for NOSE HOOVER used for restart

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify masses of the system

SECTION.NAME: CSVR
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters of the canonical sampling through velocity rescaling thermostat.

KEYWORD.NAME: TIMECON
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Time constant of the CSVR thermostat. A small time constant will result in strong thermostatting (useful for initial equilibrations) and a large time constant would be adequate to get weak thermostatting in production runs.

SECTION.NAME: THERMOSTAT_ENERGY
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Information to initialize the CSVR thermostat energy.

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify an initial thermostat energy for CSVR thermostat.

SECTION.NAME: RNG_INIT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Information to initialize the parallel random number generator streams

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify an initial RNG stream record

SECTION.NAME: GLE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: paramameters of the gle thermostat. This section can be generated from <https://gle4md.org/index.html?page=matrix>.

KEYWORD.NAME: A_SCALE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: scaling factor for matrix A (for generic matrix A, depends on the characteristic frequency of the system).

KEYWORD.NAME: A_LIST
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: A matrix The defaults give optimal sampling for most cristalline and liquid compounds. Generated with the parameters set kv_4-4.a centered on w_0=40 cm^-1.

SECTION.NAME: THERMOSTAT_ENERGY
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Information to initialize the CSVR thermostat energy.

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify an initial thermostat energy for CSVR thermostat.

SECTION.NAME: RNG_INIT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Information to initialize the parallel random number generator streams

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify an initial RNG stream record

SECTION.NAME: S
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The s variable for GLE used for restart

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify s variable for GLE thermostat

SECTION.NAME: AD_LANGEVIN
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters of the adaptive-Langevin thermostat. Known to work with NVT ensemble, but not tested with other ensembles. Also tested with FIXED_ATOMS constraints, but may not work with other constraints (restraints should be OK, but haven't been well tested)

KEYWORD.NAME: TIMECON_NH
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Time constant of the Nose-Hoover part of the AD_LANGEVIN thermostat. A small time constant will result in strong thermostatting (useful for initial equilibrations) and a large time constant would be adequate to get weak thermostatting in production runs.

KEYWORD.NAME: TIMECON_LANGEVIN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Time constant of the Langevin part of the AD_LANGEVIN thermostat. A small time constant will result in strong thermostatting (useful for initial equilibrations) and a large time constant would be adequate to get weak thermostatting in production runs.

SECTION.NAME: CHI
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Information to initialize the Ad-Langevin thermostat DOF CHI

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify an initial thermostat DOF CHI for Ad-Langevin thermostat.

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Information to initialize the Ad-Langevin thermostat DOF MASS

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls output information of the corresponding thermostat.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: RESPA
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Multiple timestep integration based on RESPA (implemented for NVE only). RESPA exploits multiple force_eval. In this case the order of the force_eval maps the order of the respa shells from the slowest to the fastest force evaluation. If force_evals share the same subsys, it's enough then to specify the subsys in the force_eval corresponding at the first index in the multiple_force_eval list. Can be used to speedup classical and ab initio MD simulations.

KEYWORD.NAME: FREQUENCY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The number of reference MD steps between two RESPA corrections.

SECTION.NAME: SHELL
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters of shell model in adiabatic dynamics.

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMPERATURE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Temperature in K used to control the internal velocities of the core-shell motion

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMP_TOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum accepted temperature deviation from the expected value, for the internal core-shell motion. If 0, no rescaling is performed

KEYWORD.NAME: NOSE_PARTICLE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If nvt or npt, the core and shell velocities are controlled by the same thermostat used for the particle. This might favour heat exchange and additional rescaling of the internal core-shell velocity is needed (TEMP_TOL)

KEYWORD.NAME: DISPLACEMENT_SHELL_TOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keyword sets a maximum variation of the shell core distance in each Cartesian direction. The maximum internal core-shell velocity is evaluated and if it is too large to remain within the assigned limit, the time step is rescaled accordingly, and the first half step of the velocity verlet is repeated.

SECTION.NAME: VELOCITY_SOFTENING
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: A method to initialize the velocities along low-curvature directions in order to favors MD trajectories to cross rapidly over small energy barriers into neighboring basins. In each iteration the forces are calculated at a point y, which is slightly displaced from the current positions x in the direction of the original velocities v. The velocities are then updated with the force component F_t, which is perpendicular to N. N = v / |v|; y = x + delta * N; F_t = F(y) - ⟨ F(y) | N ⟩ * N; v' = v + alpha * F_t

KEYWORD.NAME: STEPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of softening iterations performed. Typical values are around 40 steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: ALPHA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Mixing factor used for updating velocities.

SECTION.NAME: REFTRAJ
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Loads an external trajectory file and performs analysis on the loaded snapshots.

KEYWORD.NAME: TRAJ_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the filename where the trajectory is stored. If you built your own trajectory file make sure it has the trajectory format. In particular, each structure has to be enumerated using " i = ..."

KEYWORD.NAME: CELL_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the filename where the cell is stored (for trajectories generated within variable cell ensembles).

KEYWORD.NAME: VARIABLE_VOLUME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Enables the possibility to read a CELL file with information on the CELL size during the MD.

KEYWORD.NAME: FIRST_SNAPSHOT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Index of the snapshot stored in the trajectory file from which to start a REFTRAJ run

KEYWORD.NAME: LAST_SNAPSHOT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Index of the last snapshot stored in the trajectory file that is read along a REFTRAJ run. Must be specified as default is 0. Must be specified exactly as LAST_SNAPSHOT = FIRST_SNAPSHOT + STRIDE*(number of strides) to avoid an error 'Unexpected EOF'. Note that STRIDE*(number of strides) is simply the number of steps between the first to last snapshot.

KEYWORD.NAME: STRIDE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Stride in number of snapshot for the reftraj analysis

ITEM.NAME: NONE

SECTION.NAME: THERMAL_REGION
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Define regions where different initialization and control of the temperature is used. When MOTION%MD%ENSEMBLE is set to LANGEVIN, this section controls if the atoms defined inside and outside the thermal regions should undergo Langevin MD or NVE Born-Oppenheimer MD. The theory behind Langevin MD using different regions can be found in articles by Kantorovitch et al. listed below.

KEYWORD.NAME: FORCE_RESCALING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Control the rescaling ot the velocities in all the regions, according to the temperature assigned to each reagion, when RESTART_VELOCITY in EXT_RESTART is active.

KEYWORD.NAME: DO_LANGEVIN_DEFAULT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If ENSEMBLE is set to LANGEVIN, controls whether the atoms NOT defined in the thermal regions to undergo langevin MD or not. If not, then the atoms will undergo NVE Born-Oppenheimer MD.

SECTION.NAME: DEFINE_REGION
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section provides the possibility to define arbitrary region

KEYWORD.NAME: LIST
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies a list of atoms belonging to the region.

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMPERATURE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The temperature in K used to initialize the velocities of the atoms in this region

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMP_TOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum accepted temperature deviation from the expected value for this region. If temp_tol=0 no rescaling is performed

KEYWORD.NAME: DO_LANGEVIN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: When ENSEMBLE is set to LANGEVIN, Controls whether the atoms in the thermal region should undergo Langevin MD. If not, then they will undergo NVE Born-Oppenheimer MD.

KEYWORD.NAME: NOISY_GAMMA_REGION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Special imaginary Langevin Friction term for Langevin Dynamics with noisy forces for the atoms in this region. When set, overrides the general value set by NOISY_GAMMA in the MOTION%MD%LANGEVIN section. When unset for a defined region, the general NOISY_GAMMA value applies.

SECTION.NAME: TEMPERATURE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls output of temperature per region.
