SECTION.NAME: CASCADE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Defines the parameters for the setup of a cascade simulation.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Controls the activation of the CASCADE section.

KEYWORD.NAME: ENERGY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Total energy transferred to the system during the cascade event.

SECTION.NAME: ATOM_LIST
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Defines a list of atoms for which the initial velocities are modified

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the list of atoms for which the velocities are modified. Each record consists of the atomic index, the velocity vector, and a weight to define which fraction of the total energy is assigned to the current atom: `Atomic_index v_x v_y v_z Weight`

SECTION.NAME: INITIAL_VIBRATION
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the set of parameters for MD initialisation based on vibration analysis data. The starting atomic coordinates should be based on the relaxed positions obtained from a previous geometry/cell optimisation calculation, and the vibrational frequencies and displacements data should be obtained from a vibrational analysis calculation done based on the relaxed coordinates. The MD initialisation process expects the user has performed both geometry optimisation and vibrational analysis before hand, and won't perform those calculations automatically

KEYWORD.NAME: VIB_EIGS_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The file name of vibrational frequency (eigenvalue) and displacement (eigenvector) data calculated from the a vibrational analysis calculation done previously. This file must be the same unformatted binary file as referred to by VIBRATIONAL_ANALYSIS%PRINT%CARTESIAN_EIGS keyword. If this keyword is not explicitly defined by the user, then the default file name of: <project_name>-<CARTESIAN_EIGS_FILENAME>.eig will be used

KEYWORD.NAME: PHASE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Controls the initial ratio of potential and kinetic contribution to the total energy. The contribution is determined by COS**2(2*pi*PHASE) for potential energy, and SIN**2(2*pi*PHASE) for kinetic energy. If PHASE is negative, then for each vibration mode the phase is determined randomly. Otherwise, PHASE must be between 0.0 and 1.0 and will be the same for all vibration modes. If value > 1.0 it will just be treated as 1.0. For example, setting PHASE = 0.25 would set all modes to begin with entirely kinetic energy --- in other words, the initial atomic positions will remain at their optimised location

SECTION.NAME: DRIVER
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section defines the parameters needed to run in i-PI driver mode.

KEYWORD.NAME: UNIX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use a UNIX socket rather than an INET socket.

KEYWORD.NAME: PORT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Port number for the i-PI server.

KEYWORD.NAME: HOST
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Host name for the i-PI server.

KEYWORD.NAME: SLEEP_TIME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sleeping time while waiting for for driver commands [s].

SECTION.NAME: FREE_ENERGY
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the calculation of free energy and free energy derivatives with different possible methods

KEYWORD.NAME: METHOD

ITEM.NAME: METADYN
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Metadynamics

ITEM.NAME: UI
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Umbrella Integration

ITEM.NAME: AC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Alchemical Change

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the method to use to compute free energy.

SECTION.NAME: METADYN
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section sets parameters to set up a calculation of metadynamics.

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_PLUMED
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify whether to use plumed as an external metadynamics driver.

KEYWORD.NAME: PLUMED_INPUT_FILE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the file name of the external plumed input file

KEYWORD.NAME: MIN_NT_HILLS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the minimum MD step interval between spawning two hills. If specified, it must be >= than NT_HILLS. In case MIN_DISP is used, if MIN_DISP is satisfied before MIN_NT_HILLS MD steps have been performed, the MD will continue without any spawning until MIN_NT_HILLS is reached. The default value has the net effect of skipping this check.

KEYWORD.NAME: NT_HILLS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the maximum MD step interval between spawning two hills. When negative, no new hills are spawned and only the hills read from SPAWNED_HILLS_* are in effect. The latter is useful when one wants to add a custom constant bias potential.

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMPERATURE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If a Lagrangian scheme is used the temperature for the collective variables is specified.

KEYWORD.NAME: MIN_DISP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Minimum displacement between hills before placing a new hill.

KEYWORD.NAME: OLD_HILL_NUMBER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Index of the last hill spawned for this walker.Needed to calculate MIN_DISP

KEYWORD.NAME: OLD_HILL_STEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Timestep of the last hill spawned for this walker.Needed to calculate MIN_DISP

KEYWORD.NAME: HILL_TAIL_CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: By setting this variable larger than 0 the tail of the Gaussian hill is damped to zero faster. The Gaussian function is multiplied by a cutoff function that becomes active at |x-X0|>HILL_TAIL_CUTOFF*SCALE, where X0 is the location of the Gaussian and SCALE is the width of the Gaussian. For more than one METAVAR X0 and SCALE are METAVAR-dependent. (1-(|x-X0|/HILL_TAIL_CUTOFF*SCALE)^P_EXP)/(1-(|x-X0|/HILL_TAIL_CUTOFF*SCALE)^Q_EXP)

KEYWORD.NAME: P_EXPONENT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Exponent at the numerator of the cutoff function to damp the tail of the Gaussian.

KEYWORD.NAME: Q_EXPONENT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Exponent at the denominator of the cutoff function to damp the tail of the Gaussian.

KEYWORD.NAME: SLOW_GROWTH
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Let the last hill grow slowly over NT_HILLS.

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMP_TOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If a Lagrangian scheme is used the temperature tolerance for the collective variables is specified.

KEYWORD.NAME: LANGEVIN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If a Lagrangian scheme is used the eq. motion of the COLVARS are integrated with a LANGEVIN scheme.

KEYWORD.NAME: WW
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the height of the gaussian to spawn. Default 0.1 .

KEYWORD.NAME: DO_HILLS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keyword enables the spawning of the hills. Default .FALSE.

KEYWORD.NAME: WELL_TEMPERED
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keyword enables Well-tempered metadynamics. Default .FALSE.

KEYWORD.NAME: DELTA_T
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If Well-tempered metaD is used, the temperature parameter must be specified.

KEYWORD.NAME: WTGAMMA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If Well-tempered metaD is used, the gamma parameter must be specified if not DELTA_T.

KEYWORD.NAME: LAGRANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies whether an extended-lagrangian should be used. Default .FALSE.

KEYWORD.NAME: STEP_START_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The starting step value for metadynamics

KEYWORD.NAME: NHILLS_START_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The starting value of previously spawned hills

KEYWORD.NAME: COLVAR_AVG_TEMPERATURE_RESTART
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: COLVAR average temperature. Only for restarting purposes.

KEYWORD.NAME: TAMCSTEPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of sampling points for z

KEYWORD.NAME: TIMESTEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The length of an integration step for colvars (TAMC only)

SECTION.NAME: METAVAR
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specify the nature of the collective variables.

KEYWORD.NAME: LAMBDA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the lambda parameter for the coupling of the collective variable with the system coordinates in the extended lagrangian scheme.

KEYWORD.NAME: MASS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the mass parameter of the collective variable in the extended lagrangian scheme.

KEYWORD.NAME: GAMMA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the friction term in Langevin integration of the collective variable in the extended lagrangian scheme.

KEYWORD.NAME: SCALE
WIDTH
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the scale factor for the following collective variable. The history dependent term has the expression: WW * Sum_{j=1}^{nhills} Prod_{k=1}^{ncolvar} [EXP[-0.5*((ss-ss0(k,j))/SCALE(k))^2]], where ncolvar is the number of defined METAVAR and nhills is the number of spawned hills.

KEYWORD.NAME: COLVAR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the colvar on which to apply metadynamics.

SECTION.NAME: WALL
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the activation of walls on COLVAR during a metadynamic run.

ITEM.NAME: REFLECTIVE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Reflective wall. Colvar velocity is inverted when the colvar is beyond the wall position.

ITEM.NAME: QUADRATIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Applies a quadratic potential at the wall position.

ITEM.NAME: QUARTIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Applies a quartic potential at the wall position.

ITEM.NAME: GAUSSIAN
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Applies a gaussian potential at the wall position.

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: No walls are applied.

KEYWORD.NAME: POSITION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the value of the colvar for the wall position

KEYWORD.NAME: DIRECTION

ITEM.NAME: WALL_PLUS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Wall extends from the position towards larger values of COLVAR

ITEM.NAME: WALL_MINUS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Wall extends from the position towards smaller values of COLVAR

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the direction of the wall.

KEYWORD.NAME: DIRECTION

ITEM.NAME: WALL_PLUS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Wall extends from the position towards larger values of COLVAR

ITEM.NAME: WALL_MINUS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Wall extends from the position towards smaller values of COLVAR

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the direction of the wall.

KEYWORD.NAME: K
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the value of the quadratic potential constant: K*(CV-POS)^2

KEYWORD.NAME: DIRECTION

ITEM.NAME: WALL_PLUS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Wall extends from the position towards larger values of COLVAR

ITEM.NAME: WALL_MINUS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Wall extends from the position towards smaller values of COLVAR

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the direction of the wall.

KEYWORD.NAME: K
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the value of the quartic potential constant: K*(CV-(POS+/-(1/K^(1/4))))^4

KEYWORD.NAME: WW
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the height of the gaussian: WW*e^(-((CV-POS)/sigma)^2)

KEYWORD.NAME: SIGMA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the width of the gaussian: WW*e^(-((CV-POS)/sigma)^2)

SECTION.NAME: MULTIPLE_WALKERS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Enables and configures the metadynamics using multiple walkers.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Controls the usage of the multiple walkers in a metadynamics run.

KEYWORD.NAME: WALKER_ID
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets the walker ID for the local metadynamics run.

KEYWORD.NAME: NUMBER_OF_WALKERS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets the total number of walkers in the metadynamic run.

KEYWORD.NAME: WALKER_COMM_FREQUENCY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets the frequency (in unit of spawned hills) for the communication between the several walkers, in order to update the local list of hills with the ones coming from the other walkers

KEYWORD.NAME: WALKERS_STATUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Stores the status of the several walkers in the local run.

SECTION.NAME: WALKERS_FILE_NAME
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Specify the basename for the NUMBER_OF_WALKERS files used to communicate between the walkers. Absolute path can be input as well together with the filename. One file will be created for each spawned hill.

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specified the communication filename for each walker.

SECTION.NAME: PRINT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing properties during an metadynamics run

SECTION.NAME: PROGRAM_RUN_INFO
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of basic and summary information during metadynamics.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: COLVAR
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of COLVAR summary information during metadynamics. When an extended Lagrangian use used, the files contain (in order): colvar value of the extended Lagrangian, instantaneous colvar value, force due to the harmonic term of the extended Lagrangian and the force due to the previously spawned hills, the force due to the walls, the velocities in the extended Lagrangian, the potential of the harmonic term of the Lagrangian, the potential energy of the hills, the potential energy of the walls and the temperature of the extended Lagrangian. When the extended Lagrangian is not used, all related fields are omitted.

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: CONSTRAINT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section specifying information regarding how to impose constraints on the system.

KEYWORD.NAME: SHAKE_TOLERANCE
SHAKE_TOL
SHAKE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Set the tolerance for the shake/rattle constraint algorithm.

KEYWORD.NAME: ROLL_TOLERANCE
ROLL_TOL
ROLL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Set the tolerance for the roll constraint algorithm.

KEYWORD.NAME: CONSTRAINT_INIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Apply constraints to the initial position and velocities. Default is to apply constraints only after the first MD step.

SECTION.NAME: HBONDS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section is used to set bonds constraints involving Hydrogen atoms

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOM_TYPE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the atoms' type forming a bond with an hydrogen. If not specified the default bond value of the first molecule is used as constraint target

KEYWORD.NAME: MOLECULE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the indexes of the molecule kind (in input file order) on which the constraint will be applied. MOLECULE and MOLNAME keyword exclude themself mutually.

KEYWORD.NAME: MOLNAME
SEGNAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the names of the molecule on which the constraint will be applied.

KEYWORD.NAME: EXCLUDE_QM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Does not shake HBONDS in the QM region within a QM/MM calculation

KEYWORD.NAME: EXCLUDE_MM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Does not shake HBONDS in the MM region within a QM/MM calculation

KEYWORD.NAME: TARGETS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The constrained distances' values for the types defines in ATOM_TYPE.

SECTION.NAME: RESTRAINT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Activate and specify information on restraint instead of constraint

KEYWORD.NAME: K
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the force constant for the harmonic restraint. The functional form for the restraint is: K*(X-TARGET)^2.

SECTION.NAME: G3X3
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section is used to set 3x3 (3 atoms and 3 distances) constraints.

KEYWORD.NAME: MOLECULE
MOL

KEYWORD.NAME: MOLNAME
SEGNAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the name of the molecule on which the constraint will be applied.

KEYWORD.NAME: INTERMOLECULAR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify if the constraint/restraint is intermolecular.

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Atoms' index on which apply the constraint

KEYWORD.NAME: EXCLUDE_QM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Does not apply the constraint to the QM region within a QM/MM calculation

KEYWORD.NAME: EXCLUDE_MM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Does not apply the constraint to the MM region within a QM/MM calculation

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Activate and specify information on restraint instead of constraint

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the force constant for the harmonic restraint. The functional form for the restraint is: K*(X-TARGET)^2.

KEYWORD.NAME: MOLECULE
MOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the molecule number on which constraint will be applied. MOLECULE and MOLNAME keyword exclude themself mutually.

KEYWORD.NAME: MOLNAME
SEGNAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the name of the molecule on which the constraint will be applied.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The constrained parameters' values to construct virtual site. r_v=a*r_ij+b*r_kj

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Does not apply the constraint to the QM region within a QM/MM calculation

SECTION.NAME: COLLECTIVE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Used to constraint collective (general) degrees of freedom, writing langrangian multipliers to file.

KEYWORD.NAME: COLVAR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the index (in input file order) of the type of colvar to constrain.

KEYWORD.NAME: MOLECULE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the index of the molecule kind (in input file order) on which the constraint will be applied. MOLECULE and MOLNAME keyword exclude themself mutually.

KEYWORD.NAME: MOLNAME
SEGNAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the name of the molecule on which the constraint will be applied.

KEYWORD.NAME: INTERMOLECULAR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify if the constraint/restraint is intermolecular.

KEYWORD.NAME: TARGET
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the target value of the constrained collective variable (units depend on the colvar).

KEYWORD.NAME: TARGET_GROWTH
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the growth speed of the target value of the constrained collective variable.

KEYWORD.NAME: TARGET_LIMIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the limit of the growth of the target value of the constrained collective variable. By default no limit at the colvar growth is set.

KEYWORD.NAME: EXCLUDE_QM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Does not apply the constraint to the QM region within a QM/MM calculation

KEYWORD.NAME: EXCLUDE_MM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Does not apply the constraint to the MM region within a QM/MM calculation

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Activate and specify information on restraint instead of constraint

KEYWORD.NAME: K
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the force constant for the harmonic restraint. The functional form for the restraint is: K*(X-TARGET)^2.

SECTION.NAME: FIXED_ATOMS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section is used to constraint the fractional atomic position (X,Y,Z). Note that fractional coordinates are constrained, not real space coordinates. In case a restraint is specified the value of the TARGET is considered to be the value of the coordinates at the beginning of the run or alternatively the corresponding value in the section: FIX_ATOM_RESTART.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMPONENTS_TO_FIX

ITEM.NAME: X
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Fix only X component

ITEM.NAME: Y
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Fix only Y component

ITEM.NAME: Z
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Fix only Z component

ITEM.NAME: XY
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Fix X-Y components

ITEM.NAME: XZ
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Fix X-Z components

ITEM.NAME: YZ
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Fix Y-Z components

ITEM.NAME: XYZ
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Fix the full components of the atomic position.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify which fractional components (X,Y,Z or combinations) of the atoms specified in the section will be constrained/restrained.

KEYWORD.NAME: LIST
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies a list of atoms to freeze.

KEYWORD.NAME: MOLNAME
SEGNAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the name of the molecule to fix

KEYWORD.NAME: MM_SUBSYS
PROTEIN

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: fix nothing

ITEM.NAME: ATOMIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: only the MM atoms itself

ITEM.NAME: MOLECULAR
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: the full molecule/residue that contains a MM atom (i.e. some QM atoms might be fixed as well)

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: In a QM/MM run all MM atoms are fixed according to the argument.

KEYWORD.NAME: QM_SUBSYS

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: fix nothing

ITEM.NAME: ATOMIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: only the QM atoms itself

ITEM.NAME: MOLECULAR
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: the full molecule/residue that contains a QM atom (i.e. some MM atoms might be fixed as well)

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: In a QM/MM run all QM atoms are fixed according to the argument.

KEYWORD.NAME: EXCLUDE_QM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Does not apply the constraint to the QM region within a QM/MM calculation. This keyword is active only together with MOLNAME

KEYWORD.NAME: EXCLUDE_MM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Does not apply the constraint to the MM region within a QM/MM calculation. This keyword is active only together with MOLNAME

SECTION.NAME: RESTRAINT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Activate and specify information on restraint instead of constraint

KEYWORD.NAME: K
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the force constant for the harmonic restraint. The functional form for the restraint is: K*(X-TARGET)^2.

SECTION.NAME: FIX_ATOM_RESTART
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Specify restart position only for FIXED_ATOMS restraints.

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The restarting position of fixed atoms for restraints. The order is an internal order. So if you decide to modify these values by hand first think what you're doing!

SECTION.NAME: COLVAR_RESTART
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Specify restart position only for COLVAR restraints.

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The restarting values for COLVAR restraints. The order is an internal order. So if you decide to modify these values by hand first think what you're doing!

KEYWORD.NAME: XAS_SCF

KEYWORD.NAME: MD

KEYWORD.NAME: PINT

KEYWORD.NAME: METADYNAMICS

KEYWORD.NAME: GEO_OPT

KEYWORD.NAME: ROT_OPT

KEYWORD.NAME: CELL_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Cell optimization steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: BAND

KEYWORD.NAME: EP_LIN_SOLVER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Energy Perturbation (EP) linear solver

KEYWORD.NAME: SPLINE_FIND_COEFFS

KEYWORD.NAME: REPLICA_EVAL

KEYWORD.NAME: BSSE

KEYWORD.NAME: SHELL_OPT

KEYWORD.NAME: TDDFT_SCF

SECTION.NAME: MC
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section sets parameters to set up a MonteCarlo calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: NSTEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the number of MC cycles.

KEYWORD.NAME: IPRINT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Prints coordinate/cell/etc information every IPRINT steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: NMOVES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the number of classical moves between energy evaluations.

KEYWORD.NAME: NSWAPMOVES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many insertions to try per swap move.

KEYWORD.NAME: LBIAS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Dictates if we presample moves with a different potential.

KEYWORD.NAME: LSTOP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Makes nstep in terms of steps, instead of cycles.

KEYWORD.NAME: LDISCRETE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Changes the volume of the box in discrete steps, one side at a time.

KEYWORD.NAME: RCLUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The cluster cut off radius in angstroms.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Read initial configuration from restart file.

KEYWORD.NAME: NVIRIAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use this many random orientations to compute the second virial coefficient (ENSEMBLE=VIRIAL)

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the restart file for MC information.

KEYWORD.NAME: MOVES_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The file to print the move statistics to.

KEYWORD.NAME: MOLECULES_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The file to print the number of molecules to.

KEYWORD.NAME: COORDINATE_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The file to print the current coordinates to.

KEYWORD.NAME: ENERGY_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The file to print current energies to.

KEYWORD.NAME: DATA_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The file to print current configurational info to.

KEYWORD.NAME: CELL_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The file to print current cell length info to.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_DISP_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The file to print current maximum displacement info to.

KEYWORD.NAME: BOX2_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: For GEMC, the name of the input file for the other box.

KEYWORD.NAME: PRESSURE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The pressure for NpT simulations, in bar.

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMPERATURE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The temperature of the simulation, in Kelvin.

KEYWORD.NAME: VIRIAL_TEMPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The temperatures you wish to compute the virial coefficient for. Only used if ensemble=VIRIAL.

KEYWORD.NAME: DISCRETE_STEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The size of the discrete volume move step, in angstroms.

KEYWORD.NAME: ETA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The free energy bias (in Kelvin) for swapping a molecule of each type into this box.

KEYWORD.NAME: RANDOMTOSKIP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of random numbers from the acceptance/rejection stream to skip

SECTION.NAME: AVBMC
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for Aggregation Volume Bias Monte Carlo (AVBMC) which explores cluster formation and destruction. Chen and Siepmann, J. Phys. Chem. B 105, 11275-11282 (2001).

KEYWORD.NAME: PBIAS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The probability of swapping to an inner region in an AVBMC swap move for each molecule type.

KEYWORD.NAME: AVBMC_ATOM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The target atom for an AVBMC swap move for each molecule type.

KEYWORD.NAME: AVBMC_RMIN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The inner radius for an AVBMC swap move, in angstroms for every molecule type.

KEYWORD.NAME: AVBMC_RMAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The outer radius for an AVBMC swap move, in angstroms, for every molecule type.

SECTION.NAME: MOVE_PROBABILITIES
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for fraction of moves performed for each move type.

KEYWORD.NAME: PMHMC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The probability of attempting a hybrid MC move.

KEYWORD.NAME: PMTRANS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The probability of attempting a molecule translation.

KEYWORD.NAME: PMCLTRANS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The probability of attempting a cluster translation.

KEYWORD.NAME: PMAVBMC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The probability of attempting an AVBMC swap move.

KEYWORD.NAME: PMTRAION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The probability of attempting a conformational change.

KEYWORD.NAME: PMSWAP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The probability of attempting a swap move.

KEYWORD.NAME: PMVOLUME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The probability of attempting a volume move.

SECTION.NAME: MOL_PROBABILITIES
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Probabilities of attempting various moves types on the various molecular types present in the simulation.

KEYWORD.NAME: PMAVBMC_MOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The probability of attempting an AVBMC swap move on each molecule type.

KEYWORD.NAME: PMSWAP_MOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The probability of attempting a molecule swap of a given molecule type.

KEYWORD.NAME: PMROT_MOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The probability of attempting a molecule rotation of a given molecule type.

KEYWORD.NAME: PMTRAION_MOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The probability of attempting a conformational change of a given molecule type.

KEYWORD.NAME: PMTRANS_MOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The probability of attempting a molecule translation of a given molecule type.

SECTION.NAME: BOX_PROBABILITIES
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Probabilities of attempting various moves types on the box.

KEYWORD.NAME: PMHMC_BOX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The probability of attempting a HMC move on this box.

KEYWORD.NAME: PMVOL_BOX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The probability of attempting a volume move on this box (GEMC_NpT).

KEYWORD.NAME: PMCLUS_BOX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The probability of attempting a cluster move in this box

SECTION.NAME: MOVE_UPDATES
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Frequency for updating move maximum displacements.

KEYWORD.NAME: IUPVOLUME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Every iupvolume steps update maximum volume displacement.

KEYWORD.NAME: IUPTRANS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Every iuptrans steps update maximum translation/rotation/configurational changes.

KEYWORD.NAME: IUPCLTRANS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Every iupcltrans steps update maximum cluster translation.

SECTION.NAME: MAX_DISPLACEMENTS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The maximum displacements for all attempted moves.

SECTION.NAME: MOL_DISPLACEMENTS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Maximum displacements for every move type that requires a value for each molecular type in the simulation.

KEYWORD.NAME: RMBOND
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum bond length displacement, in angstroms, for each molecule type.

KEYWORD.NAME: RMANGLE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum bond angle displacement, in degrees, for each molecule type.

KEYWORD.NAME: RMDIHEDRAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum dihedral angle distplacement, in degrees, for each molecule type.

KEYWORD.NAME: RMROT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum rotational displacement, in degrees, for each molecule type.

KEYWORD.NAME: RMTRANS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum translational displacement, in angstroms, for each molecule type.

SECTION.NAME: BOX_DISPLACEMENTS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Maximum displacements for any move that is performed on each simulation box.

KEYWORD.NAME: RMCLTRANS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum translational displacement, in angstroms, for each cluster.

SECTION.NAME: TMC
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: A parallelized MC algorithm, presampling the configurations, espacially the Markov chain elements

KEYWORD.NAME: GROUP_ENERGY_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: amount of CPUs per group for energy calculation

KEYWORD.NAME: GROUP_ENERGY_NR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: amount of groups for exact energy calculation

KEYWORD.NAME: GROUP_CC_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: amount of of CPUs per group for configurational change

KEYWORD.NAME: GROUP_ANLYSIS_NR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: amount of groups (cores) for analysing the configurations

KEYWORD.NAME: NUM_MC_ELEM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: the minimum Markov Chain elements, to be sampled

KEYWORD.NAME: RND_DETERMINISTIC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: the initialisation number for the random number generator

KEYWORD.NAME: TASK_TYPE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Select specialized types. Selectable: IDEAL_GAS (constant configuration energy E=0.0)

KEYWORD.NAME: NR_TEMPERATURE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: the number of different temperature for parallel tempering

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMPERATURE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: one temperature OR for parallel tempering: Tmin Tmax or each temperature T1 T2 T3 ... If every single temperature is specified, do NOT use keyword NR_TEMPERATURE

KEYWORD.NAME: NUM_MV_ELEM_IN_CELL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: the number of elements (atoms or molecules) moves in cell or sub box. if 0 all elements are moved once in a MC move

KEYWORD.NAME: SUB_BOX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: specifies the size ot the sub box. Standard moves only within subbox of random position, to compensate the potential difference of the approximate potential.

KEYWORD.NAME: PRESSURE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: enables NPT calculation with specified constant pressure [bar]

KEYWORD.NAME: VOLUME_ISOTROPIC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: volume move is equal in each direction

KEYWORD.NAME: MOVE_CENTER_OF_MASS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Moves the center of mass of defined molecules (in volume moves)

KEYWORD.NAME: ESIMATE_ACC_PROB
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: set the estimation of the acceptance probability using run time information of the energy

KEYWORD.NAME: SPECULATIVE_CANCELING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: enables or disables the speculative canceling. If we have further knowledge of acceptance probabilities using parent acceptance or the estimated energy.

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_SCF_ENERGY_INFO
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: enables or disables the usage of SCF energy information for estimating the acceptance probability.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESULT_LIST_IN_MEMORY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: enables the storing of the whole Markov Chain

KEYWORD.NAME: INFO_OUT_STEP_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: the number the amount of calculated configurations between to output printings.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_IN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: if existing use the last restart file

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_OUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the frequency to write restart files. If no frequency is specified (lone keyword) the restart file is written at the end (only). If the value is 0, no restart file is written at all. The frequency specifies is related to the calculated Markov chain elements

KEYWORD.NAME: ENERGY_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: input file name for the exact potential energy calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_ONLY_ACC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: printing only accepted elements of the Markov Chain.

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_COORDS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: printing coordinates of the Markov Chain elements

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_FORCES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: printing forces of the Markov Chain elements

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_DIPOLE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: enables the calculation and printing the exact cell dipoles (only for QS methods)

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_CELL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: printing the cell vectors of the Markov Chain elements

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_ENERGIES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: printing the different calculated energies (approximated, scf and exact)

KEYWORD.NAME: DOT_TREE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: file name for GrapgViz dot file

KEYWORD.NAME: ALL_CONF_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: file name for printing every single calculated configuration (e.g. for fitting).

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_TEST_OUTPUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: printing different values for regtest comparison

SECTION.NAME: MOVE_TYPE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies the TMC move type, and its properties. Selectable types are: ATOM_TRANS atom translation, MOL_TRANS molecule translation, MOL_ROT molecule rotation, PROT_REORDER proton reordering, PT_SWAP Parallel Tempering swap, VOL_MOVE volume change, ATOM_SWAP swaps two atoms of different type.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the move type described in this section.

KEYWORD.NAME: SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the size of the move: ATOM_TRANS [A], MOL_TRANS [A], MOL_ROT [degree], PROT_REORDER [], VOL_MOVE [A], ATOM_SWAP

KEYWORD.NAME: PROB
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the probability of the move (considering the ration between the selected moves)

KEYWORD.NAME: INIT_ACC_PROB
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the initial probability of accepting the move.

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the atomic kinds involved in the move. Up to now only used for the atom swap.

SECTION.NAME: NMC_MOVES

KEYWORD.NAME: NR_NMC_STEPS

KEYWORD.NAME: NMC_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: input file name for the approximate potential for Nested Monte Carlo.

KEYWORD.NAME: PROB
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the probability of the NMC move (considering the ration between the selected other moves) the probabilities of the move types in the NMC section defines only the weight within the NMC steps

KEYWORD.NAME: INIT_ACC_PROB
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the initial probability of accepting the move.

SECTION.NAME: MOVE_TYPE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies the TMC move type, and its properties. Selectable types are: ATOM_TRANS atom translation, MOL_TRANS molecule translation, MOL_ROT molecule rotation, PROT_REORDER proton reordering, PT_SWAP Parallel Tempering swap, VOL_MOVE volume change, ATOM_SWAP swaps two atoms of different type.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the initial probability of accepting the move.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the atomic kinds involved in the move. Up to now only used for the atom swap.

KEYWORD.NAME: LEVY_SEED
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial seed for the (pseudo)random number generator that controls Levy walk for bead positions.

KEYWORD.NAME: THERMOSTAT_SEED
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial seed for the (pseudo)random number generator that controls the PILE and PIGLET thermostats.

KEYWORD.NAME: RANDOMIZE_POS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: add gaussian noise to the positions of the beads

KEYWORD.NAME: CENTROID_SPEED
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: adds random velocity component to the centroid modes (useful to correct for the averaging out of the speed of various beads)

KEYWORD.NAME: VELOCITY_QUENCH
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: set the initial velocities to zero

KEYWORD.NAME: VELOCITY_SCALE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: scale initial velocities to the temperature given in MOTION%PINT%TEMP

SECTION.NAME: HELIUM
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The section that controls optional helium solvent environment (highly experimental, not for general use yet)

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Whether or not to actually use this section

KEYWORD.NAME: HELIUM_ONLY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Simulate helium solvent only, disregard solute entirely

KEYWORD.NAME: INTERACTION_POT_SCAN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scan solute-helium interaction potential, cubefile parameters set in subsection RHO

KEYWORD.NAME: POTENTIAL_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the Helium interaction potential file

KEYWORD.NAME: GET_FORCES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Get average MC forces or last MC forces to propagate MD

KEYWORD.NAME: SOLUTE_INTERACTION

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: No interaction with solute

ITEM.NAME: MWATER
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Test interaction with wrong Water

ITEM.NAME: NNP
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Interaction with NNP

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Interaction potential between helium and the solute

KEYWORD.NAME: NBEADS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of helium path integral beads

KEYWORD.NAME: RNG_SEED
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial seed for the (pseudo)random number generator that controls helium coordinate generation and propagation.

KEYWORD.NAME: N_INNER
INOROT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of MC iterations at the same time slice(s) (number of inner MC loop iterations)

KEYWORD.NAME: N_OUTER
IROT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: how often to reselect the time slice(s) to work on (number of outer MC loop iterations)

KEYWORD.NAME: SAMPLING_METHOD
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Choose between Ceperley or the worm algorithm

KEYWORD.NAME: COORD_INIT_TEMP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Temperature for thermal gaussian initialization of the helium. Negative values correspond to a hot start.

KEYWORD.NAME: SOLUTE_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Radius of the solute molecule for prevention of coordinate collision during initialization

KEYWORD.NAME: PERIODIC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use periodic boundary conditions for helium

KEYWORD.NAME: CELL_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: PBC unit cell size (NOTE 1: density, number of atoms and volume are interdependent - give only two of them; NOTE 2: for small cell sizes specify NATOMS instead)

KEYWORD.NAME: CELL_SHAPE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: PBC unit cell shape for helium

KEYWORD.NAME: DROPLET_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Reject a move if any of the new positions does not lie within this range from the center of gravity

KEYWORD.NAME: DENSITY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: trial density of helium for determining the helium box size

KEYWORD.NAME: PRESAMPLE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Presample He coordinates before first PIMD step

SECTION.NAME: NNP
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section contains all information to run an helium-solute interaction Neural Network Potential (NNP) calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: NNP_INPUT_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: File containing the input information for the setup of the NNP (n2p2/RuNNer format).

KEYWORD.NAME: SCALE_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: File containing the scaling information for the symmetry functions of the NNP.

SECTION.NAME: SR_CUTOFF
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section for failsafe short range cutoffs for the NNPs, if the distance between solvent and specified solute element becomes smaller than the given cutoff, an artifical repulsive potential is introduced. Note this is only meant to prevent such configurations, not to physically sample them.

KEYWORD.NAME: ELEMENT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Solute element for which the short range cutoff is in effect

KEYWORD.NAME: RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Short range cutoff in Angstrom, below this cutoff, the energy is replaced by a sizable positive value plus a 1/r**2 term to guide particles away from each other.

SECTION.NAME: MODEL
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section for a single NNP model. If this section is repeated, a committee model (C-NNP)is used where the NNP members share the same symmetry functions.

KEYWORD.NAME: WEIGHTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: File containing the weights for the artificial neural networks of the NNP. The specified name is extended by .XXX.data

SECTION.NAME: PRINT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section of possible print options in NNP code.

SECTION.NAME: ENERGIES
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of the NNP energies.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: WORM
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Enables sampling via the canonical worm algorithm adapted from Bonisegni

KEYWORD.NAME: CENTROID_DRMAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum displacement allowed for the centroid moves

KEYWORD.NAME: STAGING_L
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: From 2 up to max. L-1 beads will be moved

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_OPEN_CYCLES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If > 0 then reset positions and permutations to the previous closed state if staying more than this amount of MC cycles in open state to avoid staying trapped in open state for too long. Use with caution as it can potentially introduce a bias in the sampling.

KEYWORD.NAME: CENTROID_WEIGHT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Absolute weight of the centroid move

KEYWORD.NAME: STAGING_WEIGHT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Absolute weight of the staging move

KEYWORD.NAME: OPEN_CLOSE_WEIGHT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Absolute weight of the open/close move

KEYWORD.NAME: HEAD_TAIL_WEIGHT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Absolute weight of the head/tail moves (both)

KEYWORD.NAME: CRAWL_WEIGHT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Absolute weight of the crawl bwd/fwd moves (both)

KEYWORD.NAME: SWAP_WEIGHT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Absolute weight of the crawl move

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether or not to calculate He-He RDFs

KEYWORD.NAME: MIN_CYCLE_LENGTHS_WDG

KEYWORD.NAME: MIN_CYCLE_LENGTHS_NON
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Density of non-winding paths not shorter than the given length

KEYWORD.NAME: MIN_CYCLE_LENGTHS_ALL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Density of all paths not shorter than the given length

ITEM.NAME: NO

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Write the coordinates (no element labels) and the cell information to a binary file

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Like DCD, but the dumped coordinates refer to an aligned cell following the common convention: the cell vector **a** is aligned with the *x* axis and the cell vector **b** lies in the *xy* plane. This allows the reconstruction of scaled coordinates from the DCD data only.

KEYWORD.NAME: CHARGE_EXTENDED

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Write the atom kind given in the subsys section instead of the element symbol. Only valid for the XMOL format.

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Full potential (no projections in a subspace of colvars)

ITEM.NAME: FE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Free energy (requires a projections in a subspace of colvars)

ITEM.NAME: ME
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Minimum energy (requires a projections in a subspace of colvars)

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the type of potential used in the BAND calculation

KEYWORD.NAME: ROTATE_FRAMES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Compute at each BAND step the RMSD and rotate the frames in order to minimize it.

KEYWORD.NAME: ALIGN_FRAMES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Enables the alignment of the frames at the beginning of a BAND calculation. This keyword does not affect the rotation of the replicas during a BAND calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: K_SPRING
K
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the value of the spring constant

SECTION.NAME: CONVERGENCE_CONTROL
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Setup parameters to control the convergence criteria for BAND

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_DR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tolerance on the maximum value of the displacement on the BAND.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_FORCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tolerance on the maximum value of Forces on the BAND.

KEYWORD.NAME: RMS_DR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tolerance on RMS displacements on the BAND.

KEYWORD.NAME: RMS_FORCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tolerance on RMS Forces on the BAND.

SECTION.NAME: CI_NEB
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls parameters for CI-NEB type calculation only.

KEYWORD.NAME: NSTEPS_IT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the number of steps of IT-NEB to perform before switching on the CI algorithm

SECTION.NAME: STRING_METHOD
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls parameters for String Method type calculation only.

KEYWORD.NAME: SPLINE_ORDER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the oder of the spline used in the String Method.

KEYWORD.NAME: SMOOTHING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Smoothing parameter for the reparametrization of the frames.

SECTION.NAME: OPTIMIZE_BAND
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Specify the optimization method for the band

KEYWORD.NAME: OPT_TYPE

ITEM.NAME: MD
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Molecular dynamics-based optimizer

ITEM.NAME: DIIS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Coupled steepest descent / direct inversion in the iterative subspace

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the type optimizer used for the band

KEYWORD.NAME: OPTIMIZE_END_POINTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Performs also an optimization of the end points of the band.

SECTION.NAME: MD
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Activate the MD based optimization procedure for BAND

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_STEPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the maximum number of MD steps

KEYWORD.NAME: TIMESTEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The length of an integration step

SECTION.NAME: TEMP_CONTROL
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Setup parameters to control the temperature during a BAND MD run.

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMP_TOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the tolerance on the temperature for rescaling

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMP_TOL_STEPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the number of steps to apply a temperature control

SECTION.NAME: VEL_CONTROL
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Setup parameters to control the velocity during a BAND MD run.

KEYWORD.NAME: PROJ_VELOCITY_VERLET
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Uses a Projected Velocity Verlet instead of a normal Velocity Verlet. Every time the cosine between velocities and forces is < 0 velocities are zeroed.

KEYWORD.NAME: SD_LIKE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Zeros velocity at each MD step emulating a steepest descent like (SD_LIKE) approach

SECTION.NAME: DIIS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Activate the DIIS based optimization procedure for BAND

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_SD_STEPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the maximum number of SD steps to perform before switching on DIIS (the minimum number will always be equal to N_DIIS).

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_STEPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the maximum number of optimization steps

KEYWORD.NAME: N_DIIS
NDIIS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of history vectors to be used with DIIS

KEYWORD.NAME: STEPSIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial stepsize used for the line search, sometimes this parameter can be reduced to stabilize DIIS

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_STEPSIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum stepsize used for the line search, sometimes this parameter can be reduced to stabilize the LS for particularly difficult initial geometries

KEYWORD.NAME: NP_LS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of points used in the line search SD.

KEYWORD.NAME: NO_LS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Does not perform LS during SD. Useful in combination with a proper STEPSIZE for particularly out of equilibrium starting geometries.

KEYWORD.NAME: CHECK_DIIS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Performs a series of checks on the DIIS solution in order to accept the DIIS step. If set to .FALSE. the only check performed is that the angle between the DIIS solution and the reference vector is less than Pi/2. Can be useful if many DIIS steps are rejected.

SECTION.NAME: DIIS_INFO
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of DIIS info during a BAND run

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: PRINT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing properties during an MD/Optimization run

KEYWORD.NAME: MEMORY_INFO
MEMORY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether overall memory usage should be sampled and printed at each MD/Optimization step.

SECTION.NAME: TRAJECTORY
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the output of the trajectory

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

KEYWORD.NAME: UNIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the unit of measurement for the quantity in output. All available CP2K units can be used.

KEYWORD.NAME: FORMAT

ITEM.NAME: ATOMIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Write only the coordinates X,Y,Z without element symbols to a formatted file

ITEM.NAME: DCD
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Write the coordinates (no element labels) and the cell information to a binary file

ITEM.NAME: DCD_ALIGNED_CELL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Like DCD, but the dumped coordinates refer to an aligned cell following the common convention: the cell vector **a** is aligned with the *x* axis and the cell vector **b** lies in the *xy* plane. This allows the reconstruction of scaled coordinates from the DCD data only.

ITEM.NAME: PDB
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Write the atomic information in PDB format to a formatted file

ITEM.NAME: XMOL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mostly known as XYZ format, provides in a formatted file: element_symbol X Y Z

ITEM.NAME: XYZ
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Alias name for XMOL

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the format of the output file for the trajectory.

KEYWORD.NAME: CHARGE_OCCUP
CHARGE_O
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Write the MM charges to the OCCUP field of the PDB file

KEYWORD.NAME: CHARGE_BETA
CHARGE_B
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Write the MM charges to the BETA field of the PDB file

KEYWORD.NAME: CHARGE_EXTENDED
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Write the MM charges to the very last field of the PDB file (starting from column 81)

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_ATOM_KIND
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Write the atom kind given in the subsys section instead of the element symbol. Only valid for the XMOL format.

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: VELOCITIES
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the output of the velocities. The default unit for velocities is bohr/au_time. The au_time is derived from the hbar value (1.054e-34 J*sec) and the value of the hartree unit of energy (27.21 eV or 4.359e-18 J) as hbar/Ehartree = 2.42e-17 sec = 0.0242 fs. Having an atom with a mass m in AMU the kinetic energy 1/2mv^2 will be obtained in Hartree (i.e. au) multiplying by 911.447 .

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

KEYWORD.NAME: UNIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the unit of measurement for the quantity in output. All available CP2K units can be used.

KEYWORD.NAME: FORMAT

ITEM.NAME: ATOMIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Write only the coordinates X,Y,Z without element symbols to a formatted file

ITEM.NAME: DCD
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Write the coordinates (no element labels) and the cell information to a binary file

ITEM.NAME: XMOL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mostly known as XYZ format, provides in a formatted file: element_symbol X Y Z

ITEM.NAME: XYZ
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Alias name for XMOL

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the format of the output file for the forces on cores.

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_ATOM_KIND
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Write the atom kind given in the subsys section instead of the element symbol. Only valid for the XMOL format.

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: MIXED
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section contains all information to run with a hamiltonian defined by a mixing of force_evals

KEYWORD.NAME: MIXING_TYPE

ITEM.NAME: LINEAR_COMBINATION
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Linear combination of force envs (support only 2 force_evals)

ITEM.NAME: MINIMUM
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use the force env with the minimum energy (support only 2 force_evals)

ITEM.NAME: COUPLED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Consider the force envs as a two state system with a given coupling matrix element (support only 2 force_evals)

ITEM.NAME: RESTRAINT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use the difference between the energy of the force envs as a restraint on the first (support only 2 force_evals)

ITEM.NAME: GENMIX
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Defines a user-driven generica coupling (support for an unlimited number of force_eval)

ITEM.NAME: MIXED_CDFT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Consider each force env as a CDFT state (supports an unlimited number of force_eval for calculation of CDFT properties, but only two states can be mixed for forces).

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The type of mixing to be employed

KEYWORD.NAME: GROUP_PARTITION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: gives the exact number of processors for each group. If not specified processors allocated will be equally distributed for the specified subforce_eval, trying to build a number of groups equal to the number of subforce_eval specified.

KEYWORD.NAME: NGROUPS
NGROUP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Gives the wanted number of groups. If not specified the number of groups is set to the number of subforce_eval defined.

SECTION.NAME: LINEAR
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Linear combination between two force_eval: F= lambda F1 + (1-lambda) F2

KEYWORD.NAME: LAMBDA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the mixing parameter lambda in the formula.

SECTION.NAME: MIXED_CDFT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Calculate properties involving multiple constrained states. Each repetition of the FORCE_EVAL section defines a new CDFT state that is included in the simulation. The DFT&QS&CDFT section must be active in each FORCE_EVAL and it must be consistently defined. When the keyword MIXED&NGROUPS is set to a value 2 or larger, the CDFT states are solved in parallel, whereas when it is set to 1, the states are solved in serial. During MD, the system can be translated using only two of the CDFT states, which are selected with the keyword FORCE_STATES. The forces are determined by the linear combination F= lambda F1 + (1-lambda) F2.

KEYWORD.NAME: LAMBDA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the mixing parameter lambda in the formula.

KEYWORD.NAME: FORCE_STATES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the CDFT states used to translate the system.

KEYWORD.NAME: COUPLING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Parameter determining how often the CDFT electronic coupling element is calculated. Use a negative number to disable and 0 means every step. By default, the coupling is calculated by rotating the CDFT states to eigenstates of the weight function matrix when a single constraint is active and the constraint definitions are identical in both CDFT states. Otherwise uses Lowdin orthogonalization. For more than two CDFT states, the couplings are not computed pairwise and the values might deviate from values computed separately for each unique CDFT state pair.

KEYWORD.NAME: PARALLEL_BUILD
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Build CDFT weight function and gradients in parallel on all N MPI processors before starting the CDFT SCF calculations of the 2 involved CDFT states in parallel on N/2 processors. Supports only Becke constraints that are identical in both states. Limited to 1 charge constraint per state (different target values). The keyword MIXED&NGROUPS must be set to 2.

KEYWORD.NAME: DLB
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Controls the activation of dynamic load balancing during a mixed CDFT calculation. Requires Gaussian cavity confinement. Works only in conjunction with keyword PARALLEL_BUILD.

KEYWORD.NAME: METRIC
COUPLING_METRIC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Compute reliability metric for the CDFT electronic coupling element by diagonalizing the difference density matrix.

KEYWORD.NAME: WFN_OVERLAP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Compute the CDFT electronic coupling element using the wavefunction overlap method in addition to the standard method defined by the keyword COUPLING. In this method, the unconstrained KS ground state wavefunction (WFN_RESTART_FILE_NAME) is represented as a linear combination of the CDFT states. For more than two CDFT states, the coupling is computed pairwise for every state pair (contrary to other coupling methods).

KEYWORD.NAME: LOWDIN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Compute the CDFT electronic coupling element using Lowdin orthogonalization. This is the default behavior with multiple constraints and nonidentical constraints. By activating this keyword, this method is also used to compute the coupling when a single constraint is active in addition to the standard method.

KEYWORD.NAME: CI
CONFIGURATION_INTERACTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Perform a CDFT configuration interaction calculation (CDFT-CI). The CI vector is expanded in the basis of the CDFT states. Diagonalizes the nonorthogonal diabatic CDFT Hamiltonian. The energies and expansion coefficients of the CDFT-CI states are outputted. Keyword COUPLING must be active to use this feature.

KEYWORD.NAME: NONORTHOGONAL_COUPLING
NONORTHO_COUPLING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Print out the nonorthogonal diabatic CDFT coupling between states, as it appears in the mixed CDFT Hamiltonian before orthogonalization (coupling calculations) and CDFT-CI. Useful for (re)constructing the Hamiltonian for additional analysis. This is the CDFT interaction energy between states.

KEYWORD.NAME: SCALE_WITH_OCCUPATION_NUMBERS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scale molecular orbitals with occupation numbers before calculating the electronic coupling. Affects only simulations which employ MO smearing. Disabling this keyword in conjunction with a properly selected EPS_OCCUPIED threshold might be useful in systems with a large number of fractionally occupied orbitals.

KEYWORD.NAME: WFN_RESTART_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the wavefunction restart file that defines the unconstrained KS ground state, which is used to compute the electronic coupling with the wavefunction overlap method. May include a path.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_SVD
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines the matrix inversion solver needed to compute the coupling. Default value implies LU decomposition, while values between 0.0 and 1.0 imply SVD decomposition. For SVD, the value acts as a threshold for screening singular values so that only values above it are included in the matrix pseudoinverse.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_OCCUPIED
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Threshold for determining which molecular orbitals are considered occupied when fractional and/or empty orbitals are employed. Can and usually should be less than the threshold EPS_FERMI_DIRAC defined in section SCF&SMEAR. Note that the number occupied MOs should be constant in each CDFT state, since the CDFT coupling is only defined between states in the same spin state. Fractionally occupied MOs might exhibit linear dependencies and a singular value decomposition (EPS_SVD) can be used for removing these.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOAD_SCALE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Control parameter for dynamic load balancing during a mixed CDFT calculation. See code for details. Works only in conjunction with keyword PARALLEL_BUILD.

KEYWORD.NAME: MORE_WORK
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Control parameter for dynamic load balancing during a mixed CDFT calculation. See code for details. Works only in conjunction with keyword PARALLEL_BUILD.

KEYWORD.NAME: VERY_OVERLOADED
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Control parameter for dynamic load balancing during a mixed CDFT calculation. See code for details. Works only in conjunction with keyword PARALLEL_BUILD.

KEYWORD.NAME: BLOCK_DIAGONALIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Block diagonalize the CDFT Hamiltonian. Control settings should be given in section &BLOCK_DIAGONALIZE. All requested electronic couplings are printed out after block diagonalization. When CDFT-CI and block diagonalization are both requested, the CI calculation is performed using the block diagonalized Hamiltonian.

SECTION.NAME: BLOCK_DIAGONALIZE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Control section to setup block diagonalization of the mixed CDFT Hamiltonian. Constructs a new Hamiltonian by diagonalizing the initial matrix within each block and by rotating the off-diagonal blocks (which represent the interactions between different blocks) by the eigenvectors of diagonal blocks.

KEYWORD.NAME: BLOCK
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines which CDFT states are included in a block. Each repetition of this keyword defines a new block. The Hamiltonian matrix elements of the requested states are collected into a new matrix and subsequently diagonalized. The eigenvectors of this matrix are used to rotate the matrix blocks describing the interactions between blocks.

KEYWORD.NAME: IGNORE_EXCITED
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Ignore excited states related to each block when constructing the new mixed CDFT Hamiltonian. This reduces the dimensionality of the Hamiltonian.

KEYWORD.NAME: RECURSIVE_DIAGONALIZATION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Perform block diagonalization recursively until only two blocks remain. For example, if the elements of a 8x8 matrix are first collected into 4 blocks (using keyword BLOCK), this keyword will transform the matrix to a 2x2 matrix (8x8 -> 4x4 -> 2x2). In this example, the blocks of the 2x2 matrix would be assembled from the first and last 2 blocks of the 4x4 matrix.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

KEYWORD.NAME: MO_OVERLAP_MATRIX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of the MO overlap matrices between CDFT states. The matrices are printed out in plain text.

KEYWORD.NAME: MO_OVERLAP_EIGENVALUES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of the eigenvalues/singular values of the CDFT MO overlap matrices. The product of the eigenvalues/singular values is the CDFT MO overlap. Useful mainly for checking which singular values will get screened for a particular EPS_SVD.

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. SECTION.NAME: EACH

Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: WARNING: Experimental feature under development that will help the user to switch parameters to facilitate SCF convergence. SECTION.NAME: OT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the various options for the orbital transformation (OT) method. Default settings already provide an efficient, yet robust method. Most systems benefit from using the FULL_ALL preconditioner combined with a small value (0.001) of ENERGY_GAP. Well-behaved systems might benefit from using a DIIS minimizer.
**Advantages:** It's fast, because no expensive diagonalisation is performed. If preconditioned correctly, method guaranteed to find minimum.
**Disadvantages:** Sensitive to preconditioning. A good preconditioner can be expensive. No smearing, or advanced SCF mixing possible: POOR convergence for metallic systems.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: controls the activation of the ot method

KEYWORD.NAME: ALGORITHM

ITEM.NAME: STRICT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Strict orthogonality: Taylor or diagonalization based algorithm.

ITEM.NAME: IRAC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Orbital Transformation based Iterative Refinement of the Approximative Congruence transformation (OT/IR).

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Algorithm to be used for OT

ITEM.NAME: CHOL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Cholesky.

ITEM.NAME: POLY
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Polynomial.

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Loewdin.
