SECTION.NAME: MEMORY
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Sets up memory parameters for the storage of the ERI's if requested

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_STORAGE_SCALING
EPS_STORAGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scaling factor to scale eps_schwarz. Storage threshold for compression will be EPS_SCHWARZ*EPS_STORAGE_SCALING.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_MEMORY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the maximum amount of memory [MiB] to be consumed by the full HFX module. All temporary buffers and helper arrays are subtracted from this number. What remains will be used for storage of integrals. NOTE: This number is assumed to represent the memory available to one MPI process. When running a threaded version, cp2k automatically takes care of distributing the memory among all the threads within a process.

KEYWORD.NAME: STORAGE_LOCATION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Loaction where ERI's are stored if MAX_DISK_SPACE /=0 Expects a path to a directory.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_DISK_SPACE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the maximum amount of disk space [MiB] used to store precomputed compressed four-center integrals. If 0, nothing is stored to disk

KEYWORD.NAME: TREAT_FORCES_IN_CORE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines whether the derivative ERI's should be stored to RAM or not. Only meaningful when performing Ehrenfest MD. Memory usage is defined via MAX_MEMORY, i.e. the memory is shared wit the energy ERI's.

SECTION.NAME: RI
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for RI method in HFX (experimental, forces not yet implemented).

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Filter threshold for DBCSR tensor contraction.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER_2C
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Filter threshold for 2c integrals. Default should be kept.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_STORAGE_SCALING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scaling factor to scale EPS_FILTER for storage of 3-center integrals. Storage threshold will be EPS_FILTER*EPS_STORAGE_SCALING.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER_MO
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Filter threshold for contraction of 3-center integrals with MOs. Default should be kept.

KEYWORD.NAME: OMEGA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The range parameter for the short range operator (in 1/a0). Default is OMEGA from INTERACTION_POTENTIAL.

KEYWORD.NAME: CUTOFF_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The cutoff radius (in Angstroms) for the truncated Coulomb operator. Default is CUTOFF_RADIUS from INTERACTION_POTENTIAL.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_NGROUPS
NGROUPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The number of MPI subgroup that work in parallel during the SCF. The default value is 1. Using N subgroups should speed up the calculation by a factor ~N, at the cost of N times more memory usage.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_USE_DELTA_P
USE_DELTA_P
KP_USE_P_DIFF
USE_P_DIFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This kweyword controls whether the KS matrix at each SCF cycle is built by adding the contribution of the denisty difference (wrt to previous step) to the KS matrix of the previous step. As the SCF converges, the density fluctuations get smaller and sparsity increases, leading to faster SCF steps. Not always numerically stable => turn off if SCF struggles to converge.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_STACK_SIZE
STACK_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: When doing contraction over periodic cells of the type: T_mu^a,nu^b,P^c = (mu^a nu^b | Q^d) * (Q^d | P^c), with a,b,c,d labeling cells, there are in principle Ncells contractions taking place. Because a smaller number of contractions involving larger tensors is more efficient, the tensors can be stacked along the d direction. STCK_SIZE controls the size of this stack. Larger stacks are more efficient, but required more memory.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_RI_EXTENSION_FACTOR
RI_EXTENSION_FACTOR
RI_EXT
RI_EXT_FACT
KP_RI_EXT
KP_RI_EXT_FACT
KP_RI_BASIS_EXT
RI_BASIS_EXT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: In KP-RI-HFX, each atom has its own local RI basis. The RI basis is defined by a sphere of radius R centered on the atom, whereby all neighboring atoms within that sphere contribute their RI basis elements. The radius of that sphere is calculated based on the systems' most diffuse orbital PGF (with exponant alpha), such that EPS_PGF_ORB * KP_RI_EXTENSION_FACTOR = exp(-alpha*R^2). The default value of 1.0 is safe. More accurate results can be obtained with a value < 1.0, at greated computational cost.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_RI_BUMP_FACTOR
RI_BUMP
BUMP
BUMP_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: In KP-RI-HFX, the extended RI basis set has a bump radius. All basis elements within that radius contribute with full weight. All basis elements beyond that radius have decaying weight, from 1 at the bump radius, to zero at the RI extension radius. The bump radius is calculated as a fraction of the RI extension radius: bump radius = KP_RI_NUMP_FACTOR * RI extension radius

KEYWORD.NAME: RI_METRIC

ITEM.NAME: HFX
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Same as HFX operator

ITEM.NAME: COULOMB
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Standard Coulomb operator: 1/r

ITEM.NAME: IDENTITY
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Overlap

ITEM.NAME: TRUNCATED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Truncated Coulomb operator: 1/r if (r<R_c), 0 otherwise

ITEM.NAME: SHORTRANGE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Short range: erfc(omega*r)/r

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The type of RI operator. Default is POTENTIAL_TYPE from INTERACTION_POTENTIAL. The standard Coulomb operator cannot be used in periodic systems.

KEYWORD.NAME: 2C_MATRIX_FUNCTIONS

ITEM.NAME: DIAG
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Diagonalization with eigenvalue quenching: stable

ITEM.NAME: CHOLESKY
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Cholesky: not stable in case of ill-conditioned RI basis

ITEM.NAME: ITER
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Iterative algorithms: linear scaling Hotelling's method for inverse and Newton-Schulz iteration for matrix square root

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Methods for matrix inverse and matrix square root.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_EIGVAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Throw away linear combinations of RI basis functions with a small eigenvalue, this is applied only if 2C_MATRIX_FUNCTIONS DIAG

KEYWORD.NAME: CHECK_2C_MATRIX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Report accuracy for the inverse/sqrt of the 2-center integral matrix.

KEYWORD.NAME: CALC_COND_NUM
CALC_CONDITION_NUMBER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Calculate the condition number of integral matrices.

KEYWORD.NAME: SQRT_ORDER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Order of the iteration method for the calculation of the sqrt of 2-center integral matrix.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_PGF_ORB
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets precision of the integral tensors.

KEYWORD.NAME: RI_FLAVOR

ITEM.NAME: MO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: with MO coefficients

ITEM.NAME: RHO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: with density matrix

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Flavor of RI: how to contract 3-center integrals

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_BLOCK_SIZE_MO
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum tensor block size for MOs.

KEYWORD.NAME: MEMORY_CUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Memory reduction factor. This keyword controls the batching of tensor contractions into smaller, more manageable chunks. The details vary depending on the RI_FLAVOR.

KEYWORD.NAME: FLAVOR_SWITCH_MEMORY_CUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Memory reduction factor to be applied upon RI_FLAVOR switching from MO to RHO. The RHO flavor typically requires more memory, and depending on the ressources available, a higher MEMORY_CUT.

KEYWORD.NAME: PINT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Path integral md steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: METADYNAMICS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the METADYNAMICS steps (number of hills added).

KEYWORD.NAME: GEO_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Geometry optimization steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: ROT_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Rotational optimization steps in the Dimer calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: CELL_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Cell optimization steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: BAND
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the BAND calculation steps

KEYWORD.NAME: EP_LIN_SOLVER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Energy Perturbation (EP) linear solver

KEYWORD.NAME: SPLINE_FIND_COEFFS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the solution of the coefficients of the splines

KEYWORD.NAME: REPLICA_EVAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the evaluation of the Replica Environment

KEYWORD.NAME: BSSE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Basis Set Superposition Error (BSSE) calculation

KEYWORD.NAME: SHELL_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Shell-Core distances optimization steps

KEYWORD.NAME: TDDFT_SCF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory SCF steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: CORR_MOS_OCC
CORR_OCC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of occupied MOs whose energies are corrected by RI-G0W0. Counting beginning from HOMO, e.g. 3 corrected occ. MOs correspond to correction of HOMO, HOMO-1 and HOMO-2. Numerical effort and storage of RI-G0W0 increase linearly with this number. In case you want to correct all occ. MOs, insert a number larger than the number of occ. MOs.

KEYWORD.NAME: CORR_MOS_VIRT
CORR_VIRT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of virtual MOs whose energies are corrected by RI-G0W0. Counting beginning from LUMO, e.g. 3 corrected occ. MOs correspond to correction of LUMO, LUMO+1 and LUMO+2. Numerical effort and storage of RI-G0W0 increase linearly with this number. In case you want to correct all virt. MOs, insert a number larger than the number of virt. MOs.

KEYWORD.NAME: NUMB_POLES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of poles for the fitting. Usually, two poles are sufficient.

KEYWORD.NAME: OMEGA_MAX_FIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines fitting range for the self-energy on the imaginary axis: [0, OMEGA_MAX_FIT] for virt orbitals, [-OMEGA_MAX_FIT,0] for occ orbitals. Unit: Hartree. Default: 0.734996 H = 20 eV.

KEYWORD.NAME: CROSSING_SEARCH

ITEM.NAME: Z_SHOT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Calculate the derivative of Sigma and out of it Z. Then extrapolate using Z.

ITEM.NAME: NEWTON
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Make a Newton-Raphson fix point iteration.

ITEM.NAME: BISECTION
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Make a bisection fix point iteration.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines, how the self_energy is evaluated on the real axis.

KEYWORD.NAME: FERMI_LEVEL_OFFSET
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Fermi level for occ. orbitals: e_HOMO + FERMI_LEVEL_OFFSET; Fermi level for virt. orbitals: e_LUMO - FERMI_LEVEL_OFFSET. In case e_homo + FERMI_LEVEL_OFFSET < e_lumo - FERMI_LEVEL_OFFSET, we set Fermi level = (e_HOMO+e_LUMO)/2. For cubic-scaling GW, the Fermi level is always equal to (e_HOMO+e_LUMO)/2 regardless of FERMI_LEVEL_OFFSET.

KEYWORD.NAME: EV_GW_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of iterations for eigenvalue self-consistency cycle. The computational effort of GW scales linearly with this number.

KEYWORD.NAME: SC_GW0_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of iterations for GW0 self-consistency cycle. The computational effort of GW is not much affected by the number of scGW0 cycles.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Target accuracy for the eigenvalue self-consistency. If the G0W0 HOMO-LUMO gap differs by less than the target accuracy during the iteration, the eigenvalue self-consistency cycle stops. Unit: Hartree.

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_EXX

ITEM.NAME: TRUE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Please, put TRUE for Gamma only calculation to get the exchange self-energy. If 'SIGMA_X' and the corresponding values for the exchange-energy are written, the writing has been successful

ITEM.NAME: FALSE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: FALSE is needed if you want to do nothing here.

ITEM.NAME: READ
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Please, put READ for the k-point GW calculation to read the exact exchange. You have to provide an output file including the exact exchange. This file has to be named 'exx.dat'.

ITEM.NAME: SKIP_FOR_REGTEST
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: SKIP_FOR_REGTEST is only used for the GW k-point regtest where no exchange self-energy is computed.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Print exchange self-energy minus exchange correlation potential for Gamma-only calculation (PRINT). For a GW calculation with k-points we use this output as exchange self-energy (READ). This is a temporary solution because the hybrid MPI/OMP parallelization in the HFX by Manuel Guidon conflicts with the parallelization in low-scaling GW k-points which is most efficient with maximum number of MPI tasks and minimum number of OMP threads. For HFX by M. Guidon, the density matrix is fully replicated on every MPI rank which necessitates a high number of OMP threads per MPI rank for large systems to prevent out of memory. Such a high number of OMP threads would slow down the GW calculation severely. Therefore, it was decided to temporarily divide the GW k-point calculation in a Gamma-only HF calculation with high number of OMP threads to prevent out of memory and a GW k-point calculation with 1 OMP thread per MPI rank reading the previousHF output.

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_SELF_ENERGY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, print the self-energy for all levels for real energy together with the straight line to see the quasiparticle energy as intersection. In addition, prints the self-energy for imaginary frequencies together with the Pade fit.

KEYWORD.NAME: RI_SIGMA_X
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, the exchange self-energy is calculated approximatively with RI. If false, the Hartree-Fock implementation in CP2K is used.

KEYWORD.NAME: IC_CORR_LIST
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: List of image charge correction from a previous calculation to be applied in G0W0 or evGW. Keyword is active, if the first entry is positive (since IC corrections are positive occupied MOs. The start corresponds to the first corrected GW level.

KEYWORD.NAME: IC_CORR_LIST_BETA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: IC_CORR_LIST for beta spins in case of open shell calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: PERIODIC_CORRECTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, the periodic correction scheme is used employing k-points. Method is not recommended to use, use instead PERIODIC_LOW_SCALING which much more accurate than the periodic correction.

KEYWORD.NAME: BSE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, electronic excitation energies are computed from the Bethe-Salpeter equation on top of GW eigenvalues. Parameter of BSE can be adjusted in the corresponding section.

KEYWORD.NAME: IMAGE_CHARGE_MODEL
IC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, an image charge model is applied to mimic the renormalization of electronic levels of a molecule at a metallic surface. For this calculation, the molecule has to be reflected on the desired xy image plane. The coordinates of the reflected molecule have to be added to the coord file as ghost atoms. For the ghost atoms, identical basis sets the normal atoms have to be used.

KEYWORD.NAME: ANALYTIC_CONTINUATION

ITEM.NAME: TWO_POLE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use 'two-pole' model.

ITEM.NAME: PADE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use Pade approximation.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines which type of analytic continuation for the self energy is used

KEYWORD.NAME: NPARAM_PADE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of parameters for the Pade approximation when using the latter for the analytic continuation of the self energy. 16 parameters (corresponding to 8 poles) are are recommended.

KEYWORD.NAME: GAMMA_ONLY_SIGMA
GAMMA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, the correlation self-energy is only computed at the Gamma point. The Gamma point itself is obtained by averaging over all kpoints of the DFT mesh.

KEYWORD.NAME: UPDATE_XC_ENERGY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, the Hartree-Fock and RPA total energy are printed and the total energy is corrected using exact exchange and the RPA correlation energy.

KEYWORD.NAME: KPOINTS_SELF_ENERGY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify number of k-points for the k-point grid of the self-energy. Internally, a Monkhorst-Pack grid is used. A dense k-point grid may be necessary to compute an accurate density of state from GW. Large self-energy k-meshes do not cost much more computation time.

KEYWORD.NAME: REGULARIZATION_MINIMAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tikhonov regularization for computing weights of the Fourier transform from imaginary time to imaginary frequency and vice versa. Needed for large minimax grids with 20 or more points and a small range.

KEYWORD.NAME: SOC

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: No SOC.

ITEM.NAME: LDA
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use parameters from LDA (PADE) pseudopotential.

ITEM.NAME: PBE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use parameters from PBE pseudopotential.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Calculate the spin-orbit splitting of the eigenvalues/band structure using the spin-orbit part of the GTH pseudos parametrized in Hartwigsen, Goedecker, Hutter, Phys. Rev. B 58, 3641 (1998), Eq. 19, parameters in Table I.

KEYWORD.NAME: SOC_ENERGY_WINDOW
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: For perturbative SOC calculation, only take frontier levels in an energy window [E_HOMO - SOC_ENERGY_WINDOW/2 , E_LUMO + SOC_ENERGY_WINDOW/2 into account for the diagonalization of H^GW,SOC.

SECTION.NAME: PERIODIC_CORRECTION
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters influencing correction for periodic GW. Old method, not recommended to use

KEYWORD.NAME: KPOINTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify number of k-points for a single k-point grid. Internally, a Monkhorst-Pack grid is used. Typically, even numbers are chosen such that the Gamma point is excluded from the k-point mesh.

KEYWORD.NAME: NUM_KP_GRIDS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of k-point grids around the Gamma point with different resolution. E.g. for KPOINTS 4 4 4 and NUM_KP_GRIDS 3, there will be a 3x3x3 Monkhorst-Pack (MP) k-point grid for the whole Brillouin zone (excluding Gamma), another 3x3x3 MP grid with smaller spacing around Gamma (again excluding Gamma) and a very fine 4x4x4 MP grid around Gamma.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_KPOINT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the absolute value of a k-point is below EPS_KPOINT, this kpoint is neglected since the Gamma point is not included in the periodic correction.

KEYWORD.NAME: MO_COEFF_GAMMA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, only the MO coefficients at the Gamma point are used for the periodic correction. Otherwise, the MO coeffs are computed at every k-point which is much more expensive. It should be okay to use the Gamma MO coefficients.

KEYWORD.NAME: AVERAGE_DEGENERATE_LEVELS
ADL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, the correlation self-energy of degenerate levels is averaged.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_EIGENVAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Threshold for considering levels as degenerate. Unit: Hartree.

KEYWORD.NAME: EXTRAPOLATE_KPOINTS
EXTRAPOLATE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, extrapolates the k-point mesh. Only working if k-point mesh numbers are divisible by 4, e.g. 8x8x8 or 12x12x12 is recommended.

KEYWORD.NAME: DO_AUX_BAS_GW
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, use a different basis for the periodic correction. This can be necessary in case a diffused basis is used for GW to converge the HOMO-LUMO gap. In this case, numerical problems may occur due to diffuse functions in the basis. This keyword only works if AUX_GW <basis set> is specified in the kind section for every atom kind.

KEYWORD.NAME: FRACTION_AUX_MOS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Fraction how many MOs are used in the auxiliary basis.

KEYWORD.NAME: NUM_OMEGA_POINTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of Clenshaw-Curtis integration points for the periodic correction in cubic- scaling GW. This variable is a dummy variable for canonical N^4 GW calculations.

SECTION.NAME: BSE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters influencing the Bethe-Salpeter calculations on top of GW eigenvalues.

KEYWORD.NAME: NUM_Z_VECTORS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number Z vectors used in the subspace iterations. This is a convergence parameter: Increasing NUM_Z_VECTORS should keep the result constant in case of convergence,.

KEYWORD.NAME: THRESHOLD_MIN_TRANS
EPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Threshold for stopping the iteration for computing the transition energies. If the lowest excitation changes by less than THRESHOLD_MIN_TRANS (in eV), the ieration stops.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of iterations for determining the transition energies.

SECTION.NAME: IC
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters influencing the image charge correction. The image plane is always an xy plane, so adjust the molecule according to that.

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_IC_LIST
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, the image charge correction values are printed in a list, such that it can be used as input for a subsequent evGW calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_DIST
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Threshold where molecule and image molecule have to coincide.

SECTION.NAME: KPOINT_SET
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Specifies a k-point line to be calculated.

KEYWORD.NAME: SPECIAL_POINT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name and coordinates of a special k-point

KEYWORD.NAME: NPOINTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of k-points along the line.

KEYWORD.NAME: UNITS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Special k-points are defined either in units of reciprocal lattice vectors or in Cartesian coordinates in uints of 2Pi/len. B_VECTOR: in multiples of the reciprocal lattice vectors (b). CART_ANGSTROM: In units of 2*Pi/Angstrom. CART_BOHR: In units of 2*Pi/Bohr.

SECTION.NAME: PRINT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section of possible print options specific for the GW code.

SECTION.NAME: LOCAL_BANDGAP
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Prints a local bandgap E_gap(r), derived from the local density of states rho(r,E). Details and formulae in the SI of the periodic GW paper (2023).

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

KEYWORD.NAME: ENERGY_WINDOW
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Energy window in the LDOS for searching the gap.

KEYWORD.NAME: ENERGY_SPACING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Energy spacing of the LDOS for searching the gap.

KEYWORD.NAME: LDOS_THRESHOLD_GAP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Relative LDOS threshold that determines the local bandgap.

KEYWORD.NAME: STRIDE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The stride (X,Y,Z) used to write the cube file (larger values result in smaller cube files). You can provide 3 numbers (for X,Y,Z) or 1 number valid for all components.

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

KEYWORD.NAME: JUST_ENERGY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for an ENERGY/ENERGY_FORCE calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: POWELL_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for POWELL based optimization steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: QS_SCF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the SCF steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: XAS_SCF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the X-Ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS) SCF steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: MD
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the MD steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: PINT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Path integral md steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: METADYNAMICS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the METADYNAMICS steps (number of hills added).

KEYWORD.NAME: GEO_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Geometry optimization steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: ROT_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Rotational optimization steps in the Dimer calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: CELL_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Cell optimization steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: BAND
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the BAND calculation steps

KEYWORD.NAME: EP_LIN_SOLVER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Energy Perturbation (EP) linear solver

KEYWORD.NAME: SPLINE_FIND_COEFFS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the solution of the coefficients of the splines

KEYWORD.NAME: REPLICA_EVAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the evaluation of the Replica Environment

KEYWORD.NAME: BSSE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Basis Set Superposition Error (BSSE) calculation

KEYWORD.NAME: SHELL_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Shell-Core distances optimization steps

KEYWORD.NAME: TDDFT_SCF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory SCF steps.

SECTION.NAME: GW_DOS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section for printing the spectral function.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOWER_BOUND
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Lower bound for GW-DOS in eV.

KEYWORD.NAME: UPPER_BOUND
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Upper bound for GW-DOS in eV.

KEYWORD.NAME: STEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Difference of two consecutive energy levels for GW-DOS.

KEYWORD.NAME: MIN_LEVEL_SELF_ENERGY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Lowest energy level to print the self energy to files.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_LEVEL_SELF_ENERGY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Highest energy level to print the self energy to files.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Putting the &RI_SOS_MP2 section activates RI-SOS-MP2 calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: QUADRATURE_POINTS
LAPLACE_NUM_QUAD_POINTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of quadrature points for the numerical integration in the RI-SOS-MP2-Laplace method.

KEYWORD.NAME: NUM_INTEG_GROUPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of groups for the integration in the Laplace method. Each groups processes the same amount of quadrature points. It must be a divisor of the number of quadrature points and NUM_INTEG_GROUPS*GROUP_SIZE must be a divisor of the total number of processes. The default (-1) is automatic.

SECTION.NAME: LOW_SCALING
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Cubic scaling RI-RPA, GW and Laplace-SOS-MP2 method using the imaginary time formalism. EPS_GRID in WFC_GPW section controls accuracy / req. memory for 3-center integrals. SORT_BASIS EXP should be specified in DFT section.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Activates cubic-scaling RPA, GW and Laplace-SOS-MP2 calculations.

KEYWORD.NAME: MEMORY_CUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Reduces memory for sparse tensor contractions by this factor. A high value leads to some loss of performance. This memory reduction factor applies to storage of the tensors 'M occ' / 'M virt' but does not reduce storage of '3c ints'.

KEYWORD.NAME: MEMORY_INFO
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Decide whether to print memory info on the sparse matrices.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines a threshold for the DBCSR based multiply. Normally, this EPS_FILTER determines accuracy and timing of low-scaling RPA and GW calculations.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Multiply EPS_FILTER with this factor to determine filter epsilon for DBCSR based multiply P(it)=(Mocc(it))^T*Mvirt(it) Default should be kept.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_STORAGE_SCALING
EPS_STORAGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scaling factor to scale EPS_FILTER. Storage threshold for compression will be EPS_FILTER*EPS_STORAGE_SCALING.

KEYWORD.NAME: DO_KPOINTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Besides in DFT, this keyword has to be switched on if one wants to do kpoints in. cubic RPA.

KEYWORD.NAME: KPOINTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Keyword activates periodic, low-scaling GW calculations (&LOW_SCALING section also needed). For periodic calculations, kpoints are used for the density response, the Coulomb interaction and the screened Coulomb interaction. For 2d periodic systems, e.g. xz periodicity, please also specify KPOINTS, e.g. N_x 1 N_z.

KEYWORD.NAME: KPOINT_WEIGHTS_W

ITEM.NAME: TAILORED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Choose k-point integration weights such that the function f(k)=k^alpha is exactly integrated. alpha is specified using EXPONENT_TAILORED_WEIGHTS.

ITEM.NAME: AUTO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: As 'TAILORED', but alpha is chosen automatically according to dimensionality (3D: alpha = -2 for 3D, 2D: alpha = -1 for exchange self-energy, uniform weights for correlation self-energy).

ITEM.NAME: UNIFORM
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Choose the same weight for every k-point (original Monkhorst-Pack method).

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: For kpoints in low-scaling GW, a Monkhorst-Pack mesh is used. The screened Coulomb interaction W(k) needs special care near the Gamma point (e.g. in 3d, W(k) diverges at the Gamma point with W(k) ~ k^alpha). KPOINT_WEIGHTS_W decides how the weights of the Monkhorst-Pack mesh are chosen to compute W(R) = int_BZ W(k) exp(ikR) dk (BZ=Brllouin zone).

KEYWORD.NAME: EXPONENT_TAILORED_WEIGHTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Gives the exponent of exactly integrated function in case 'KPOINT_WEIGHTS_W TAILORED' is chosen.

KEYWORD.NAME: REGULARIZATION_RI
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Parameter to reduce the expansion coefficients in RI for periodic GW. Larger parameter means smaller expansion coefficients that leads to a more stable calculation at the price of a slightly worse RI approximation. In case the parameter 0.0 is chosen, ordinary RI is used.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_EIGVAL_S
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Parameter to reduce the expansion coefficients in RI for periodic GW. Removes all eigenvectors and eigenvalues of S_PQ(k) that are smaller than EPS_EIGVAL_S.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_EIGVAL_S_GAMMA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Parameter to reduce the expansion coefficients in RI for periodic GW. Removes all eigenvectors and eigenvalues of M_PQ(k=0) that are smaller than EPS_EIGVAL_S.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAKE_CHI_POS_DEFINITE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, makes eigenvalue decomposition of chi(iw,k) and removes negative eigenvalues. May increase computational cost significantly. Only recommended to try in case Cholesky decomposition of epsilon(iw,k) fails.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAKE_OVERLAP_MAT_AO_POS_DEFINITE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, makes eigenvalue decomposition of S_mu,nu(k) and removes negative eigenvalues. Slightly increases computational cost. Only recommended to try in case Cholesky decomposition of S_mu,nu(k) fails (error message: Cholesky decompose failed: matrix is not positive definite or ill-conditioned; when calling create_kp_and_calc_kp_orbitals).

KEYWORD.NAME: DO_EXTRAPOLATE_KPOINTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, use a larger k-mesh to extrapolate the k-point integration of W. For example, in 2D, when using KPOINTS 4 4 1, an additional 6x6x1 mesh will be used to extrapolate the k-point integration of W with N_k^-0.5, where Nk is the number of k-points.

KEYWORD.NAME: TRUNC_COULOMB_RI_X
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, use the truncated Coulomb operator for the exchange-self-energy in periodic GW.

KEYWORD.NAME: REL_CUTOFF_TRUNC_COULOMB_RI_X
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Only active in case TRUNC_COULOMB_RI_X = True. Normally, relative cutoff = 0.5 is good choice; still needs to be evaluated for RI schemes.

KEYWORD.NAME: KEEP_QUADRATURE
KEEP_WEIGHTS
KEEP_QUAD
KEEP_WEIGHT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Keep the Laplace quadrature defined at the first energy evaluations throughout the run. Allows to have consistent force evaluations.

KEYWORD.NAME: K_MESH_G_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The k-mesh for the Green's function can be chosen to be larger than the k-mesh for W (without much higher computational cost). The factor given here multiplies the mesh for W to obtain the k-mesh for G. Example: factor 4, k-mesh for W: 4x4x1 -> k-mesh for G: 16x16x1 (z-dir. is non-periodic).

KEYWORD.NAME: MIN_BLOCK_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Minimum tensor block size. Adjusting this value may have minor effect on performance but default should be good enough.

KEYWORD.NAME: MIN_BLOCK_SIZE_MO
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Tensor block size for MOs. Only relevant for GW calculations. The memory consumption of GW scales as O(MIN_BLOCK_SIZE_MO). It is recommended to set this parameter to a smaller number if GW runs out of memory. Otherwise the default should not be changed.

SECTION.NAME: CPHF
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters influencing the solution of the Z-vector equations in low-scaling Laplace-SOS-MP2 gradients calculations.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_CONV
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Target accuracy for Z-vector euation solution.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of conjugate gradient iteration to be performed for one optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: PRECONDITIONER

ITEM.NAME: FULL_ALL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Most effective state selective preconditioner based on diagonalization, requires the ENERGY_GAP parameter to be an underestimate of the HOMO-LUMO gap. This preconditioner is recommended for almost all systems, except very large systems where make_preconditioner would dominate the total computational cost.

ITEM.NAME: FULL_SINGLE_INVERSE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Based on H-eS cholesky inversion, similar to FULL_SINGLE in preconditioning efficiency but cheaper to construct, might be somewhat less robust. Recommended for large systems.

ITEM.NAME: FULL_SINGLE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Based on H-eS diagonalisation, not as good as FULL_ALL, but somewhat cheaper to apply.

ITEM.NAME: FULL_KINETIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Cholesky inversion of S and T, fast construction, robust, and relatively good, use for very large systems.

ITEM.NAME: FULL_S_INVERSE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Cholesky inversion of S, not as good as FULL_KINETIC, yet equally expensive.

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: skip preconditioning

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Type of preconditioner to be used with all minimization schemes. They differ in effectiveness, cost of construction, cost of application. Properly preconditioned minimization can be orders of magnitude faster than doing nothing.

SECTION.NAME: RI
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters influencing resolution of the identity (RI) that is used in RI-MP2, RI-RPA, RI-SOS-MP2 and GW (inside RI-RPA).

KEYWORD.NAME: ROW_BLOCK
ROW_BLOCK_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Size of the row block used in the SCALAPACK block cyclic data distribution. Default is (ROW_BLOCK=-1) is automatic. A proper choice can speedup the parallel matrix multiplication in the case of RI-RPA and RI-SOS-MP2-Laplace.

KEYWORD.NAME: COL_BLOCK
COL_BLOCK_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Size of the column block used in the SCALAPACK block cyclic data distribution. Default is (COL_BLOCK=-1) is automatic. A proper choice can speedup the parallel matrix multiplication in the case of RI-RPA and RI-SOS-MP2-Laplace.

KEYWORD.NAME: CALC_COND_NUM
CALC_CONDITION_NUMBER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Calculate the condition number of the (P|Q) matrix for the RI methods.

KEYWORD.NAME: DO_SVD
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Wether to perform a singular value decomposition instead of the Cholesky decomposition of the potential operator in the RI basis. Computationally expensive but numerically more stable. It reduces the computational costs of some subsequent steps. Recommended when a longrange Coulomb potential is employed.

KEYWORD.NAME: ERI_BLKSIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: block sizes for tensors (only used if ERI_METHOD=MME). First value is the block size for ORB basis, second value is the block size for RI_AUX basis.

KEYWORD.NAME: POTENTIAL_TYPE

ITEM.NAME: DEFAULT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use Coulomb metric for RI-MP2 and normal-scaling RI-SOS-MP2, RI-RPA and GW. Use Overlap metric for low-scaling RI-SOS-MP2, RI-RPA and GW for periodic systems. Use truncated Coulomb metric for low-scaling RI-SOS-MP2, RI-RPA and GW for non-periodic systems.

ITEM.NAME: COULOMB
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Coulomb metric: 1/r. Recommended for RI-MP2,

ITEM.NAME: IDENTITY
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Overlap metric: delta(r).

ITEM.NAME: LONGRANGE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Longrange metric: erf(omega*r)/r. Not recommended with DO_SVD .TRUE.

ITEM.NAME: SHORTRANGE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Shortrange metric: erfc(omega*r)/r

ITEM.NAME: TRUNCATED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Truncated Coulomb metric: if (r < R_c) 1/r else 0. More accurate than IDENTITY for non-periodic systems. Recommended for low-scaling methods.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Decides which operator/metric is used for resolution of the identity (RI).

KEYWORD.NAME: OMEGA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The range parameter for the short/long range operator (in 1/a0).

KEYWORD.NAME: CUTOFF_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The cutoff radius (in Angstrom) for the truncated Coulomb operator.

KEYWORD.NAME: T_C_G_DATA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Location of the file t_c_g.dat that contains the data for the evaluation of the truncated gamma function

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_RANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The threshold to determine the effective range of the short range RI metric: erfc(omega*eff_range)/eff_range = EPS_RANGE

SECTION.NAME: OPT_RI_BASIS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters influencing the optimization of the RI MP2 basis. Only exponents of non-contracted auxiliary basis can be optimized. An initial RI auxiliary basis has to be specified.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Putting the &OPT_RI_BASIS section activates optimization of RI basis.

KEYWORD.NAME: DELTA_I_REL
DI_REL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Target accuracy in the relative deviation of the amplitudes calculated with and without RI approximation, (more details in Chem.Phys.Lett.294(1998)143).

KEYWORD.NAME: DELTA_RI
DRI
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Target accuracy in the absolute difference between the RI-MP2 and the exact MP2 energy, DRI=ABS(E_MP2-E_RI-MP2).

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_DERIV
EPS_NUM_DERIV
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The derivatives of the MP2 energy with respect to the exponents of the basis are calculated numerically. The change in the exponent a_i employed for the numerical evaluation is defined as h_i=EPS_DERIV*a_i.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ITER
MAX_NUM_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the maximum number of steps in the RI basis optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: NUM_FUNC
KEYWORD.USAGE: NUM_FUNC {number of s func.} {number of p func.} ...
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the number of function, for each angular momentum (s, p, d ...), employed in the automatically generated initial guess. This will be effective only if RI_AUX_BASIS_SET in the KIND section is not specified.

KEYWORD.NAME: BASIS_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the size of the auxiliary basis set automatically generated as initial guess. This will be effective only if RI_AUX_BASIS_SET in the KIND section and NUM_FUNC are not specified.

SECTION.NAME: INTEGRALS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters controlling how to compute integrals that are needed in MP2, RI-MP2, RI-RPA, RI-SOS-MP2 and GW (inside RI-RPA).

KEYWORD.NAME: ERI_METHOD

ITEM.NAME: DEFAULT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use default ERI method (for periodic systems: GPW, for molecules: OS, for MP2 and RI-MP2: GPW in any case).

ITEM.NAME: GPW
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Uses Gaussian Plane Wave method [DelBen2013].

ITEM.NAME: MME
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Uses MiniMax-Ewald method (experimental, ERI_MME subsection, only for fully periodic systems with orthorhombic cells).

ITEM.NAME: OS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use analytical Obara-Saika method.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Method for calculating periodic electron repulsion integrals (MME method is faster but experimental, forces not yet implemented). Obara-Saika (OS) for the Coulomb operator can only be used for non-periodic calculations.

SECTION.NAME: ERI_MME
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for the calculation of periodic electron repulsion integrals (ERI) using the Minimax-Ewald (MME) method. Note: N_MINIMAX is the only parameter to be tuned for accuracy, all other parameters can be left to default. MME method is faster than numerical GPW.

KEYWORD.NAME: N_MINIMAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of terms in minimax approximation of reciprocal space potential.

KEYWORD.NAME: CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: User-defined energy cutoff to be used only if DO_CALIBRATE_CUTOFF is set to .FALSE.

KEYWORD.NAME: SUM_PRECISION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Terms in lattice sums are ignored if absolute value smaller than this value.

KEYWORD.NAME: DO_CALIBRATE_CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether the energy cutoff shall be calibrated to minimize upper bound error estimate.

KEYWORD.NAME: DO_ERROR_ESTIMATE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether the error due to minimax approx. and cutoff shall be estimated

KEYWORD.NAME: DEBUG
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: debug mode (consistency of summation methods is checked).

KEYWORD.NAME: DEBUG_TOLERANCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: tolerance for rel. numerical error in debug mode.

KEYWORD.NAME: DEBUG_NSUM_MAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: restrict debug mode for non-ortho cells to this number of summands. Sums with more terms are not checked.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

KEYWORD.NAME: JUST_ENERGY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for an ENERGY/ENERGY_FORCE calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: POWELL_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for POWELL based optimization steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: QS_SCF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the SCF steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: XAS_SCF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the X-Ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS) SCF steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: MD
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the MD steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: PINT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Path integral md steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: METADYNAMICS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the METADYNAMICS steps (number of hills added).

KEYWORD.NAME: GEO_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Geometry optimization steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: ROT_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Rotational optimization steps in the Dimer calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: CELL_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Cell optimization steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: BAND
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the BAND calculation steps

KEYWORD.NAME: EP_LIN_SOLVER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Energy Perturbation (EP) linear solver

KEYWORD.NAME: SPLINE_FIND_COEFFS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the solution of the coefficients of the splines

KEYWORD.NAME: REPLICA_EVAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the evaluation of the Replica Environment

KEYWORD.NAME: BSSE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Basis Set Superposition Error (BSSE) calculation

KEYWORD.NAME: SHELL_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Shell-Core distances optimization steps

KEYWORD.NAME: TDDFT_SCF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory SCF steps.

SECTION.NAME: CUTOFF_CALIB
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for the calibration of the energy cutoff by minimizing the errors due to finite cutoff and minimax approximation. Implemented as bisection of error(minimax) - error(cutoff). Not implemented for non-orthorhombic cells.

KEYWORD.NAME: MIN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial guess of lower bound for cutoff.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial guess of upper bound for cutoff.

KEYWORD.NAME: DELTA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Relative widening of cutoff interval in case starting values are not valid.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Relative cutoff precision required to stop calibration.

SECTION.NAME: WFC_GPW
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for the GPW approach in Wavefunction-based Correlation methods

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_GRID
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines a threshold for the GPW based integration

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines a threshold for the DBCSR based multiply (usually 10 times smaller than EPS_GRID). Normally, this EPS_FILTER determines accuracy and timing of cubic-scaling RPA calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The cutoff of the finest grid level in the MP2 gpw integration.

KEYWORD.NAME: REL_CUTOFF
RELATIVE_CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines the grid at which a Gaussian is mapped.

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_LEVEL
IOLEVEL

ITEM.NAME: SILENT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Almost no output

ITEM.NAME: LOW
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Little output

ITEM.NAME: MEDIUM
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Quite some output

ITEM.NAME: HIGH
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Lots of output

ITEM.NAME: DEBUG
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Everything is written out, useful for debugging purposes only

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How much output is written by the individual groups.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_PGF_ORB_S
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Screening for overlap matrix in RI. Usually, it is best to choose this parameter to be very small since the inversion of overlap matrix might be ill-conditioned.

SECTION.NAME: INTERACTION_POTENTIAL
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters the interaction potential in computing the biel integrals

KEYWORD.NAME: POTENTIAL_TYPE

ITEM.NAME: COULOMB
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Coulomb potential: 1/r

ITEM.NAME: LONGRANGE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Longrange Coulomb potential: $ \operatorname{erf}(wr)/r $

ITEM.NAME: SHORTRANGE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Shortrange Coulomb potential: $ \operatorname{erfc}(wr)/r $

ITEM.NAME: TRUNCATED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Truncated Coulomb potential

ITEM.NAME: MIX_CL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mixed Coulomb/Longrange Coulomb potential

ITEM.NAME: IDENTITY
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Delta potential

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Which interaction potential should be used (Coulomb, TShPSC operator).

KEYWORD.NAME: TRUNCATION_RADIUS
CUTOFF_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines truncation radius for the truncated potentials. Only valid when doing truncated calculations

KEYWORD.NAME: POTENTIAL_DATA
TSHPSC_DATA
T_C_G_DATA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Location of the file TShPSC.dat or t_c_g.dat that contains the data for the evaluation of the evaluation of the truncated potentials

KEYWORD.NAME: OMEGA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Range separation parameter for the longrange or shortrange potential. Only valid when longrange or shortrange potential is requested.

KEYWORD.NAME: SCALE_COULOMB
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scaling factor of (truncated) Coulomb potential in mixed (truncated) Coulomb/Longrange potential. Only valid when mixed potential is requested.

KEYWORD.NAME: SCALE_LONGRANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scaling factor of longrange Coulomb potential in mixed (truncated) Coulomb/Longrange potential. Only valid when mixed potential is requested.

SECTION.NAME: CANONICAL_GRADIENTS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters influencing gradient calculations of canonical RI methods. Ignored if the IM_TIME section is set.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_CANONICAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Threshold under which a given ij or ab pair is considered to be degenerate and its contribution to the density matrix is calculated directly. Ignored in case of energy-only calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: FREE_HFX_BUFFER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Free the buffer containing the 4 center integrals used in the Hartree-Fock exchange calculation. This will be effective only for gradients calculations, since for the energy only case, the buffers are released by default. (Right now debugging only).

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_OLD_GRADIENT_CODE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use the original RI-MP2 gradient code.

KEYWORD.NAME: DOT_PRODUCT_BLKSIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Dot products for the calculation of the RPA/SOS-MP2 density matrices are calculated in batches of the size given by this keyword. Larger block sizes improve the performance but reduce the numerical accuracy. Recommended block sizes are multiples of the number of doubles per cache line (usually 8). Ignored with MP2 gradients. Set it to -1 to prevent blocking.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_PARALLEL_COMM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets the maximum number of parallel communication steps of the non-blocking communication scheme. The number of channels is determined from the available memory. If set to a value smaller than one, CP2K will use all memory for communication. A value of one enforces the blocking communication scheme increasing the communication costs.

SECTION.NAME: CPHF
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters influencing the solution of the Z-vector equations in MP2 gradients calculations.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ITER
MAX_NUM_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of iterations allowed for the solution of the Z-vector equations.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_EVERY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restart iteration every given number of steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: SOLVER_METHOD

ITEM.NAME: POPLE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Pople's method (Default).

ITEM.NAME: CG
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Conjugated gradient method (equivalent to Pople).

ITEM.NAME: RICHARDSON
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Richardson iteration

ITEM.NAME: SD
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Steepest Descent iteration

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Chose solver of the z-vector equations.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_CONV
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence threshold for the solution of the Z-vector equations. The Z-vector equations have the form of a linear system of equations Ax=b, convergence is achieved when |Ax-b|<=EPS_CONV.

KEYWORD.NAME: ENFORCE_DECREASE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts if residual does not decrease.

KEYWORD.NAME: DO_POLAK_RIBIERE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use a Polak-Ribiere update of the search vector in CG instead of the Fletcher Reeves update. Improves the convergence with modified step sizes. Ignored with other methods than CG.

KEYWORD.NAME: LAMBDA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The point to be used along the adiabatic curve (0 < λ < 1)

KEYWORD.NAME: FUNCTIONAL_MODEL

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: NONE

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: List of parameters specific to the kernel function

KEYWORD.NAME: SHORT_RANGE_CORRECTION

KEYWORD.NAME: MOLECULE_CORRECTION_C8

KEYWORD.NAME: D3_EXCLUDE_KIND_PAIR

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Information on the non local part of dispersion functionals. Correct functionals require a corresponding setting of XC_FUNCTIONAL.

KEYWORD.NAME: TYPE

ITEM.NAME: DRSLL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Dion-Rydberg-Schroeder-Langreth-Lundqvist nonlocal van der Waals density functional

ITEM.NAME: LMKLL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Lee-Murray-Kong-Lundqvist-Langreth nonlocal van der Waals density functional

ITEM.NAME: RVV10
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Revised Vydrov-van Voorhis nonlocal van der Waals density functional

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Type of functional (the corresponding kernel data file should be selected). Allows for common forms such as vdW-DF, vdW-DF2, optB88-vdW, rVV10.

KEYWORD.NAME: VERBOSE_OUTPUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Extensive output for non local functionals

KEYWORD.NAME: KERNEL_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the kernel data file, may include a path. vdW_kernel_table.dat is for DRSLL and LMKLL and rVV10_kernel_table.dat is for rVV10.

KEYWORD.NAME: CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The cutoff of the FFT grid used in the calculation of the nonlocal vdW functional [Ry].

KEYWORD.NAME: PARAMETERS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Parameters b and C of the rVV10 functional

KEYWORD.NAME: SCALE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scales the energy contribution of the rVV10 functional

SECTION.NAME: GCP_POTENTIAL
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section combines geometrical counterpoise potentials. This is a simple empirical pair potential to correct for BSSE.

KEYWORD.NAME: PARAMETER_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the parameter file, may include a path

KEYWORD.NAME: GLOBAL_PARAMETERS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Global parameters of the gCP method. Parameters are sigma, alpha, beta, eta from the original paper.

KEYWORD.NAME: DELTA_ENERGY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the delta energy [Hartree] term for an atom kind

SECTION.NAME: RESPONSE_SOLVER
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the parameters of the linear scaling solver routines

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Target accuracy for the convergence of the conjugate gradient.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Threshold used for filtering matrix operations.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of conjugate gradient iteration to be performed for one optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: METHOD

ITEM.NAME: MO_SOLVER
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Solver based on MO (vector) formalism

ITEM.NAME: AO_ORTHO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Solver based on density matrix formalism

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Algorithm used to solve response equation. Both solver are conjugate gradient based, but use either a vector (MO-coefficient) or density matrix formalism in the orthonormal AO-basis to obtain response density

KEYWORD.NAME: PRECONDITIONER

ITEM.NAME: FULL_ALL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Most effective state selective preconditioner based on diagonalization, requires the ENERGY_GAP parameter to be an underestimate of the HOMO-LUMO gap. This preconditioner is recommended for almost all systems, except very large systems where make_preconditioner would dominate the total computational cost.

ITEM.NAME: FULL_SINGLE_INVERSE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Based on H-eS cholesky inversion, similar to FULL_SINGLE in preconditioning efficiency but cheaper to construct, might be somewhat less robust. Recommended for large systems.

ITEM.NAME: FULL_SINGLE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Based on H-eS diagonalisation, not as good as FULL_ALL, but somewhat cheaper to apply.

ITEM.NAME: FULL_KINETIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Cholesky inversion of S and T, fast construction, robust, and relatively good, use for very large systems.

ITEM.NAME: FULL_S_INVERSE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Cholesky inversion of S, not as good as FULL_KINETIC, yet equally expensive.

ITEM.NAME: MULTI_LEVEL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Based on same CG as AO-solver itself, but uses cheaper linear transformation

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: skip preconditioning

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Type of preconditioner to be used with MO conjugate gradient solver. They differ in effectiveness, cost of construction, cost of application. Properly preconditioned minimization can be orders of magnitude faster than doing nothing. Only multi-level conjugate gradient preconditioner (MULTI_LEVEL) available for AO response solver (AO_ORTHO).

KEYWORD.NAME: S_PRECONDITIONER

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: No preconditioner

ITEM.NAME: ATOMIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Using atomic blocks

ITEM.NAME: MOLECULAR
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Using molecular sub-blocks. Recommended if molecules are defined and not too large.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Preconditions S with some appropriate form.

KEYWORD.NAME: S_SQRT_METHOD

ITEM.NAME: NEWTONSCHULZ
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Using a Newton-Schulz-like iteration

ITEM.NAME: PROOT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Using the p-th root method.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Method for the caclulation of the sqrt of S.

KEYWORD.NAME: S_SQRT_ORDER
SIGN_SQRT_ORDER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Order of the iteration method for the calculation of the sqrt of S.

KEYWORD.NAME: MATRIX_CLUSTER_TYPE

ITEM.NAME: ATOMIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Using atomic blocks

ITEM.NAME: MOLECULAR
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Using molecular blocks.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify how atomic blocks should be clustered in the used matrices, in order to improve flop rate, and possibly speedup the matrix multiply. Note that the atomic s_preconditioner can not be used. Furthermore, since screening is on matrix blocks, slightly more accurate results can be expected with molecular.

KEYWORD.NAME: S_INVERSION

ITEM.NAME: SIGN_SQRT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Using the inverse sqrt as obtained from sign function iterations.

ITEM.NAME: HOTELLING
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Using the Hotellign iteration.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Method used to compute the inverse of S.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restart the response calculation if the restart file exists

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_EVERY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restart the conjugate gradient after the specified number of iterations.

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the output of the electron density to the losslessly compressed BQB file format, see [Brehm2018] (via LibBQB see <https://brehm-research.de/bqb>). Currently does not work with changing cell vector (NpT ensemble).

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

KEYWORD.NAME: SKIP_FIRST
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Skips the first step of a MD run (avoids duplicate step if restarted).

KEYWORD.NAME: STORE_STEP_NUMBER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Stores the step number and simulation time in the comment line of each BQB frame. Switch it off for binary compatibility with original CP2k CUBE files.

KEYWORD.NAME: CHECK
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Performs an on-the-fly decompression of each compressed BQB frame to check whether the volumetric data exactly matches, and aborts the run if not so.

KEYWORD.NAME: OVERWRITE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify this keyword to overwrite the output BQB file if it already exists. By default, the data is appended to an existing file.

KEYWORD.NAME: HISTORY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Controls how many previous steps are taken into account for extrapolation in compression. Use a value of 1 to compress the frames independently.

KEYWORD.NAME: PARAMETER_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Allows to supply previously optimized compression parameters via a parameter key (alphanumeric character sequence starting with 'at'). Just leave away the 'at' sign here, because CP2k will otherwise assume it is a variable name in the input

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Standard optimization

ITEM.NAME: PATIENT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Precise optimization

ITEM.NAME: EXHAUSTIVE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Exhaustive optimization

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Controls the time spent to optimize the parameters for compression efficiency.

KEYWORD.NAME: SANITY_CHECK
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Performs a sanity check before each Voronoi integration, i.e., checks if every grid point is located in exactly one Voronoi cell.

KEYWORD.NAME: OVERWRITE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify this keyword to overwrite any existing "properties.emp" file if it already exists. By default, the data is appended to an existing .emp file.

KEYWORD.NAME: SKIP_FIRST
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Skips the first step of a MD run (avoids duplicate step if restarted).

KEYWORD.NAME: VERBOSE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Switches on verbose screen output of the Voronoi integration.

KEYWORD.NAME: OUTPUT_EMP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Writes the resulting electromagnetic moments to a binary file "properties.emp". The file name cannot be changed.

KEYWORD.NAME: OUTPUT_TEXT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Writes the resulting electromagnetic moments to text files (*.voronoi). The file name is specified via FILENAME.

KEYWORD.NAME: REFINEMENT_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets the refinement factor for the Voronoi integration.

KEYWORD.NAME: VORONOI_RADII

ITEM.NAME: UNITY
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use unity radii (non-radical Voronoi tessellation)

ITEM.NAME: VDW
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use VdW atom radii

ITEM.NAME: COVALENT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use covalent atom radii

ITEM.NAME: USER
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use user-specified atom radii

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Which atomic radii to use for the radical Voronoi tessellation.

KEYWORD.NAME: USER_RADII
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines user atom radii for the radical Voronoi tessellation (one per atom).

KEYWORD.NAME: MOLECULAR_PROPERTIES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Calculation of molecular properties from Voronoi integration.

KEYWORD.NAME: MOLPROP_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Root of the file name where to print molecular properties. filename.molprop is used.

KEYWORD.NAME: JITTER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The Voronoi tessellation can have issues with highly symmetric structures. This keyword displaces all atoms pseudo-randomly by a tiny amount (see JITTER_AMPLITUDE) to break symmetry. The displacement is constant over time, so that no temporal noise is introduced. The displacement is not visible to other CP2k routines (FORCE_EVAL, output). It is only applied internally in the library for the Voronoi tessellation.

KEYWORD.NAME: JITTER_SEED
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets the random seed for the jitter. The pseudo-random number generator is re-initialized for each Voronoi tessellation so that the jitter is constant over simulation time (no temporal noise).

KEYWORD.NAME: JITTER_AMPLITUDE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets the maximum displacement amplitude for the jitter.

SECTION.NAME: COULOMB
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Setup parameters for the evaluation of the COULOMB term in SE calculations.

KEYWORD.NAME: CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Atomic Cutoff Radius Cutoff for the evaluation of the Coulomb integrals. For non-periodic calculation the default value is exactly the full cell dimension, in order to evaluate all pair interactions. Instead, for periodic calculations the default numerical value is used.

KEYWORD.NAME: RC_TAPER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Atomic Cutoff Radius Cutoff for Tapering Coulomb integrals. If not specified it assumes the same value specified for the CUTOFF.

KEYWORD.NAME: RC_RANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Range of cutoff switch function (tapering): 0.5*(1-TANH((r-r0)/RC_RANGE)), where r0=2.0*RC_TAPER-20.0*RC_RANGE.

SECTION.NAME: EXCHANGE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Setup parameters for the evaluation of the EXCHANGE and core Hamiltonian terms in SE calculations.

KEYWORD.NAME: CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Atomic Cutoff Radius Cutoff for the evaluation of the Exchange integrals. For non-periodic calculation the default value is exactly the full cell dimension, in order to evaluate all pair interactions. Instead, for periodic calculations the default is the minimum value between 1/4 of the cell dimension and the value specified in input (either explicitly defined or the default numerical value).

KEYWORD.NAME: RC_TAPER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Atomic Cutoff Radius Cutoff for Tapering Exchange integrals. If not specified it assumes the same value specified for the CUTOFF.

KEYWORD.NAME: RC_RANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Range of cutoff switch function (tapering): 0.5*(1-TANH((r-r0)/RC_RANGE)), where r0=2.0*RC_TAPER-20.0*RC_RANGE.

SECTION.NAME: SCREENING

KEYWORD.NAME: RC_TAPER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Atomic Cutoff Radius Cutoff for Tapering the screening term.

KEYWORD.NAME: RC_RANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Range of cutoff switch function (tapering): 0.5*(1-TANH((r-r0)/RC_RANGE)), where r0=2*RC_TAPER-20*RC_RANGE.

SECTION.NAME: LR_CORRECTION

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Atomic Cutoff Radius Cutoff for the evaluation of the long-ranbe correction integrals.

KEYWORD.NAME: RC_TAPER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Atomic Cutoff Radius Cutoff for Tapering the long-range correction integrals. If not specified it assumes the same value specified for the CUTOFF.

KEYWORD.NAME: RC_RANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Range of cutoff switch function (tapering): 0.5*(1-TANH((r-r0)/RC_RANGE)), where r0=2.0*RC_TAPER-20.0*RC_RANGE.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number.
