SECTION.NAME: CDFT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters needed to set up a constrained DFT calculation. Each repetition of the ATOM_GROUP section defines a new constraint. The constraint(s) is (are) converged in a separate external SCF loop with settings read from the OUTER_SCF section. Supported constraints: Becke and Gaussian Hirshfeld (partial).

KEYWORD.NAME: TYPE_OF_CONSTRAINT

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: No constraint (disables section).

ITEM.NAME: HIRSHFELD
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Gaussian Hirshfeld constraint. Partial implementation: no forces. Requires corresponding section. Not as extensively tested.

ITEM.NAME: BECKE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Becke constraint. Requires corresponding section.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the type of constraint used.

KEYWORD.NAME: STRENGTH
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Constraint force constants (Lagrange multipliers). Give one value per constraint group.

KEYWORD.NAME: TARGET
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Constraint target values. Give one value per constraint group. The target value is the desired number of valence electrons, spin moment, or the number of alpha or beta electrons on the atoms that define the constraint, suitably multiplied by atomic coefficients in case a relative constraint between two sets of atoms is employed. Note that core charges are not subtracted from the target value.

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOMIC_CHARGES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Calculate atomic CDFT charges with selected weight function (Z = Z_core - Z_CDFT). With fragment based constraints, charges are relative to the fragment reference state i.e. Z = Z_CDFT - Z_frag_reference. Note: if the number of atoms is greater than the default pw_pool max cache, calculation of atomic CDFT charges will prompt harmless warnings during deallocation of atomic grids.

KEYWORD.NAME: FRAGMENT_A_FILE_NAME
FRAGMENT_A_FILE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the reference total electron density cube file for fragment A. May include a path. The reference electron density needs to be outputted on the same grid as the full system (same cutoff and cell, output stride 1).

KEYWORD.NAME: FRAGMENT_B_FILE_NAME
FRAGMENT_B_FILE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the reference total electron density cube file for fragment B. May include a path. The reference electron density needs to be outputted on the same grid as the full system (same cutoff and cell, output stride 1).

KEYWORD.NAME: FRAGMENT_A_SPIN_FILE
FRAGMENT_A_SPIN_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the reference spin density cube file for fragment A. May include a path. The reference spin density needs to be outputted on the same grid as the full system (same cutoff and cell, output stride 1).

KEYWORD.NAME: FRAGMENT_B_SPIN_FILE
FRAGMENT_B_SPIN_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the reference spin density cube file for fragment B. May include a path. The reference spin density needs to be outputted on the same grid as the full system (same cutoff and cell, output stride 1).

KEYWORD.NAME: FLIP_FRAGMENT_A
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Logical which determines if the reference spin difference density (rho_alpha-rho_beta) for fragment A should be flipped. With default (off) value, the fragment is constrained to have more alpha than beta electrons if the isolated fragment has unpaired electrons. Useful in conjunction with FLIP_FRAGMENT_B.

KEYWORD.NAME: FLIP_FRAGMENT_B
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Logical which determines if the reference spin difference density (rho_alpha-rho_beta) for fragment B should be flipped. With default (off) value, the fragment is constrained to have more alpha than beta electrons if the isolated fragment has unpaired electrons. Useful in conjunction with FLIP_FRAGMENT_A.

KEYWORD.NAME: REUSE_PRECOND
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Reuse a previously built OT preconditioner between subsequent CDFT SCF iterations if the inner OT SCF loop converged in PRECOND_FREQ steps or less. Intended mainly for MD simulations with the FULL_ALL preconditioner to speed up the final iterations of the CDFT SCF loop.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_REUSE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines how many times a previously built preconditioner can be reused.

KEYWORD.NAME: PURGE_HISTORY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Purge wavefunction and constraint history to improve SCF convergence during MD. Counts how often the convergence of the first CDFT SCF iteration takes 2 or more outer SCF iterations and purges the history if the counter exceeds PURGE_FREQ, and PURGE_OFFSET MD steps have passed since the last purge. The counter is zeroed after each purge.

KEYWORD.NAME: COUNTER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: A counter to track the total number of energy evaluations. Needed by some optimizers to print information. Useful mainly for restarts.

KEYWORD.NAME: IN_MEMORY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Precompute gradients due to constraint during initial formation of constraint and store them in memory. Does nothing if forces are not calculated.

SECTION.NAME: OUTER_SCF
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: parameters controlling the outer SCF loop

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: controls the activation of the outer SCF loop

KEYWORD.NAME: TYPE

ITEM.NAME: DDAPC_CONSTRAINT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Enforce a constraint on the DDAPC, requires the corresponding section

ITEM.NAME: S2_CONSTRAINT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Enforce a constraint on the S2, requires the corresponding section

ITEM.NAME: BASIS_CENTER_OPT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Optimize positions of basis functions, if atom types FLOATING_BASIS_CENTER are defined

ITEM.NAME: CDFT_CONSTRAINT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Enforce a constraint on a generic CDFT weight population. Requires the corresponding section QS&CDFT which determines the type of weight used.

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do nothing in the outer loop, useful for resetting the inner loop,

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies which kind of outer SCF should be employed

KEYWORD.NAME: OPTIMIZER

ITEM.NAME: SD
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Takes steps in the direction of the gradient, multiplied by step_size

ITEM.NAME: DIIS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Uses a Direct Inversion in the Iterative Subspace method

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do nothing, useful only with the none type

ITEM.NAME: BISECT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Bisection of the gradient, useful for difficult one dimensional cases

ITEM.NAME: BROYDEN
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Broyden's method. Variant defined in BROYDEN_TYPE.

ITEM.NAME: NEWTON
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Newton's method. Only compatible with CDFT constraints.

ITEM.NAME: SECANT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Secant method. Only for one dimensional cases. See Broyden for multidimensional cases.

ITEM.NAME: NEWTON_LS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Newton's method with backtracking line search to find the optimal step size. Only compatible with CDFT constraints. Starts from the regular Newton solution and successively reduces the step size until the L2 norm of the CDFT gradient decreases or MAX_LS steps is reached. Potentially very expensive because each iteration performs a full SCF calculation.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Method used to bring the outer loop to a stationary point

KEYWORD.NAME: BISECT_TRUST_COUNT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of times the same point will be used in bisection, a small number guards against the effect of wrongly converged states.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_SCF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The target gradient of the outer SCF variables. Notice that the EPS_SCF of the inner loop also determines the value that can be reached in the outer loop, typically EPS_SCF of the outer loop must be smaller than or equal to EPS_SCF of the inner loop.

KEYWORD.NAME: DIIS_BUFFER_LENGTH
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of DIIS vectors used

KEYWORD.NAME: EXTRAPOLATION_ORDER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of past states used in the extrapolation of the variables during e.g. MD

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_SCF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The maximum number of outer loops

KEYWORD.NAME: STEP_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The initial step_size used in the optimizer (currently steepest descent). Note that in cases where a sadle point is sought for (constrained DFT), this can be negative. For Newton and Broyden optimizers, use a value less/higher than the default 1.0 (in absolute value, the sign is not significant) to active an under/overrelaxed optimizer.

SECTION.NAME: CDFT_OPT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters controlling optimization methods that are compatible only with CDFT based constraints (i.e. CDFT SCF is active). Specifically, the control parameters for the Broyden and Newton optimizers are defined in this section.

KEYWORD.NAME: BROYDEN_TYPE

ITEM.NAME: BT1
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Broyden's first method, also known as the good method. The initial Jacobian is built from MD history if available. Otherwise switches to SD for one SCF iteration until a Jacobian can be built from the SCF history.

ITEM.NAME: BT1_EXPLICIT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Same as BT1, but computes the explicit Jacobian with finite differences. Requires a CDFT SCF procedure to be active.

ITEM.NAME: BT2
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Same as BT1, but uses Broyden's second method, also known as the bad method.

ITEM.NAME: BT2_EXPLICIT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Same as BT1_EXPLICIT, but using Broyden's second method.

ITEM.NAME: BT1_LS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Same as BT1, but uses backtracking line search for optimizing the step size (see optimizer NEWTON_LS).

ITEM.NAME: BT1_EXPLICIT_LS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Same as BT1_EXPLICIT, but uses backtracking line search for optimizing the step size.

ITEM.NAME: BT2_LS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Same as BT2, but uses backtracking line search for optimizing the step size.

ITEM.NAME: BT2_EXPLICIT_LS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Same as BT2_EXPLICIT, but uses backtracking line search for optimizing the step size.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the Broyden optimizer variant to use.

KEYWORD.NAME: JACOBIAN_TYPE

ITEM.NAME: FD1
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: First order forward difference (one extra energy evaluation per constraint).

ITEM.NAME: FD1_BACKWARD
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: First order backward difference (one extra energy evaluation per constraint).

ITEM.NAME: FD2
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Second order forward difference (two extra energy evaluations per constraint).

ITEM.NAME: FD2_BACKWARD
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Second order backward difference (two extra energy evaluations per constraint).

ITEM.NAME: FD1_CENTRAL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: First order central difference (two extra energy evaluations per constraint).

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Finite difference method used to calculate the inverse Jacobian needed by some optimizers. Compatible only with CDFT constraints.

KEYWORD.NAME: JACOBIAN_STEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Step size to use in the calculation of the inverse Jacobian with finite differences. Expects one value for all constraints, or one value per constraint.

KEYWORD.NAME: JACOBIAN_FREQ
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines parameters that control how often the explicit Jacobian is built, which is needed by some optimizers. Expects two values. The first value determines how many consecutive CDFT SCF iterations should skip a rebuild, whereas the latter how many MD steps. The values can be zero (meaning never rebuild) or positive. Both values cannot be zero.

KEYWORD.NAME: JACOBIAN_RESTART
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restart the inverse Jacobian using the vector defined with keyword JACOBIAN_VECTOR.

KEYWORD.NAME: JACOBIAN_VECTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the inverse Jacobian matrix. Useful for restarting calculations. Expects n^2 values where n is the total number of constraints. The matrix should be given in row major order.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_LS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The maximum number of backtracking line search steps to perform.

KEYWORD.NAME: FACTOR_LS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Control parameter for backtracking line search. The step size is reduced by this factor on every line search iteration. Value must be between 0 and 1 (exclusive).

KEYWORD.NAME: CONTINUE_LS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Continue backtracking line search until MAX_LS steps are reached or the norm of the CDFT gradient no longer decreases. Default (false) behavior exits the line search procedure on the first step that the gradient decreases.

SECTION.NAME: BECKE_CONSTRAINT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Define settings influencing the construction of the Becke weight function.

KEYWORD.NAME: ADJUST_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Adjust Becke cell boundaries with atomic radii to generate a heteronuclear cutoff profile. These radii are defined with the keyword ATOMIC_RADII.

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOMIC_RADII
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines atomic radii to generate a heteronuclear cutoff profile. Give one value per element in the same order as they appear in the input coordinates.

KEYWORD.NAME: SHOULD_SKIP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If grid point is farther than GLOBAL_CUTOFF from all constraint atoms, move directly to next grid point, thus saving computational resources.

KEYWORD.NAME: CAVITY_CONFINE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Activates Gaussian cavity confinement. The constraint is evaluated only inside the cavity. The cavity is formed by summing spherical Gaussians centered on the constraint atoms.

KEYWORD.NAME: CAVITY_SHAPE

ITEM.NAME: DEFAULT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use covalent radii (in angstrom) to construct Gaussians, but fixed 1.0_dp radius for elements with a radius larger than this value.

ITEM.NAME: SINGLE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Single Gaussian for all atom types with radius given by CAVITY_RADIUS.

ITEM.NAME: VDW
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use van der Waals radii to construct Gaussians.

ITEM.NAME: COVALENT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use covalent radii to construct Gaussians.

ITEM.NAME: USER
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use user defined radii (keyword ATOMIC_RADII) to construct Gaussians.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the type of Gaussian cavity used.

KEYWORD.NAME: CAVITY_USE_BOHR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convert the cavity radius from angstrom to bohr. This results in a larger confinement cavity than without unit conversion.

KEYWORD.NAME: CAVITY_PRINT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Print cavity in Gaussian cube file format. Currently, printing options are hardcoded.

KEYWORD.NAME: CAVITY_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Radius parameter controlling the creation of Gaussian cavity confinement.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_CAVITY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Density threshold for cavity creation. Grid points where the Gaussian density falls below the threshold are ignored.

KEYWORD.NAME: CUTOFF_TYPE

ITEM.NAME: GLOBAL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use a single value for all elements. Read from GLOBAL_CUTOFF.

ITEM.NAME: ELEMENT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use a different value for all elements. Values read from ELEMENT_CUTOFF.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the type of cutoff used when building the Becke weight function.

KEYWORD.NAME: GLOBAL_CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Parameter used to select which atoms contribute to the weight function at each real space grid point.

KEYWORD.NAME: ELEMENT_CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines element specific cutoffs to decide which atoms contribute to the weight function at each real space grid point. Give one value per element in the same order as they appear in the coordinates.

KEYWORD.NAME: IN_MEMORY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Precompute gradients due to Becke constraint during initial formation of constraint and store them in memory. Useful in combination with confinement, memory intensive otherwise. Does nothing if forces are not calculated.

SECTION.NAME: HIRSHFELD_CONSTRAINT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for CDFT with a Gaussian Hirshfeld constraint.

KEYWORD.NAME: SHAPE_FUNCTION

ITEM.NAME: GAUSSIAN
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: One Gaussian per atom with radius determined by the keyword GAUSSIAN_SHAPE.

ITEM.NAME: DENSITY
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Atomic density expanded in terms of multiple Gaussians.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Type of shape function used for Hirshfeld partitioning.

KEYWORD.NAME: GAUSSIAN_SHAPE

ITEM.NAME: DEFAULT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use covalent radii (in angstrom) to construct Gaussians, but fixed 1.0_dp radius for elements with a radius larger than this value.

ITEM.NAME: SINGLE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Single Gaussian for all atom types with radius given by GAUSSIAN_RADIUS.

ITEM.NAME: VDW
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use van der Waals radii to construct Gaussians.

ITEM.NAME: COVALENT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use covalent radii to construct Gaussians.

ITEM.NAME: USER
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use user defined radii (keyword ATOMIC_RADII) to construct Gaussians.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the type of Gaussian used for SHAPE_FUNCTION GAUSSIAN.

KEYWORD.NAME: GAUSSIAN_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Radius parameter controlling the creation of Gaussians.

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOMIC_RADII
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines custom radii to setup the spherical Gaussians. Give one value per element in the same order as they appear in the input coordinates.

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_BOHR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convert the Gaussian radius from angstrom to bohr. This results in a larger Gaussian than without unit conversion.

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_DENSITY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Logical to control printing of Hirshfeld densities to .cube file.

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOMS_MEMORY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of atomic gradients to store in memory.

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_ATOMIC_CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Logical to control use of ATOMIC_CUTOFF.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Numerical cutoff for calculation of weight function.

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOMIC_CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Numerical cutoff for calculation of Hirshfeld densities.

SECTION.NAME: PROGRAM_RUN_INFO
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of basic info about the method.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

KEYWORD.NAME: JUST_ENERGY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for an ENERGY/ENERGY_FORCE calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: POWELL_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for POWELL based optimization steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: QS_SCF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the SCF steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: XAS_SCF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the X-Ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS) SCF steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: MD
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the MD steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: PINT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Path integral md steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: METADYNAMICS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the METADYNAMICS steps (number of hills added).

KEYWORD.NAME: GEO_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Geometry optimization steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: ROT_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Rotational optimization steps in the Dimer calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: CELL_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Cell optimization steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: BAND
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the BAND calculation steps

KEYWORD.NAME: EP_LIN_SOLVER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Energy Perturbation (EP) linear solver

KEYWORD.NAME: SPLINE_FIND_COEFFS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the solution of the coefficients of the splines

KEYWORD.NAME: REPLICA_EVAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the evaluation of the Replica Environment

KEYWORD.NAME: BSSE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Basis Set Superposition Error (BSSE) calculation

KEYWORD.NAME: SHELL_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Shell-Core distances optimization steps

KEYWORD.NAME: TDDFT_SCF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Iteration level for the Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory SCF steps.

SECTION.NAME: WEIGHT_FUNCTION
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of cube files with the CDFT weight function(s). Intended for single-point testing. In multistep simulations, generated cube files are overwritten each step.

KEYWORD.NAME: STRIDE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The stride (X,Y,Z) used to write the cube file (larger values result in smaller cube files). You can provide 3 numbers (for X,Y,Z) or 1 number valid for all components.

SECTION.NAME: ATOM_GROUP
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Define a group of atoms for use in a CDFT constraint. Each repetition of this section creates a new constraint.

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the list of atoms that are included in the constraint group.

KEYWORD.NAME: COEFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines coefficients for the atoms in the list of atoms. Accepts values +/-1.0.

KEYWORD.NAME: CONSTRAINT_TYPE

ITEM.NAME: CHARGE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Total charge density constraint (rho_alpha + rho_beta).

ITEM.NAME: MAGNETIZATION
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Magnetization density constraint (rho_alpha - rho_beta).

ITEM.NAME: ALPHA
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Alpha spin density constraint.

ITEM.NAME: BETA
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Beta spin density constraint.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines what type of constraint to apply.

KEYWORD.NAME: FRAGMENT_CONSTRAINT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use a fragment based constraint. Takes as input the electron densities of two isolated fragments in the same geometry that they have in the full system. The isolated fragment densities are read from cube files defined in FRAGMENT_{A,B}_FILE. For magnetization density constraints, additional files containing the spin difference densities must be defined with the keywords FRAGMENT_{A,B}_SPIN_FILE. With this keyword active, the target value of the constraint is calculated from the the superposition of the isolated fragment densities. Supports only static calculations.

SECTION.NAME: DUMMY_ATOMS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Define an extra group of atoms for which only atomic CDFT charges should be computed. The section cannot contain any constraint atoms that were included in section ATOM_GROUP.

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the list of atoms that are included in the DUMMY_ATOMS group.

SECTION.NAME: S2_RESTRAINT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Use S2 in a re/constraint (OT only)

KEYWORD.NAME: FUNCTIONAL_FORM

ITEM.NAME: RESTRAINT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Harmonic potential: s*(q-t)**2

ITEM.NAME: CONSTRAINT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Constraint form: s*(q-t)

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the functional form of the term added

SECTION.NAME: LRIGPW
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies optional parameters for LRIGPW.

KEYWORD.NAME: LRI_OVERLAP_MATRIX

ITEM.NAME: INVERSE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Calculate inverse of the overlap matrix.

ITEM.NAME: PSEUDO_INVERSE_SVD
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Calculate the pseuodinverse of the overlap matrix using singular value decomposition.

ITEM.NAME: PSEUDO_INVERSE_DIAG
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Calculate the pseudoinverse of the overlap matrix by prior diagonalization.

ITEM.NAME: AUTOSELECT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Choose automatically for each pair whether to calculate the inverse or pseudoinverse based on the condition number of the overlap matrix for each pair. Calculating the pseudoinverse is much more expensive.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies whether to calculate the inverse or the pseudoinverse of the overlap matrix of the auxiliary basis set. Calculating the pseudoinverse is necessary for very large auxiliary basis sets, but more expensive. Using the pseudoinverse, consistent forces are not guaranteed yet.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_CONDITION_NUM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If AUTOSELECT is chosen for LRI_OVERLAP_MATRIX, this keyword specifies that the pseudoinverse is calculated only if the LOG of the condition number of the lri overlap matrix is larger than the given value.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_O3_INT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Threshold for ABA and ABB integrals in LRI. This is used for screening in the KS and force calculations (tensor contractions).

KEYWORD.NAME: DEBUG_LRI_INTEGRALS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Debug the integrals needed for LRIGPW.

KEYWORD.NAME: EXACT_1C_TERMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Don't use LRI for one center densities.

KEYWORD.NAME: RI_STATISTIC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Print statistical information on the RI calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: DISTANT_PAIR_APPROXIMATION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Calculate distant pairs using an independent atom approximation.

KEYWORD.NAME: DISTANT_PAIR_METHOD
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Method used to separate pair density for distant pairs. Options: EW (equal weights); AW (atomic weights); SW (set weights); LW (shell function weights)

KEYWORD.NAME: DISTANT_PAIR_RADII
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Inner and outer radii used in distant pair separation. Smooth interpolation between inner and outer radius is used.

KEYWORD.NAME: SHG_LRI_INTEGRALS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Uses the SHG (solid harmonic Gaussian) integral scheme instead of Obara-Saika

KEYWORD.NAME: RI_SINV
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Approximation to be used for the inverse of the RI overlap matrix. INVF, INVS: exact inverse, apply directly for solver (F:full matrix, S:sparsematrix). AINV approximate inverse, use with PCG. NONE: no approximation used with CG solver.

SECTION.NAME: OPTIMIZE_LRI_BASIS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies the parameters for optimizing the lri auxiliary basis sets for LRIGPW. The Powell optimizer is used.

KEYWORD.NAME: ACCURACY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Target accuracy for the objective function (RHOEND)

KEYWORD.NAME: STEP_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial step size for search algorithm (RHOBEG)

KEYWORD.NAME: CONDITION_WEIGHT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keyword allows to give different weight factors to the condition number (LOG(cond) is used).

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_CONDITION_NUMBER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines whether condition number should be part of optimization or not

KEYWORD.NAME: GEOMETRIC_SEQUENCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Exponents are assumed to be a geometric sequence. Only the minimal and maximal exponents of one set are optimized and the other exponents are obtained by geometric progression.

KEYWORD.NAME: DEGREES_OF_FREEDOM

ITEM.NAME: ALL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Set all parameters in the basis to be variable.

ITEM.NAME: COEFFICIENTS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Set all coefficients in the basis set to be variable.

ITEM.NAME: EXPONENTS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Set all exponents in the basis to be variable.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the degrees of freedom in the basis optimization.

SECTION.NAME: CONSTRAIN_EXPONENTS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: specifies constraints for the exponents of the lri auxiliary basis sets in the optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: SCALE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the upper and lower boundaries as (1+scale)*exp and (1-scale)*exp. Fermi-like constraint function

KEYWORD.NAME: FERMI_EXP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Exponent in the fermi-like constraint function.

SECTION.NAME: OPT_EMBED
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies optional parameters for DFT embedding potential optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: REG_LAMBDA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Parameter for Yang's regularization involving kinetic matrix.

KEYWORD.NAME: N_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of iterations in the optimization procedure.

KEYWORD.NAME: TRUST_RAD
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of iterations in the optimization procedure.

KEYWORD.NAME: DENS_CONV_MAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the maximum electron density difference.

KEYWORD.NAME: DENS_CONV_INT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the integrated electron density difference.

KEYWORD.NAME: SPIN_DENS_CONV_MAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the maximum electron density difference.

KEYWORD.NAME: SPIN_DENS_CONV_INT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the integrated electron density difference.

ITEM.NAME: STEEPEST_DESCENT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Steepest descent.

ITEM.NAME: QUASI_NEWTON
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Quasi-Newton.

ITEM.NAME: LEVEL_SHIFT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Level shift.

KEYWORD.NAME: GRID_OPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Optimize embedding potential on the grid.

KEYWORD.NAME: LEEUWEN-BAERENDS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Van Leeuwen-Baerends iterative update. Alternative to Wu-Yang optimizer. Use only with ADD_CONTST_POT.

KEYWORD.NAME: FAB
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Finzel-Ayers-Bultinck iterative update. Generally, not reliable.

KEYWORD.NAME: VW_CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Cutoff for von Weizsacker potential in the FAB optimization procedure.

KEYWORD.NAME: VW_SMOOTH_CUT_RANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Smooth cutoff range for von Weizsacker potential in the FAB optimization procedure.

KEYWORD.NAME: POT_GUESS

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Initial guess is zero grid.

ITEM.NAME: DIFF
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Initial density difference. A euristic but working approach.

ITEM.NAME: FERMI_AMALDI
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Fermi-Amaldi potential. More rigorous than DIFF, although less efficient.

ITEM.NAME: RESP
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Coulomb interaction between the subsystem using RESP charges) on the total system.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the guess of the embedding potential. For optimization in finite basis (not grid optimization) in is a constant part to be added to the one in finite basis.

KEYWORD.NAME: CHARGE_DISTR_WIDTH
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Width of the Gaussian representing point charges. To be used with ADD_COULOMB_POT.

KEYWORD.NAME: READ_EMBED_POT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Read the embedding potential restart vector as a guess.

KEYWORD.NAME: READ_EMBED_POT_CUBE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Read the embedding potential (restart) from the cube file.

KEYWORD.NAME: EMBED_RESTART_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Root of the file name where to read the embedding potential guess.

KEYWORD.NAME: EMBED_CUBE_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Root of the file name where to read the embedding potential (guess) as a cube.

KEYWORD.NAME: EMBED_SPIN_CUBE_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Root of the file name where to read the spin part of the embedding potential (guess) as a cube.

SECTION.NAME: EMBED_DENS_DIFF
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of cube files with embedding densisty differences

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: HF
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Sets up the Hartree-Fock parameters if requested

KEYWORD.NAME: FRACTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The fraction of Hartree-Fock to add to the total energy. 1.0 implies standard Hartree-Fock if used with XC_FUNCTIONAL NONE. NOTE: In a mixed potential calculation this should be set to 1.0, otherwise all parts are multiplied with this factor.

KEYWORD.NAME: TREAT_LSD_IN_CORE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines how spin densities are taken into account. If true, the beta spin density is included via a second in core call. If false, alpha and beta spins are done in one shot

KEYWORD.NAME: PW_HFX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Compute the Hartree-Fock energy also in the plane wave basis. The value is ignored, and intended for debugging only.

KEYWORD.NAME: PW_HFX_BLOCKSIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Improve the performance of pw_hfx at the cost of some additional memory by storing the realspace representation of PW_HFX_BLOCKSIZE states.

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_SCHWARZ
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Screens the near field part of the electronic repulsion integrals using the Schwarz inequality for the given threshold.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_SCHWARZ_FORCES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Screens the near field part of the electronic repulsion integrals using the Schwarz inequality for the given threshold. This will be approximately the accuracy of the forces, and should normally be similar to EPS_SCF

KEYWORD.NAME: SCREEN_P_FORCES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Screens the electronic repulsion integrals for the forces using the density matrix. This results in a significant speedup for large systems, but might require a somewhat tigher EPS_SCHWARZ_FORCES.

KEYWORD.NAME: SCREEN_ON_INITIAL_P
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Screen on an initial density matrix. For the first MD step this matrix must be provided by a Restart File.

KEYWORD.NAME: P_SCREEN_CORRECTION_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Recalculates integrals on the fly if the actual density matrix is larger by a given factor than the initial one. If the factor is set to 0.0_dp, this feature is disabled.

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Overlap

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Truncated Mix coulomb and longrange potential, assumes/requires that the erf has fully decayed at R_c

SECTION.NAME: MEMORY
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Sets up memory parameters for the storage of the ERI's if requested

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_STORAGE_SCALING
EPS_STORAGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scaling factor to scale eps_schwarz. Storage threshold for compression will be EPS_SCHWARZ*EPS_STORAGE_SCALING.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_MEMORY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the maximum amount of memory [MiB] to be consumed by the full HFX module. All temporary buffers and helper arrays are subtracted from this number. What remains will be used for storage of integrals. NOTE: This number is assumed to represent the memory available to one MPI process. When running a threaded version, cp2k automatically takes care of distributing the memory among all the threads within a process.

KEYWORD.NAME: STORAGE_LOCATION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Loaction where ERI's are stored if MAX_DISK_SPACE /=0 Expects a path to a directory.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_DISK_SPACE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the maximum amount of disk space [MiB] used to store precomputed compressed four-center integrals. If 0, nothing is stored to disk

KEYWORD.NAME: TREAT_FORCES_IN_CORE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines whether the derivative ERI's should be stored to RAM or not. Only meaningful when performing Ehrenfest MD. Memory usage is defined via MAX_MEMORY, i.e. the memory is shared wit the energy ERI's.

SECTION.NAME: RI
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for RI method in HFX (experimental, forces not yet implemented).

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Filter threshold for DBCSR tensor contraction.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER_2C
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Filter threshold for 2c integrals. Default should be kept.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_STORAGE_SCALING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scaling factor to scale EPS_FILTER for storage of 3-center integrals. Storage threshold will be EPS_FILTER*EPS_STORAGE_SCALING.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER_MO
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Filter threshold for contraction of 3-center integrals with MOs. Default should be kept.

KEYWORD.NAME: OMEGA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The range parameter for the short range operator (in 1/a0). Default is OMEGA from INTERACTION_POTENTIAL.

KEYWORD.NAME: CUTOFF_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The cutoff radius (in Angstroms) for the truncated Coulomb operator. Default is CUTOFF_RADIUS from INTERACTION_POTENTIAL.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_NGROUPS
NGROUPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The number of MPI subgroup that work in parallel during the SCF. The default value is 1. Using N subgroups should speed up the calculation by a factor ~N, at the cost of N times more memory usage.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_USE_DELTA_P
USE_DELTA_P
KP_USE_P_DIFF
USE_P_DIFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This kweyword controls whether the KS matrix at each SCF cycle is built by adding the contribution of the denisty difference (wrt to previous step) to the KS matrix of the previous step. As the SCF converges, the density fluctuations get smaller and sparsity increases, leading to faster SCF steps. Not always numerically stable => turn off if SCF struggles to converge.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_STACK_SIZE
STACK_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: When doing contraction over periodic cells of the type: T_mu^a,nu^b,P^c = (mu^a nu^b | Q^d) * (Q^d | P^c), with a,b,c,d labeling cells, there are in principle Ncells contractions taking place. Because a smaller number of contractions involving larger tensors is more efficient, the tensors can be stacked along the d direction. STCK_SIZE controls the size of this stack. Larger stacks are more efficient, but required more memory.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_RI_EXTENSION_FACTOR
RI_EXTENSION_FACTOR
RI_EXT
RI_EXT_FACT
KP_RI_EXT
KP_RI_EXT_FACT
KP_RI_BASIS_EXT
RI_BASIS_EXT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: In KP-RI-HFX, each atom has its own local RI basis. The RI basis is defined by a sphere of radius R centered on the atom, whereby all neighboring atoms within that sphere contribute their RI basis elements. The radius of that sphere is calculated based on the systems' most diffuse orbital PGF (with exponant alpha), such that EPS_PGF_ORB * KP_RI_EXTENSION_FACTOR = exp(-alpha*R^2). The default value of 1.0 is safe. More accurate results can be obtained with a value < 1.0, at greated computational cost.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_RI_BUMP_FACTOR
RI_BUMP
BUMP
BUMP_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: In KP-RI-HFX, the extended RI basis set has a bump radius. All basis elements within that radius contribute with full weight. All basis elements beyond that radius have decaying weight, from 1 at the bump radius, to zero at the RI extension radius. The bump radius is calculated as a fraction of the RI extension radius: bump radius = KP_RI_NUMP_FACTOR * RI extension radius

KEYWORD.NAME: RI_METRIC

ITEM.NAME: HFX
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Same as HFX operator

ITEM.NAME: COULOMB
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Standard Coulomb operator: 1/r

ITEM.NAME: IDENTITY
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Overlap

ITEM.NAME: TRUNCATED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Truncated Coulomb operator: 1/r if (r<R_c), 0 otherwise

ITEM.NAME: SHORTRANGE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Short range: erfc(omega*r)/r

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The type of RI operator. Default is POTENTIAL_TYPE from INTERACTION_POTENTIAL. The standard Coulomb operator cannot be used in periodic systems.

KEYWORD.NAME: 2C_MATRIX_FUNCTIONS

ITEM.NAME: DIAG
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Diagonalization with eigenvalue quenching: stable

ITEM.NAME: CHOLESKY
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Cholesky: not stable in case of ill-conditioned RI basis

ITEM.NAME: ITER
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Iterative algorithms: linear scaling Hotelling's method for inverse and Newton-Schulz iteration for matrix square root

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Methods for matrix inverse and matrix square root.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_EIGVAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Throw away linear combinations of RI basis functions with a small eigenvalue, this is applied only if 2C_MATRIX_FUNCTIONS DIAG

KEYWORD.NAME: CHECK_2C_MATRIX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Report accuracy for the inverse/sqrt of the 2-center integral matrix.

KEYWORD.NAME: CALC_COND_NUM
CALC_CONDITION_NUMBER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Calculate the condition number of integral matrices.

KEYWORD.NAME: SQRT_ORDER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Order of the iteration method for the calculation of the sqrt of 2-center integral matrix.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_PGF_ORB
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets precision of the integral tensors.

KEYWORD.NAME: RI_FLAVOR

ITEM.NAME: MO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: with MO coefficients

ITEM.NAME: RHO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: with density matrix

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Flavor of RI: how to contract 3-center integrals

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_BLOCK_SIZE_MO
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum tensor block size for MOs.

KEYWORD.NAME: MEMORY_CUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Memory reduction factor. This keyword controls the batching of tensor contractions into smaller, more manageable chunks. The details vary depending on the RI_FLAVOR.

KEYWORD.NAME: FLAVOR_SWITCH_MEMORY_CUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Memory reduction factor to be applied upon RI_FLAVOR switching from MO to RHO. The RHO flavor typically requires more memory, and depending on the ressources available, a higher MEMORY_CUT.

SECTION.NAME: WF_CORRELATION
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Sets up the wavefunction-based correlation methods as MP2, RI-MP2, RI-SOS-MP2, RI-RPA and GW (inside RI-RPA).

KEYWORD.NAME: MEMORY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum allowed total memory usage during MP2 methods [MiB].

KEYWORD.NAME: E_GAP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Gap energy for integration grids in Hartree. Defaults to -1.0 (automatic determination). Recommended to set if several RPA or SOS-MP2 gradient calculations are requested or to be restarted. In this way, differences of integration grids across different runs are removed as CP2K does not include derivatives thereof.

KEYWORD.NAME: E_RANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Energy range (ratio of largest and smallest) energy difference of unoccupied and occupied orbitals for integration grids. Defaults to 0.0 (automatic determination). Recommended to set if several RPA or SOS-MP2 gradient calculations are requested or to be restarted. In this way, differences of integration grids across different runs are removed as CP2K does not include derivatives thereof.

KEYWORD.NAME: SCALE_S
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scaling factor of the singlet energy component (opposite spin, OS) of the MP2, RI-MP2 and SOS-MP2 correlation energy.

KEYWORD.NAME: SCALE_T
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scaling factor of the triplet energy component (same spin, SS) of the MP2 and RI-MP2 correlation energy.

KEYWORD.NAME: GROUP_SIZE
NUMBER_PROC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Group size used in the computation of GPW and MME integrals and the MP2 correlation energy. The group size must be a divisor of the total number of MPI ranks. A smaller group size (for example the number of MPI ranks per node) accelerates the computation of integrals but a too large group size increases communication costs. A too small group size may lead to out of memory.

KEYWORD.NAME: METHOD

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Skip MP2 calculation.

ITEM.NAME: DIRECT_CANONICAL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use the direct mp2 canonical approach.

ITEM.NAME: MP2_GPW
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use the GPW approach to MP2.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Method that is used to compute the MP2 energy.

KEYWORD.NAME: BIG_SEND
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Influencing the direct canonical MP2 method: Send big messages between processes (useful for >48 processors).

SECTION.NAME: RI_MP2
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters influencing the RI-MP2 method. RI-MP2 supports gradients.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Putting the &RI_MP2 section activates RI-MP2 calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: BLOCK_SIZE
MESSAGE_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines the blocking used for communication in RI-MP2. Larger BLOCK_SIZE reduces communication but requires more memory. The default (-1) is automatic.

KEYWORD.NAME: NUMBER_INTEGRATION_GROUPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets the number of integration groups of the communication scheme in RI-MP2. Integrals will be replicated such that each integration group has all integrals available. Must be a divisor of the number of subgroups (see GROUP_SIZE keyword in the WF_CORRELATION section. Smaller groups reduce the communication costs but increase the memory developments. If the provided value is non-positive or not a divisor of the number of subgroups, the number of integration groups is determined automatically (default).

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_DGEMM_INFO
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Print details about all DGEMM calls.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Putting the &RI_RPA section activates RI-RPA calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: QUADRATURE_POINTS
RPA_NUM_QUAD_POINTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of quadrature points for the numerical integration in the RI-RPA method.

KEYWORD.NAME: NUM_INTEG_GROUPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of groups for the integration in the Laplace method. Each groups processes the same amount of quadrature points. It must be a divisor of the number of quadrature points and NUM_INTEG_GROUPS*GROUP_SIZE must be a divisor of the total number of processes. The default (-1) is automatic.

KEYWORD.NAME: MM_STYLE

ITEM.NAME: GEMM
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use pdgemm: more flops, maybe faster.

ITEM.NAME: SYRK
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use pdysrk: fewer flops, maybe slower.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Matrix multiplication style for the Q matrix.

KEYWORD.NAME: MINIMAX_QUADRATURE
MINIMAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use the Minimax quadrature scheme for performing the numerical integration. Maximum number of quadrature point limited to 20.

KEYWORD.NAME: RI_AXK
AXK
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Decide whether to perform an RPA-AXK calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: RSE
SE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Decide whether to add singles correction.

KEYWORD.NAME: ADMM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Decide whether to perform ADMM in the exact exchange calc. for RPA and/or GW. The ADMM XC correction is governed by the AUXILIARY_DENSITY_MATRIX_METHOD section in &DFT. In most cases, the Hartree-Fock exchange is not too expensive and there is no need for ADMM, ADMM can however provide significant speedup and memory savings in case of diffuse basis sets. If it is a GW bandgap calculations, RI_SIGMA_X can also be used.

KEYWORD.NAME: PRINT_DGEMM_INFO
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Print details about all DGEMM calls.

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Sets up the Hartree-Fock parameters if requested

KEYWORD.NAME: FRACTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The fraction of Hartree-Fock to add to the total energy. 1.0 implies standard Hartree-Fock if used with XC_FUNCTIONAL NONE. NOTE: In a mixed potential calculation this should be set to 1.0, otherwise all parts are multiplied with this factor.

KEYWORD.NAME: TREAT_LSD_IN_CORE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines how spin densities are taken into account. If true, the beta spin density is included via a second in core call. If false, alpha and beta spins are done in one shot

KEYWORD.NAME: PW_HFX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Compute the Hartree-Fock energy also in the plane wave basis. The value is ignored, and intended for debugging only.

KEYWORD.NAME: PW_HFX_BLOCKSIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Improve the performance of pw_hfx at the cost of some additional memory by storing the realspace representation of PW_HFX_BLOCKSIZE states.

KEYWORD.NAME: NUMBER_OF_SHELLS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of shells taken into account for periodicity. By default, cp2k tries to automatically evaluate this number. This algorithm might be to conservative, resulting in some overhead. You can try to adjust this number in order to make a calculation cheaper.

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Sets up screening parameters if requested

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_SCHWARZ
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Screens the near field part of the electronic repulsion integrals using the Schwarz inequality for the given threshold.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_SCHWARZ_FORCES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Screens the near field part of the electronic repulsion integrals using the Schwarz inequality for the given threshold. This will be approximately the accuracy of the forces, and should normally be similar to EPS_SCF

KEYWORD.NAME: SCREEN_P_FORCES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Screens the electronic repulsion integrals for the forces using the density matrix. This results in a significant speedup for large systems, but might require a somewhat tigher EPS_SCHWARZ_FORCES.

KEYWORD.NAME: SCREEN_ON_INITIAL_P
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Screen on an initial density matrix. For the first MD step this matrix must be provided by a Restart File.

KEYWORD.NAME: P_SCREEN_CORRECTION_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Recalculates integrals on the fly if the actual density matrix is larger by a given factor than the initial one. If the factor is set to 0.0_dp, this feature is disabled.

SECTION.NAME: INTERACTION_POTENTIAL
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Sets up interaction potential if requested

KEYWORD.NAME: POTENTIAL_TYPE

ITEM.NAME: COULOMB
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Coulomb potential: 1/r

ITEM.NAME: SHORTRANGE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Shortrange potential: erfc(omega*r)/r

ITEM.NAME: LONGRANGE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Longrange potential: erf(omega*r)/r

ITEM.NAME: MIX_CL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mix coulomb and longrange potential: 1/r + erf(omega*r)/r

ITEM.NAME: GAUSSIAN
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Damped Gaussian potential: exp(-omega^2*r^2)

ITEM.NAME: MIX_LG
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mix Gaussian and longrange potential: erf(omega*r)/r + exp(-omega^2*r^2)

ITEM.NAME: IDENTITY
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Overlap

ITEM.NAME: TRUNCATED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Truncated coulomb potential: if (r < R_c) 1/r else 0

ITEM.NAME: MIX_CL_TRUNC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Truncated Mix coulomb and longrange potential, assumes/requires that the erf has fully decayed at R_c

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Which interaction potential should be used (Coulomb, longrange or shortrange).

KEYWORD.NAME: SCALE_COULOMB
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scales Hartree-Fock contribution arising from a coulomb potential. Only valid when doing a mixed potential calculation

KEYWORD.NAME: SCALE_LONGRANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scales Hartree-Fock contribution arising from a longrange potential. Only valid when doing a mixed potential calculation

KEYWORD.NAME: SCALE_GAUSSIAN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scales Hartree-Fock contribution arising from a gaussian potential. Only valid when doing a mixed potential calculation

KEYWORD.NAME: CUTOFF_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines cutoff radius (in Angstroms) for the truncated 1/r potential. Only valid when doing truncated calculation

KEYWORD.NAME: T_C_G_DATA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Location of the file t_c_g.dat that contains the data for the evaluation of the truncated gamma function

KEYWORD.NAME: RANDOMIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This flag controls the randomization of the bin assignment to processes. For highly ordered input structures with a bad load balance, setting this flag to TRUE might improve.

SECTION.NAME: MEMORY
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Sets up memory parameters for the storage of the ERI's if requested

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_STORAGE_SCALING
EPS_STORAGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scaling factor to scale eps_schwarz. Storage threshold for compression will be EPS_SCHWARZ*EPS_STORAGE_SCALING.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_MEMORY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the maximum amount of memory [MiB] to be consumed by the full HFX module. All temporary buffers and helper arrays are subtracted from this number. What remains will be used for storage of integrals. NOTE: This number is assumed to represent the memory available to one MPI process. When running a threaded version, cp2k automatically takes care of distributing the memory among all the threads within a process.

KEYWORD.NAME: STORAGE_LOCATION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Loaction where ERI's are stored if MAX_DISK_SPACE /=0 Expects a path to a directory.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_DISK_SPACE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the maximum amount of disk space [MiB] used to store precomputed compressed four-center integrals. If 0, nothing is stored to disk

KEYWORD.NAME: TREAT_FORCES_IN_CORE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines whether the derivative ERI's should be stored to RAM or not. Only meaningful when performing Ehrenfest MD. Memory usage is defined via MAX_MEMORY, i.e. the memory is shared wit the energy ERI's.

SECTION.NAME: RI
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for RI method in HFX (experimental, forces not yet implemented).

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Filter threshold for DBCSR tensor contraction.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER_2C
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Filter threshold for 2c integrals. Default should be kept.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_STORAGE_SCALING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scaling factor to scale EPS_FILTER for storage of 3-center integrals. Storage threshold will be EPS_FILTER*EPS_STORAGE_SCALING.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER_MO
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Filter threshold for contraction of 3-center integrals with MOs. Default should be kept.

KEYWORD.NAME: OMEGA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The range parameter for the short range operator (in 1/a0). Default is OMEGA from INTERACTION_POTENTIAL.

KEYWORD.NAME: CUTOFF_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The cutoff radius (in Angstroms) for the truncated Coulomb operator. Default is CUTOFF_RADIUS from INTERACTION_POTENTIAL.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_NGROUPS
NGROUPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The number of MPI subgroup that work in parallel during the SCF. The default value is 1. Using N subgroups should speed up the calculation by a factor ~N, at the cost of N times more memory usage.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_USE_DELTA_P
USE_DELTA_P
KP_USE_P_DIFF
USE_P_DIFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This kweyword controls whether the KS matrix at each SCF cycle is built by adding the contribution of the denisty difference (wrt to previous step) to the KS matrix of the previous step. As the SCF converges, the density fluctuations get smaller and sparsity increases, leading to faster SCF steps. Not always numerically stable => turn off if SCF struggles to converge.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_STACK_SIZE
STACK_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: When doing contraction over periodic cells of the type: T_mu^a,nu^b,P^c = (mu^a nu^b | Q^d) * (Q^d | P^c), with a,b,c,d labeling cells, there are in principle Ncells contractions taking place. Because a smaller number of contractions involving larger tensors is more efficient, the tensors can be stacked along the d direction. STCK_SIZE controls the size of this stack. Larger stacks are more efficient, but required more memory.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_RI_EXTENSION_FACTOR
RI_EXTENSION_FACTOR
RI_EXT
RI_EXT_FACT
KP_RI_EXT
KP_RI_EXT_FACT
KP_RI_BASIS_EXT
RI_BASIS_EXT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: In KP-RI-HFX, each atom has its own local RI basis. The RI basis is defined by a sphere of radius R centered on the atom, whereby all neighboring atoms within that sphere contribute their RI basis elements. The radius of that sphere is calculated based on the systems' most diffuse orbital PGF (with exponant alpha), such that EPS_PGF_ORB * KP_RI_EXTENSION_FACTOR = exp(-alpha*R^2). The default value of 1.0 is safe. More accurate results can be obtained with a value < 1.0, at greated computational cost.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_RI_BUMP_FACTOR
RI_BUMP
BUMP
BUMP_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: In KP-RI-HFX, the extended RI basis set has a bump radius. All basis elements within that radius contribute with full weight. All basis elements beyond that radius have decaying weight, from 1 at the bump radius, to zero at the RI extension radius. The bump radius is calculated as a fraction of the RI extension radius: bump radius = KP_RI_NUMP_FACTOR * RI extension radius

KEYWORD.NAME: RI_METRIC

ITEM.NAME: HFX
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Same as HFX operator

ITEM.NAME: COULOMB
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Standard Coulomb operator: 1/r

ITEM.NAME: IDENTITY
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Overlap

ITEM.NAME: TRUNCATED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Truncated Coulomb operator: 1/r if (r<R_c), 0 otherwise

ITEM.NAME: SHORTRANGE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Short range: erfc(omega*r)/r

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The type of RI operator. Default is POTENTIAL_TYPE from INTERACTION_POTENTIAL. The standard Coulomb operator cannot be used in periodic systems.

KEYWORD.NAME: 2C_MATRIX_FUNCTIONS

ITEM.NAME: DIAG
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Diagonalization with eigenvalue quenching: stable

ITEM.NAME: CHOLESKY
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Cholesky: not stable in case of ill-conditioned RI basis

ITEM.NAME: ITER
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Iterative algorithms: linear scaling Hotelling's method for inverse and Newton-Schulz iteration for matrix square root

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Methods for matrix inverse and matrix square root.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_EIGVAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Throw away linear combinations of RI basis functions with a small eigenvalue, this is applied only if 2C_MATRIX_FUNCTIONS DIAG

KEYWORD.NAME: CHECK_2C_MATRIX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Report accuracy for the inverse/sqrt of the 2-center integral matrix.

KEYWORD.NAME: CALC_COND_NUM
CALC_CONDITION_NUMBER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Calculate the condition number of integral matrices.

KEYWORD.NAME: SQRT_ORDER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Order of the iteration method for the calculation of the sqrt of 2-center integral matrix.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_PGF_ORB
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets precision of the integral tensors.

KEYWORD.NAME: RI_FLAVOR

ITEM.NAME: MO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: with MO coefficients

ITEM.NAME: RHO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: with density matrix

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Flavor of RI: how to contract 3-center integrals

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_BLOCK_SIZE_MO
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum tensor block size for MOs.

KEYWORD.NAME: MEMORY_CUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Memory reduction factor. This keyword controls the batching of tensor contractions into smaller, more manageable chunks. The details vary depending on the RI_FLAVOR.

KEYWORD.NAME: FLAVOR_SWITCH_MEMORY_CUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Memory reduction factor to be applied upon RI_FLAVOR switching from MO to RHO. The RHO flavor typically requires more memory, and depending on the ressources available, a higher MEMORY_CUT.
