KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the number of replica to take into consideration for the real part of the calculation. Default is letting the qmmm module decide how many replica you really need.

ITEM.NAME: PERIODIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: PERIODIC is only available for fully (3D) periodic systems.

ITEM.NAME: ANALYTIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: ANALYTIC is available for 0D, 1D and 2D periodic solutions using analytical green functions in the g space (slow convergence).

ITEM.NAME: MT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: MT (Martyna Tuckermann) decoupling that interacts only with the nearest neighbor. Beware results are completely wrong if the cell is smaller than twice the cluster size (with electronic density). Available for 0D and 2D systems.

ITEM.NAME: MULTIPOLE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: MULTIPOLE uses a scheme that fits the total charge with one gaussian per atom. Available only for cluster (0D) systems.

ITEM.NAME: WAVELET
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: WAVELET allows for 0D, 2D (but only PERIODIC XZ) and 3D systems. It does not require very large unit cells, only that the density goes to zero on the faces of the cell. The use of PREFERRED_FFT_LIBRARY FFTSG is required.

ITEM.NAME: IMPLICIT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: IMPLICIT allows for 0D, 1D, 2D and 3D systems.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify which kind of solver to use to solve the Poisson equation.

KEYWORD.NAME: PERIODIC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the directions in which PBC apply. Important notice, this only applies to the electrostatics. See the CELL section to specify the periodicity used for e.g. the pair lists. Typically the settings should be the same.

SECTION.NAME: MT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Sets up parameters of Martyna-Tuckerman poisson solver. Note that exact results are only guaranteed if the unit cell is twice as large as charge density (and serious artefacts can result if the cell is much smaller).

KEYWORD.NAME: REL_CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the multiplicative factor for the CUTOFF keyword in MULTI_GRID section. The result gives the cutoff at which the 1/r non-periodic FFT3D is evaluated. Default is 2.0

SECTION.NAME: WAVELET
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Sets up parameters of wavelet based poisson solver.

KEYWORD.NAME: SCF_TYPE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Type of scaling function used in the wavelet approach, the total energy depends on this choice, and the convergence with respect to cutoff depends on the selected scaling functions. Possible values are 8,14,16,20,24,30,40,50,60,100

SECTION.NAME: EWALD
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Ewald parameters controlling electrostatic only for CLASSICAL MM.

KEYWORD.NAME: EWALD_TYPE

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: NONE standard real-space coulomb potential is computed together with the non-bonded contributions

ITEM.NAME: EWALD
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: EWALD is the standard non-fft based ewald

ITEM.NAME: PME
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: PME is the particle mesh using fft interpolation

ITEM.NAME: SPME
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: SPME is the smooth particle mesh using beta-Euler splines (recommended)

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The type of ewald you want to perform.

KEYWORD.NAME: EWALD_ACCURACY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Expected accuracy in the Ewald sum. This number affects only the calculation of the cutoff for the real-space term of the ewald summation (EWALD|PME|SPME) as well as the construction of the neighbor lists (if the cutoff for non-bonded terms is smaller than the value employed to compute the EWALD real-space term). This keyword has no effect on the reciprocal space term (which can be tuned independently).

KEYWORD.NAME: RCUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Explicitly provide the real-space cutoff of the ewald summation (EWALD|PME|SPME). This value is ignored in Tight-binding applications (rcut from basis overlap is used). If present, overwrites the estimate of EWALD_ACCURACY and may affect the construction of the neighbor lists for non-bonded terms (in FIST), if the value specified is larger than the cutoff for non-bonded interactions.

KEYWORD.NAME: ALPHA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: alpha parameter associated with Ewald (EWALD|PME|SPME). Recommended for small systems is alpha = 3.5 / r_cut. For Tight-binding application a recommended value is alpha = 1.0. Tuning alpha, r_cut and gmax is needed to obtain O(N**1.5) scaling for ewald.

KEYWORD.NAME: GMAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: number of grid points (SPME and EWALD). If a single number is specified, the same number of points is used for all three directions on the grid. If three numbers are given, each direction can have a different number of points. The number of points needs to be FFTable (which depends on the library used) and odd for EWALD. The optimal number depends e.g. on alpha and the size of the cell. 1 point per Angstrom is common.

KEYWORD.NAME: NS_MAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: number of grid points on small mesh (PME only), should be odd.

KEYWORD.NAME: O_SPLINE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: order of the beta-Euler spline (SPME only)

KEYWORD.NAME: EPSILON
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: tolerance of gaussians for fft interpolation (PME only)

SECTION.NAME: RS_GRID
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Set options that influence how the realspace grids are being distributed in parallel runs.

ITEM.NAME: AUTOMATIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use heuristic rules to decide between distributed and replicated

ITEM.NAME: DISTRIBUTED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Force a distributed setup if possible

ITEM.NAME: REPLICATED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Force a replicated setup

KEYWORD.NAME: DISTRIBUTION_LAYOUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the number of slices in the x, y and z directions. -1 specifies that any number of slices is OK. If a given distribution can not be satisfied, a replicated grid will result. Also see LOCK_DISTRIBUTION.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_DISTRIBUTED_LEVEL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the multigrid-level of a grid is larger than the parameter, it will not be distributed in the automatic scheme.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOCK_DISTRIBUTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Expert use only, only basic QS deals correctly with a non-default value. If the distribution is locked, a grid will have the same distribution as the next finer multigrid (provided it is distributed). If unlocked, all grids can be distributed freely.

KEYWORD.NAME: MEMORY_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: A grid will only be distributed if the memory usage for that grid (including halo) is smaller than a replicated grid by this parameter.

KEYWORD.NAME: HALO_REDUCTION_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Can be used to reduce the halo of the distributed grid (experimental features).

SECTION.NAME: MULTIPOLES
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Enables the use of multipoles in the treatment of the electrostatics.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Controls the activation of the Multipoles

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_MULTIPOLE_EXPANSION

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: No multipolar terms! Check the codes providing a zero contribution.

ITEM.NAME: CHARGE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use up to the Charge term

ITEM.NAME: DIPOLE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use up to the Dipole term

ITEM.NAME: QUADRUPOLE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use up to the Quadrupole term

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the maximum level of multipoles expansion used for the electrostatics.

KEYWORD.NAME: POL_SCF

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: No inducible multipoles.

ITEM.NAME: SELF_CONSISTENT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Conventional self-consistent iteration.

ITEM.NAME: CONJUGATE_GRADIENT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Linear conjugate-gradient optimization of the sum of the electrostatic and induction energy. This method does not support non-linear polarization but is sometimes faster.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the method to obtain self consistent induced multipole moments.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_IPOL_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the maximum number of iterations for induced dipoles

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_POL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the rmsd threshold for the derivatives of the energy towards the Cartesian dipoles components

SECTION.NAME: IMPLICIT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for the implicit (generalized) Poisson solver.

KEYWORD.NAME: BOUNDARY_CONDITIONS

ITEM.NAME: PERIODIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: periodic boundary conditions

ITEM.NAME: MIXED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Dirichlet + homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions

ITEM.NAME: MIXED_PERIODIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Dirichlet + periodic boundary conditions

ITEM.NAME: NEUMANN
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: homogeneous Neumann BC (zero-average solution)

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the type of boundary conditions. Dirichlet=fixed value, Neumann=zero normal deriv. Mixed and Neumann boundaries essentially requires FFTW3 so that all grid sizes are FFT-able.

KEYWORD.NAME: ZERO_INITIAL_GUESS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether or not to use zero potential as initial guess.

KEYWORD.NAME: OR_PARAMETER
OMEGA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Over-relaxation parameter (large epsilon requires smaller omega ~0.1).

KEYWORD.NAME: NEUMANN_DIRECTIONS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Directions in which homogeneous Neumann conditions are imposed. In the remaining directions periodic conditions will be enforced. Having specified MIXED or NEUMANN as BOUNDARY_CONDITIONS, the keyword is meant to be used to combine periodic and homogeneous Neumann conditions at the boundaries of the simulation cell.

SECTION.NAME: DIELECTRIC
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for the dielectric constant function.

KEYWORD.NAME: DIELECTRIC_CORE_CORRECTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Avoid spurious values of the dielectric constant at the ionic core for pseudopotentials where the electron density goes to zero at the core (e.g. GTH). The correction is based on rho_core.

KEYWORD.NAME: DIELECTRIC_FUNCTION_TYPE

ITEM.NAME: DENSITY_DEPENDENT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Dielectric constant as a function of the electron density as e.g. proposed within the SCCS model.

ITEM.NAME: SPATIALLY_DEPENDENT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Various regions with different dielectric constants.

ITEM.NAME: SPATIALLY_RHO_DEPENDENT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Various regions with different dielectric constants. The dielectric constant decays to 1.0, wherever the electron density is present.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Preferred type for the dielectric constant function.

KEYWORD.NAME: DIELECTRIC_CONSTANT
EPSILON
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Dielectric constant in the bulk of the solvent.

KEYWORD.NAME: DERIVATIVE_METHOD

ITEM.NAME: FFT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: FFT based deriv of epsilon, without correction (high cutoff needed).

ITEM.NAME: FFT_USE_DEPS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: FFT based deriv of epsilon, with correction using gradient of epsilon (high cutoff needed).

ITEM.NAME: FFT_USE_DRHO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: FFT based deriv of epsilon, with correction using gradient of rho (high cutoff needed).

ITEM.NAME: CD3
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: 3-point central difference derivative.

ITEM.NAME: CD5
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: 5-point central difference derivative.

ITEM.NAME: CD7
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: 7-point central difference derivative (recommended).

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Preferred method for evaluating the gradient of ln(eps).

SECTION.NAME: DIELEC_AA_CUBOIDAL
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for creating axis-aligned cuboidal dielectric region. Note that once such a region is defined, the 'background' dielectric constant would be the default (80.0), unless a different value is specified using the keyword IMPLICIT%DIELECTRIC%DIELECTRIC_CONSTANT.

KEYWORD.NAME: DIELECTRIC_CONSTANT
EPSILON
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: value of the dielectric constant inside the region.

KEYWORD.NAME: X_XTNT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The X extents of the cuboid.

KEYWORD.NAME: Y_XTNT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The Y extents of the cuboid.

KEYWORD.NAME: Z_XTNT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The Z extents of the cuboid.

KEYWORD.NAME: SMOOTHING_WIDTH
ZETA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The width of the standard mollifier.

SECTION.NAME: DIELEC_XAA_ANNULAR
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for creating x-axis-aligned annular dielectric region. Note that once such a region is defined, the 'background' dielectric constant would be the default (80.0), unless a different value is specified using the keyword IMPLICIT%DIELECTRIC%DIELECTRIC_CONSTANT.

KEYWORD.NAME: DIELECTRIC_CONSTANT
EPSILON
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: value of the dielectric constant inside the region.

KEYWORD.NAME: X_XTNT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The X extents of the annulus.

KEYWORD.NAME: BASE_CENTER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The y and z coordinates of the annulus' base center.

KEYWORD.NAME: BASE_RADII
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The base radius of the annulus.

KEYWORD.NAME: SMOOTHING_WIDTH
ZETA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The width of the standard mollifier.

SECTION.NAME: DIRICHLET_BC
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for creating Dirichlet type boundary conditions.

KEYWORD.NAME: VERBOSE_OUTPUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Print out the coordinates of the vertices defining Dirichlet regions and their tessellations (in Angstrom), the values of the electrostatic potential at the regions (in a.u.), and their corresponding evaluated Lagrange multipliers.

SECTION.NAME: AA_PLANAR
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for creating axis-aligned planar (rectangular) Dirichlet boundary regions.

KEYWORD.NAME: V_D
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The value of the fixed potential to be imposed at the axis-aligned Dirichlet boundary.

KEYWORD.NAME: OSCILLATING_FRACTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: A fraction of the field can be set to oscilate over time.

KEYWORD.NAME: FREQUENCY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The frequency with which the oscillating fraction oscillates.

KEYWORD.NAME: PHASE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The phase of the oscillattion. A phase of zero corresponds to a cosine function.

KEYWORD.NAME: PARALLEL_PLANE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The coordinate plane that the region is parallel to.

KEYWORD.NAME: INTERCEPT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The intercept of the rectangle's plane.

KEYWORD.NAME: X_XTNT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The X extents of the rectangle.

KEYWORD.NAME: Y_XTNT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The Y extents of the rectangle.

KEYWORD.NAME: Z_XTNT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The Z extents of the rectangle.

KEYWORD.NAME: N_PRTN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The number of partitions in the directions of the unit vectors generating the corresponding PARALLEL_PLANE (e1, e2 or e3) for tiling the rectangluar region.

KEYWORD.NAME: THICKNESS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The thickness of the planar Dirichlet region.

KEYWORD.NAME: SMOOTHING_WIDTH
SIGMA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The width of the transition region between the Dirichlet subdomain and its surrounding.

KEYWORD.NAME: PERIODIC_REGION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether or not to take into consideration the effects of the periodicity of the simulation cell (MIXED_PERIODIC bc) for regions defined sufficiently close to the boundaries.

SECTION.NAME: PLANAR
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for creating planar (rectangular) Dirichlet boundary regions with given vertices.

KEYWORD.NAME: V_D
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The value of the fixed potential to be imposed at the planar Dirichlet boundary.

KEYWORD.NAME: OSCILLATING_FRACTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: A fraction of the field can be set to oscilate over time.

KEYWORD.NAME: FREQUENCY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The frequency with which the oscillating fraction oscillates.

KEYWORD.NAME: PHASE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The phase of the oscillattion. A phase of zero corresponds to a cosine function.

KEYWORD.NAME: N_PRTN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The number of partitions along the edges for tiling the rectangular region. If the edges have different lengths, from the two given values, the larger one will be assigned to the longer edge.

KEYWORD.NAME: THICKNESS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The thickness of the planar Dirichlet region.

KEYWORD.NAME: SMOOTHING_WIDTH
SIGMA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The width of the transition region between the Dirichlet subdomain and its surrounding.

SECTION.NAME: AA_CYLINDRICAL
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for creating axis-aligned cylindrical Dirichlet boundary regions.

KEYWORD.NAME: V_D
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The value of the fixed potential to be imposed at the cylindrical Dirichlet boundary.

KEYWORD.NAME: OSCILLATING_FRACTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: A fraction of the field can be set to oscilate over time.

KEYWORD.NAME: FREQUENCY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The frequency with which the oscillating fraction oscillates.

KEYWORD.NAME: PHASE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The phase of the oscillattion. A phase of zero corresponds to a cosine function.

KEYWORD.NAME: PARALLEL_AXIS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The coordinate axis that the cylindrical region extends along.

KEYWORD.NAME: XTNT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The extents of the cylinder along its central axis.

KEYWORD.NAME: BASE_CENTER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The y and z coordinates (x and z or x and y coordinates, depending on the choice of the parallel axis) of the cylinder's base center.

KEYWORD.NAME: BASE_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The base radius of the cylinder.

KEYWORD.NAME: N_SIDES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The number of sides (faces) of the n-gonal prism approximating the cylinder.

KEYWORD.NAME: APX_TYPE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the type of the n-gonal prism approximating the cylinder.

KEYWORD.NAME: N_PRTN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The number of partitions along the face edges of the prism for tiling. If the edges have different lengths, from the two given values, the larger one will be assigned to the longer edge.

KEYWORD.NAME: SMOOTHING_WIDTH
SIGMA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The width of the transition region between the Dirichlet subdomain and its surrounding.

KEYWORD.NAME: DELTA_ALPHA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: A central angle specifying the gap between the faces of the n-gonal prism. To avoide overlap between the cuboids (of the given thickness) built on top of the faces, a larger value is required if the number of faces (N_SIDES) is quite few and/or the base radius is fairly small.

SECTION.NAME: AA_CUBOIDAL
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for creating axis-aligned cuboidal Dirichlet regions.

KEYWORD.NAME: V_D
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The value of the fixed potential to be imposed at the region.

KEYWORD.NAME: OSCILLATING_FRACTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: A fraction of the field can be set to oscilate over time.

KEYWORD.NAME: FREQUENCY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The frequency with which the oscillating fraction oscillates.

KEYWORD.NAME: PHASE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The phase of the oscillattion. A phase of zero corresponds to a cosine function.

KEYWORD.NAME: X_XTNT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The X extents of the cuboid.

KEYWORD.NAME: Y_XTNT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The Y extents of the cuboid.

KEYWORD.NAME: Z_XTNT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The Z extents of the cuboid.

KEYWORD.NAME: N_PRTN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The number of partitions in the x, y and z directions for partitioning the cuboid.

KEYWORD.NAME: SMOOTHING_WIDTH
SIGMA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The width of the transition region between the Dirichlet subdomain and its surrounding.

KEYWORD.NAME: PERIODIC_REGION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether or not to take into consideration the effects of the periodicity of the simulation cell (MIXED_PERIODIC bc) for regions defined sufficiently close to the boundaries.

SECTION.NAME: CHECK_SPLINE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the checking of the G-space term Spline Interpolation.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: LINK
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Specify information on the QM/MM link treatment

KEYWORD.NAME: QM_INDEX
QM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the index of the QM atom involved in the QM/MM link

KEYWORD.NAME: QM_KIND
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the element of the QM capping atom involved in the QM/MM link

KEYWORD.NAME: MM_INDEX
MM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the index of the MM atom involved in the QM/MM link, Default hydrogen.

KEYWORD.NAME: RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Overwrite the specification of the radius only for the MM atom involved in the link. Default is to use the same radius as for the specified type.

KEYWORD.NAME: CORR_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Overwrite the specification of the correction radius only for the MM atom involved in the link. Default is to use the same correction radius as for the specified type.

KEYWORD.NAME: LINK_TYPE
LINK
TYPE
LTYPE

ITEM.NAME: IMOMM
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use Integrated Molecular Orbital Molecular Mechanics method

ITEM.NAME: GHO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use Generalized Hybrid Orbital method

ITEM.NAME: PSEUDO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use a monovalent pseudo-potential

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the method to use to treat the defined QM/MM link

KEYWORD.NAME: ALPHA_IMOMM
ALPHA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the scaling factor to be used for projecting the forces on the capping hydrogen in the IMOMM QM/MM link scheme to the MM atom of the link. A good guess can be derived from the bond distances of the forcefield: alpha = r_eq(QM-MM) / r_eq(QM-H).

KEYWORD.NAME: QMMM_SCALE_FACTOR
QMMM_CHARGE_SCALE
QMMM_CHARGE_FACTOR
QMMM_SCALE_CHARGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the scaling factor for the MM charge involved in the link QM/MM. This keyword affects only the QM/MM potential, it doesn't affect the electrostatic in the classical part of the code. Default 1.0 i.e. no charge rescaling of the MM atom of the QM/MM link bond.

KEYWORD.NAME: FIST_SCALE_FACTOR
FIST_CHARGE_SCALE
FIST_CHARGE_FACTOR
FIST_SCALE_CHARGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the scaling factor for the MM charge involved in the link QM/MM. This keyword modifies the MM charge in FIST. The modified charge will be used then also for the generation of the QM/MM potential. Default 1.0 i.e. no charge rescaling of the MM atom of the QM/MM link bond.

SECTION.NAME: MOVE_MM_CHARGE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Specify information to move a classical charge before the QM/MM energies and forces evaluation

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOM_INDEX_1
MM1
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the index of the MM atom involved in the QM/MM link to be moved

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOM_INDEX_2
MM2
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the index of the second atom defining the direction along which the atom will be moved

KEYWORD.NAME: ALPHA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the scaling factor that defines the movement along the defined direction

KEYWORD.NAME: RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the radius used for the QM/MM electrostatic coupling after movement

KEYWORD.NAME: CORR_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the correction radius used for the QM/MM electrostatic coupling after movement

SECTION.NAME: ADD_MM_CHARGE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Specify information to add a classical charge before the QM/MM energies and forces evaluation

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOM_INDEX_1
MM1
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the index of the first atom defining the direction along which the atom will be added

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOM_INDEX_2
MM2
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the index of the second atom defining the direction along which the atom will be added

KEYWORD.NAME: ALPHA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the scaling factor that defines the movement along the defined direction

KEYWORD.NAME: RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the radius used for the QM/MM electrostatic coupling for the added source

KEYWORD.NAME: CORR_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the correction radius used for the QM/MM electrostatic coupling for the added source

KEYWORD.NAME: CHARGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the charge for the added source of QM/MM potential

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: kind of interpolation used between the multigrids

KEYWORD.NAME: SAFE_COMPUTATION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: if a non unrolled calculation is to be performed in parallel

KEYWORD.NAME: PRECOND

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_X
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: accuracy on the solution for spline3 the interpolators

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_R
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: accuracy on the residual for spline3 the interpolators

SECTION.NAME: CONV_INFO
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: if convergence information about the linear solver of the spline methods should be printed

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the EPSILON parameter of the LJ potential

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the SIGMA parameter of the LJ potential

KEYWORD.NAME: RCUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the cutoff parameter of the LJ potential

KEYWORD.NAME: RMIN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the lower bound of the potential. If not set the range is the full range generate by the spline

KEYWORD.NAME: RMAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the upper bound of the potential. If not set the range is the full range generate by the spline

SECTION.NAME: WILLIAMS

SECTION.NAME: WALLS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Enables Walls for the QM box. This can be used to avoid that QM atoms move out of the QM box.

KEYWORD.NAME: WALL_SKIN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the value of the skin of the Wall in each dimension. The wall's effect is felt when atoms fall within the skin of the Wall.

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: No Wall around QM box

ITEM.NAME: REFLECTIVE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Reflective Wall around QM box

ITEM.NAME: QUADRATIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Quadratic Wall around QM box

KEYWORD.NAME: K
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the value of the the force constant for the quadratic wall

SECTION.NAME: IMAGE_CHARGE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Inclusion of polarization effects within the image charge approach for systems where QM molecules are physisorbed on e.g. metal surfaces described by MM. This correction introduces only a very small overhead. QM box size has to be equal to MM box size.

KEYWORD.NAME: MM_ATOM_LIST
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: List of MM atoms carrying an induced Gaussian charge. If this keyword is not given, all MM atoms will carry an image charge.

KEYWORD.NAME: WIDTH
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the value of the width of the (induced) Gaussian charge distribution carried by each MM atom.

KEYWORD.NAME: EXT_POTENTIAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: External potential applied to the metal electrode

KEYWORD.NAME: DETERM_COEFF

ITEM.NAME: CALC_MATRIX
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Calculates image matrix and solves linear set of equations

ITEM.NAME: ITERATIVE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Uses an iterative scheme to calculate the coefficients

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies how the coefficients are determined.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_IMAGE_MATRIX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restart the image matrix. Useful when calculating coefficients iteratively (the image matrix is used as preconditioner in that case)

KEYWORD.NAME: IMAGE_RESTART_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: File name where to read the image matrix used as preconditioner in the iterative scheme

KEYWORD.NAME: IMAGE_MATRIX_METHOD

ITEM.NAME: GPW
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Uses Gaussian Plane Wave method [Golze2013]

ITEM.NAME: MME
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Uses MiniMax-Ewald method (ERI_MME subsection)

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Method for calculating the image matrix.

SECTION.NAME: ERI_MME
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for the calculation of periodic electron repulsion integrals (ERI) using the Minimax-Ewald (MME) method. Note: N_MINIMAX is the only parameter to be tuned for accuracy, all other parameters can be left to default. MME method is faster than numerical GPW.

KEYWORD.NAME: N_MINIMAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of terms in minimax approximation of reciprocal space potential.

KEYWORD.NAME: CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: User-defined energy cutoff to be used only if DO_CALIBRATE_CUTOFF is set to .FALSE.

KEYWORD.NAME: SUM_PRECISION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Terms in lattice sums are ignored if absolute value smaller than this value.

KEYWORD.NAME: DO_CALIBRATE_CUTOFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether the energy cutoff shall be calibrated to minimize upper bound error estimate.

KEYWORD.NAME: DO_ERROR_ESTIMATE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether the error due to minimax approx. and cutoff shall be estimated

KEYWORD.NAME: DEBUG
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: debug mode (consistency of summation methods is checked).

KEYWORD.NAME: DEBUG_TOLERANCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: tolerance for rel. numerical error in debug mode.

KEYWORD.NAME: DEBUG_NSUM_MAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: restrict debug mode for non-ortho cells to this number of summands. Sums with more terms are not checked.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: CUTOFF_CALIB
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for the calibration of the energy cutoff by minimizing the errors due to finite cutoff and minimax approximation. Implemented as bisection of error(minimax) - error(cutoff). Not implemented for non-orthorhombic cells.

KEYWORD.NAME: MIN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial guess of lower bound for cutoff.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial guess of upper bound for cutoff.

KEYWORD.NAME: DELTA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Relative widening of cutoff interval in case starting values are not valid.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Relative cutoff precision required to stop calibration.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: BSSE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section is used to set up the BSSE calculation. It also requires that for each atomic kind X a kind X_ghost is present, with the GHOST keyword specified, in addition to the other required fields.

SECTION.NAME: FRAGMENT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Specify the atom number belonging to this fragment.

SECTION.NAME: CONFIGURATION
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Specify additional parameters for the combinatorial configurations. Use this section to manually specify charge and multiplicity of the fragments and their combinations.

KEYWORD.NAME: GLB_CONF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the global configuration using 1 or 0 for each fragment. 1 specifies the respective fragment as used, 0 as unused.

KEYWORD.NAME: SUB_CONF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the subconfiguration using 1 or 0 belonging to the global configuration. 1 specifies the respective fragment as real, 0 as ghost.

KEYWORD.NAME: MULTIPLICITY
MULTIP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify for each fragment the multiplicity. Two times the total spin plus one. Specify 3 for a triplet, 4 for a quartet,and so on. Default is 1 (singlet) for an even number and 2 (doublet) for an odd number of electrons.

KEYWORD.NAME: CHARGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The total charge for each fragment.

SECTION.NAME: FRAGMENT_ENERGIES
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section contains the energies of the fragments already computed. It is useful as a summary and specifically for restarting BSSE runs.

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD

SECTION.NAME: SUBSYS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: a subsystem: coordinates, topology, molecules and cell

KEYWORD.NAME: SEED
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial seed for the (pseudo)random number generator for the Wiener process employed by the Langevin dynamics. Exactly 1 or 6 positive integer values are expected. A single value is replicated to fill up the full seed array with 6 numbers.

SECTION.NAME: RNG_INIT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Information to initialize the parallel random number generator streams

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify an initial RNG stream record

SECTION.NAME: CELL
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Input parameters needed to set up the simulation cell. Simple products and fractions combined with functions of a single number can be used like 2/3, 0.3*COS(60) or -SQRT(3)/2. The functions COS, EXP, LOG, LOG10, SIN, SQRT, and TAN are available.

KEYWORD.NAME: A
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the Cartesian components for the cell vector A. This defines the first column of the h matrix.

KEYWORD.NAME: B
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the Cartesian components for the cell vector B. This defines the second column of the h matrix.

KEYWORD.NAME: C
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the Cartesian components for the cell vector C. This defines the third column of the h matrix.

KEYWORD.NAME: ABC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the lengths of the cell vectors A, B, and C, which defines the diagonal elements of h matrix for an orthorhombic cell. For non-orthorhombic cells it is possible either to specify the angles ALPHA, BETA, GAMMA via ALPHA_BETA_GAMMA keyword or alternatively use the keywords A, B, and C. The convention is that A lies along the X-axis, B is in the XY plane.

KEYWORD.NAME: ALPHA_BETA_GAMMA
ANGLES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the angles between the vectors A, B and C when using the ABC keyword. The convention is that A lies along the X-axis, B is in the XY plane. ALPHA is the angle between B and C, BETA is the angle between A and C and GAMMA the angle between A and B.

SECTION.NAME: COORD
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The coordinates for simple systems (like small QM cells) are specified here by default using explicit XYZ coordinates. Simple products and fractions combined with functions of a single number can be used like 2/3, 0.3*COS(60) or -SQRT(3)/2. More complex systems should be given via an external coordinate file in the SUBSYS%TOPOLOGY section.

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION:
The atomic coordinates in the format:
`ATOMIC_KIND X Y Z MOLNAME`
The `MOLNAME` is optional. If not provided the molecule name is internally created. All other fields after `MOLNAME` are simply ignored.

KEYWORD.NAME: UNIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the unit of measurement for the coordinates in inputAll available CP2K units can be used.

KEYWORD.NAME: SCALED
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify if the coordinates in input are scaled. When true, the coordinates are given in multiples of the lattice vectors.

SECTION.NAME: VELOCITY
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The velocities for simple systems or the centroid mode in PI runs, xyz format by default

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The atomic velocities in the format: $ v_x \ v_y \ v_z$ The same order as for the atomic coordinates is assumed.

KEYWORD.NAME: PINT_UNIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the units of measurement for the velocities (currently works only for the path integral code). All available CP2K units can be used.

SECTION.NAME: KIND
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The description of the kind of the atoms (mostly for QM)

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the kind described in this section.

KEYWORD.NAME: BASIS_SET
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The primary Gaussian basis set (NONE implies no basis used, meaningful with GHOST). Defaults are set for TYPE {ORB} and FORM {GTO}. Possible values for TYPE are {ORB, AUX, MIN, RI_AUX, LRI, ...}. Possible values for FORM are {GTO, STO}. Where STO results in a GTO expansion of a Slater type basis. If a value for FORM is given, also TYPE has to be set explicitly.

KEYWORD.NAME: RI_AUX_BASIS_SET
RI_MP2_BASIS_SET
RI_RPA_BASIS_SET
RI_AUX_BASIS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The RI auxiliary basis set used in WF_CORRELATION (GTO type)

KEYWORD.NAME: LRI_BASIS_SET
LRI_BASIS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The local resolution of identity basis set (GTO type)

KEYWORD.NAME: AUX_FIT_BASIS_SET
AUXILIARY_FIT_BASIS_SET
AUX_FIT_BASIS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The auxiliary basis set (GTO type) for auxiliary density matrix method

KEYWORD.NAME: ELEC_CONF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the electronic configuration used in construction the atomic initial guess (see the pseudo potential file for the default values).

KEYWORD.NAME: MAGNETIZATION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The magnetization used in the atomic initial guess. Adds magnetization/2 spin-alpha electrons and removes magnetization/2 spin-beta electrons.

KEYWORD.NAME: ELEMENT
ELEMENT_SYMBOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The element of the actual kind (if not given it is inferred from the kind name)

KEYWORD.NAME: MASS
ATOMIC_MASS
ATOMIC_WEIGHT
WEIGHT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The mass of the atom (if negative or non present it is inferred from the element symbol)

KEYWORD.NAME: POTENTIAL_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The name of the file where to find this kinds pseudopotential. Default file is specified in DFT section.

KEYWORD.NAME: POTENTIAL_TYPE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The type of this kinds pseudopotential (ECP, ALL, GTH, UPS).

KEYWORD.NAME: POTENTIAL
POT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The type (ECP, ALL, GTH, UPS) and name of the pseudopotential for the defined kind.

KEYWORD.NAME: KG_POTENTIAL_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The name of the file where to find this kinds KG potential. Default file is specified in DFT section.

KEYWORD.NAME: KG_POTENTIAL
KG_POT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The name of the non-additive atomic kinetic energy potential.

KEYWORD.NAME: ECP_SEMI_LOCAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use ECPs in the original semi-local form. This requires the availability of the corresponding integral library. If set to False, a fully nonlocal one-center expansion of the ECP is constructed.

KEYWORD.NAME: COVALENT_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use this covalent radius (in Angstrom) for all atoms of the atomic kind instead of the internally tabulated default value

KEYWORD.NAME: VDW_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use this van der Waals radius (in Angstrom) for all atoms of the atomic kind instead of the internally tabulated default value

KEYWORD.NAME: HARD_EXP_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The region where the hard density is supposed to be confined (GAPW) (in Bohr, default is 1.2 for H and 1.512 otherwise)

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_RAD_LOCAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Max radius for the basis functions used to generate the local projectors in GAPW [Bohr]

KEYWORD.NAME: RHO0_EXP_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: the radius which defines the atomic region where the hard compensation density is confined. should be less than HARD_EXP_RADIUS (GAPW) (Bohr, default equals HARD_EXP_RADIUS)

KEYWORD.NAME: LEBEDEV_GRID
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The number of points for the angular part of the local grid (GAPW)

KEYWORD.NAME: RADIAL_GRID
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The number of points for the radial part of the local grid (GAPW)

KEYWORD.NAME: MM_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the radius of the electrostatic multipole of the atom in Fist. This radius applies to the charge, the dipole and the quadrupole. When zero, the atom is treated as a point multipole, otherwise it is treated as a Gaussian charge distribution with the given radius: p(x,y,z)*N*exp(-(x**2+y**2+z**2)/(2*MM_RADIUS**2)), where N is a normalization constant. In the core-shell model, only the shell is treated as a Gaussian and the core is always a point charge.

KEYWORD.NAME: DFTB3_PARAM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The third order parameter (derivative of hardness) used in diagonal DFTB3 correction.

KEYWORD.NAME: LMAX_DFTB
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The maximum l-quantum number of the DFTB basis for this kind.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAO
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The number of MAOs (Modified Atomic Orbitals) for this kind.

KEYWORD.NAME: SE_P_ORBITALS_ON_H
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Forces the usage of p-orbitals on H for SEMI-EMPIRICAL calculations. This keyword applies only when the KIND is specifying an Hydrogen element. It is ignored in all other cases.

KEYWORD.NAME: GPW_TYPE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Force one type to be treated by the GPW scheme, whatever are its primitives, even if the GAPW method is used

KEYWORD.NAME: GHOST
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keyword makes all atoms of this kind ghost atoms, i.e. without pseudo or nuclear charge. Useful to just have the basis set at that position (e.g. BSSE calculations), or to have a non-interacting particle with BASIS_SET NONE

KEYWORD.NAME: FLOATING_BASIS_CENTER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keyword makes all atoms of this kind floating functions, i.e. without pseudo or nuclear charge which are subject to a geometry optimization in the outer SCF.

KEYWORD.NAME: NO_OPTIMIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Skip optimization of this type (used in specific basis set or potential optimization schemes)

KEYWORD.NAME: PAO_BASIS_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The block size used for the polarized atomic orbital basis. Setting PAO_BASIS_SIZE to the size of the primary basis or to a value below one will disables the PAO method for the given atomic kind. By default PAO is disbabled.

SECTION.NAME: PAO_POTENTIAL
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Settings of the PAO potentials, which are atomic kind specific.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAXL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum angular moment of the potential (must be an even number).

KEYWORD.NAME: BETA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Exponent of the Gaussian potential term.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_PROJECTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum angular moment of the potential's projectors. Used only by the GTH parametrization

SECTION.NAME: PAO_DESCRIPTOR
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Settings of the PAO descriptor, which are atomic kind specific.

KEYWORD.NAME: BETA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Exponent of the Gaussian potential term.

SECTION.NAME: BASIS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section used to specify a general basis set for QM calculations.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: The type of basis set defined in this section.

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION:
CP2K Basis Set Standard Format:
``` Element symbol Name of the basis set Alias names nset (repeat the following block of lines nset times) n lmin lmax nexp nshell(lmin) nshell(lmin+1) ... nshell(lmax-1) nshell(lmax) a(1) c(1,l,1) c(1,l,2) ... c(1,l,nshell(l)-1) c(1,l,nshell(l)), l=lmin,lmax a(2) c(2,l,1) c(2,l,2) ... c(2,l,nshell(l)-1) c(2,l,nshell(l)), l=lmin,lmax . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . a(nexp-1) c(nexp-1,l,1) c(nexp-1,l,2) ... c(nexp-1,l,nshell(l)-1) c(nexp-1,l,nshell(l)), l=lmin,lmax a(nexp) c(nexp,l,1) c(nexp,l,2) ... c(nexp,l,nshell(l)-1) c(nexp,l,nshell(l)), l=lmin,lmax
nset : Number of exponent sets n : Principle quantum number (only for orbital label printing) lmax : Maximum angular momentum quantum number l lmin : Minimum angular momentum quantum number l nshell(l): Number of shells for angular momentum quantum number l a : Exponent c : Contraction coefficient ```

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: CP2K Pseudo Potential Standard Format (GTH, ALL)

SECTION.NAME: KG_POTENTIAL
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section used to specify KG Potentials.

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: CP2K KG TNADD Potential Standard Format (TNADD)

SECTION.NAME: DFT_PLUS_U
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Define the parameters for a DFT+U run

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Controls the activation of the DFT+U section

KEYWORD.NAME: L
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Angular momentum quantum number of the orbitals to which the correction is applied

KEYWORD.NAME: N
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: principal quantum number of the orbitals to which the correction is applied. Ignored unless pwdft is used for the calculations

KEYWORD.NAME: U
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: U parameter in the theory of Dudarev et al. Ignored unless pwdft is used

KEYWORD.NAME: J
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: J parameter in the theory of Dudarev et al. Ignored unless pwdft is used

KEYWORD.NAME: ALPHA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: alpha parameter in the theory of Dudarev et al. Ignored unless pwdft is used

KEYWORD.NAME: BETA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: beta parameter in the theory of Dudarev et al. Ignored unless pwdft is used

KEYWORD.NAME: J0
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: J0 parameter in the theory of Dudarev et al. Ignored unless pwdft is used

KEYWORD.NAME: OCCUPATION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: number of electrons in the hubbard shell. Ignored unless pwdft is used

KEYWORD.NAME: U_RAMPING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Increase the effective U parameter stepwise using the specified increment until the target value given by U_MINUS_J is reached.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_U_RAMPING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Threshold value (SCF convergence) for incrementing the effective U value when U ramping is active.

KEYWORD.NAME: INIT_U_RAMPING_EACH_SCF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Set the initial U ramping value to zero before each wavefunction optimisation. The default is to apply U ramping only for the initial wavefunction optimisation.

SECTION.NAME: ENFORCE_OCCUPATION
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Enforce and control a special (initial) orbital occupation. Note, this feature works only for the methods MULLIKEN and LOWDIN. It should only be used to prepare an initial configuration. An inadequate parameter choice can easily inhibit SCF convergence.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Controls the activation of the ENFORCE_OCCUPATION section

KEYWORD.NAME: NELEC
N_ELECTRONS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of alpha and beta electrons. An occupation (per spin) smaller than 0.5 is ignored.

KEYWORD.NAME: ORBITALS
M
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Select orbitals and occupation order. An input of 1 to 2*L+1 integer values in the range -L to L defining the M values of the spherical orbitals is expected.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_SCF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The occupation constraint is enforced until this threshold value for the SCF convergence criterion is reached

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_SCF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The occupation constraint is applied for this number of initial SCF iterations

KEYWORD.NAME: SMEAR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The occupation constraint is applied with smearing

SECTION.NAME: BS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Define the required atomic orbital occupation assigned in initialization of the density matrix, by adding or subtracting electrons from specific angular momentum channels. It works only with GUESS ATOMIC.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: controls the activation of the BS section

KEYWORD.NAME: NEL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Orbital ccupation change per angular momentum quantum number. In unrestricted calculations applied to spin alpha.

KEYWORD.NAME: L
L
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Angular momentum quantum number of the orbitals whose occupation is changed

KEYWORD.NAME: N
N
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Principal quantum number of the orbitals whose occupation is changed. Default is the first not occupied

KEYWORD.NAME: NEL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Orbital ccupation change per angular momentum quantum number. Applied to spin beta and active only in unrestricted calculations.

KEYWORD.NAME: L
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Angular momentum quantum number of the orbitals of beta spin whose occupation is changed. Active only for unrestricted calculations

KEYWORD.NAME: N
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Principal quantum number of the orbitals of beta spin whose occupation is changed. Default is the first not occupied. Active only for unrestricted calculations

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section specifying information regarding how to handle the topology for classical runs.

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_ELEMENT_AS_KIND

CHARGE_O

KEYWORD.NAME: CHARGE_BETA

KEYWORD.NAME: MOL_CHECK

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_G96_VELOCITY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use the velocities in the G96 coordinate files as the starting velocity

KEYWORD.NAME: COORD_FILE_NAME
COORD_FILE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the filename that contains coordinates.

KEYWORD.NAME: COORD_FILE_FORMAT
COORDINATE

ITEM.NAME: OFF

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Coordinates provided through an XYZ file format

ITEM.NAME: G96

ITEM.NAME: CRD

ITEM.NAME: CIF

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Coordinates provided through a XTL (MSI native) file format

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Set up the way in which coordinates will be read.

NATOMS
NATOM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Optionally define the number of atoms read from an external file (see COORD_FILE_NAME) if the COORD_FILE_FORMAT CP2K is used

KEYWORD.NAME: CONN_FILE_NAME
CONN_FILE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the filename that contains the molecular connectivity.

KEYWORD.NAME: CONN_FILE_FORMAT
CONNECTIVITY

ITEM.NAME: PSF
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use a PSF file to determine the connectivity. (support standard CHARMM/XPLOR and EXT CHARMM)

ITEM.NAME: UPSF
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Read a PSF file in an unformatted way (useful for not so standard PSF).

ITEM.NAME: MOL_SET
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use multiple PSF (for now...) files to generate the whole system.

ITEM.NAME: GENERATE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use a simple distance criteria. (Look at keyword BONDPARM)

ITEM.NAME: OFF
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not generate molecules. (e.g. for QS or ill defined systems)

ITEM.NAME: G87
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use GROMOS G87 topology file.

ITEM.NAME: G96
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use GROMOS G96 topology file.

ITEM.NAME: AMBER
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use AMBER topology file for reading connectivity (compatible starting from AMBER V.7)

ITEM.NAME: USER
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Allows the definition of molecules and residues based on the 5th and 6th column of the COORD section. This option can be handy for the definition of molecules with QS or to save memory in the case of very large systems (use PARA_RES off).

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Ways to determine and generate a molecules. Default is to use GENERATE

KEYWORD.NAME: DISABLE_EXCLUSION_LISTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Do not build any exclusion lists.

KEYWORD.NAME: EXCLUDE_VDW
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies which kind of Van der Waals interaction to skip.

KEYWORD.NAME: EXCLUDE_EI
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies which kind of Electrostatic interaction to skip.

KEYWORD.NAME: AUTOGEN_EXCLUDE_LISTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: When True, the exclude lists are solely based on the bond data in the topology. The (minimal) number of bonds between two atoms is used to determine if the atom pair is added to an exclusion list. When False, 1-2 exclusion is based on bonds in the topology, 1-3 exclusion is based on bonds and bends in the topology, 1-4 exclusion is based on bonds, bends and dihedrals in the topology. This implies that a missing dihedral in the topology will cause the corresponding 1-4 pair not to be in the exclusion list, in case 1-4 exclusion is requested for VDW or EI interactions.

KEYWORD.NAME: MULTIPLE_UNIT_CELL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the numbers of repetition in space (X, Y, Z) of the defined cell, assuming it as a unit cell. This keyword affects only the coordinates specification. The same keyword in SUBSYS%CELL%MULTIPLE_UNIT_CELL should be modified in order to affect the cell specification.

KEYWORD.NAME: MEMORY_PROGRESSION_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keyword is quite technical and should normally not be changed by the user. It affects the memory allocation during the construction of the topology. It does NOT affect the memory used once the topology is built.

SECTION.NAME: DUMP_PDB
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: controls the dumping of the PDB at the starting geometry

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section to define functions between two distances as collective variables. The function is defined as d1+coeff*d2

SECTION.NAME: RMSD
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section to define a CV as function of RMSD computed with respect to given reference configurations. For 2 configurations the colvar is equal to: ss = (RMSDA-RMSDB)/(RMSDA+RMSDB), while if only 1 configuration is given, then the colvar is just the RMSD from that frame.

KEYWORD.NAME: SUBSET_TYPE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Define the subsytem used to compute the RMSD

KEYWORD.NAME: ALIGN_FRAMES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether the reference frames should be aligned to minimize the RMSD

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify indexes of atoms building the subset.

KEYWORD.NAME: WEIGHTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify weights of atoms building the subset.

SECTION.NAME: FRAME
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Specify coordinates of the frame (number of frames can be either 1 or 2)

KEYWORD.NAME: COORD_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the xyz file with coordinates (alternative to &COORD section)

SECTION.NAME: COORD
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The positions for RMSD used for restart

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify positions of the system

SECTION.NAME: XYZ_DIAG
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section to define the distance of an atom from its starting position ((X-X(0))^2+(Y-Y(0))^2+(Z-Z(0))^2) or part of its components as a collective variable. If absolute_position is specified, instead the CV is represented by the instantaneous position of the atom (only available for X, Y or Z components).

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOM
POINT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the index of the atom/point.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMPONENT
KEYWORD.USAGE: AXIS (XYZ | X | Y | Z | XY| XZ | YZ)
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Define the component of the position vector which will be used as a colvar.

KEYWORD.NAME: PBC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether periodic boundary conditions should be applied on the atomic position before computing the colvar or not.

KEYWORD.NAME: ABSOLUTE_POSITION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If enabled, the absolute position of the atoms will be used.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMPONENT_B

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Define the component of the position vector which will be used as a colvar for atom B.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether periodic boundary conditions should be applied on the atomic position before computing the colvar or not.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the variables of the functional form. To allow an efficient mapping the order of the energy variables will be considered identical to the order of the force_eval in the force_eval_order list.

SECTION.NAME: REACTION_PATH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section defining a one dimensional reaction path in an Q-dimensional space of colvars. Constraining this colvar, allows to sample the space orthogonal to the reaction path, both in the Q-dimensional colvar and 3N-Q remaining coordinates. For the details of the function see cited literature.

KEYWORD.NAME: SUBSET_TYPE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Define the subsytem used to compute the RMSD

KEYWORD.NAME: ALIGN_FRAMES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether the reference frames should be aligned to minimize the RMSD

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify indexes of atoms building the subset.

KEYWORD.NAME: FUNCTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the ith element of the vector valued function that defines the reaction path. This keyword needs to repeat exactly Q times, and the order must match the order of the colvars. The VARIABLE (e.g. T) which parametrises the curve can be used as the target of a constraint.

KEYWORD.NAME: VARIABLE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the name of the variable that parametrises the FUNCTION defining the reaction path.

KEYWORD.NAME: LAMBDA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the exponent of the Gaussian used in the integral representation of the colvar. The shape of the space orthogonal to the reaction path is defined by this choice. In the limit of large values, it is given by the plane orthogonal to the path. In practice, modest values are required for stable numerical integration.

KEYWORD.NAME: STEP_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Step size in the numerical integration, a few thousand points are common, and the proper number also depends on LAMBDA.

KEYWORD.NAME: RANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The range of VARIABLE used for the parametrisation.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: DISTANCE_FROM_PATH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section defining the distance from a one dimensional reaction path in an Q-dimensional space of colvars. Constraining this colvar, allows to sample the space equidistant to the reaction path, both in the Q-dimensional colvar and 3N-Q remaining coordinates. For the details of the function see cited literature.

KEYWORD.NAME: SUBSET_TYPE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Define the subsytem used to compute the RMSD

KEYWORD.NAME: ALIGN_FRAMES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether the reference frames should be aligned to minimize the RMSD

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify indexes of atoms building the subset.

KEYWORD.NAME: FUNCTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the ith element of the vector valued function that defines the reaction path. This keyword needs to repeat exactly Q times, and the order must match the order of the colvars. The VARIABLE (e.g. T) which parametrises the curve can be used as the target of a constraint.

KEYWORD.NAME: VARIABLE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the name of the variable that parametrises the FUNCTION defining the reaction path.

KEYWORD.NAME: LAMBDA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the exponent of the Gaussian used in the integral representation of the colvar. The shape of the space orthogonal to the reaction path is defined by this choice. In the limit of large values, it is given by the plane orthogonal to the path. In practice, modest values are required for stable numerical integration.

KEYWORD.NAME: STEP_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Step size in the numerical integration, a few thousand points are common, and the proper number also depends on LAMBDA.

KEYWORD.NAME: RANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The range of VARIABLE used for the parametrisation.

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section to define a CV as function of RMSD computed with respect to given reference configurations. For 2 configurations the colvar is equal to: ss = (RMSDA-RMSDB)/(RMSDA+RMSDB), while if only 1 configuration is given, then the colvar is just the RMSD from that frame.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether the reference frames should be aligned to minimize the RMSD

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify indexes of atoms building the subset.

KEYWORD.NAME: WEIGHTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify weights of atoms building the subset.

SECTION.NAME: FRAME
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Specify coordinates of the frame (number of frames can be either 1 or 2)

SECTION.NAME: COORD
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The positions for RMSD used for restart

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify positions of the system

If absolute_position is specified, instead the CV is represented by the instantaneous position of the atom (only available for X, Y or Z components).

POINT

SECTION.NAME: PRINT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of the colvar specifications

SECTION.NAME: PROGRAM_RUN_INFO
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of basic information during colvar setup.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets the value of the denominator of the exponential factor in the coordination function: number of oxygens per water oxygen.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the rc parameter in the coordination function: number of hydrogens per water molecule.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets the value of the numerator of the exponential factor in the coordination function: number of hydrogens per water molecule.

KEYWORD.NAME: QOH
EXPON_DENOMINATORB
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets the value of the denominator of the exponential factor in the coordination function: number of hydrogens per water molecule.

KEYWORD.NAME: NH
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the NH parameter in the M function.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets the value of the numerator of the exponential factor in the M function.

SECTION.NAME: RMSD
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section to define a CV as function of RMSD computed with respect to given reference configurations. For 2 configurations the colvar is equal to: ss = (RMSDA-RMSDB)/(RMSDA+RMSDB), while if only 1 configuration is given, then the colvar is just the RMSD from that frame.

KEYWORD.NAME: SUBSET_TYPE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Define the subsytem used to compute the RMSD

KEYWORD.NAME: ALIGN_FRAMES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether the reference frames should be aligned to minimize the RMSD

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify indexes of atoms building the subset.

KEYWORD.NAME: WEIGHTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify weights of atoms building the subset.

SECTION.NAME: FRAME
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Specify coordinates of the frame (number of frames can be either 1 or 2)

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the xyz file with coordinates (alternative to &COORD section)

SECTION.NAME: COORD
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The positions for RMSD used for restart

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify positions of the system

SECTION.NAME: XYZ_DIAG
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section to define the distance of an atom from its starting position ((X-X(0))^2+(Y-Y(0))^2+(Z-Z(0))^2) or part of its components as a collective variable. If absolute_position is specified, instead the CV is represented by the instantaneous position of the atom (only available for X, Y or Z components).

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOM
POINT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the index of the atom/point.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMPONENT
KEYWORD.USAGE: AXIS (XYZ | X | Y | Z | XY| XZ | YZ)
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Define the component of the position vector which will be used as a colvar.

KEYWORD.NAME: PBC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether periodic boundary conditions should be applied on the atomic position before computing the colvar or not.

KEYWORD.NAME: ABSOLUTE_POSITION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If enabled, the absolute position of the atoms will be used.

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the indexes of atoms defining the geometrical center

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the weights for a weighted geometrical center. Default is 1/natoms for every atom

KEYWORD.NAME: XYZ
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the xyz of the fixed point (if the case)

SECTION.NAME: XYZ_OUTERDIAG
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section to define the cross term (XA-XA(0))*(XB-XB(0))+(XA-XA(0))*(YB-YB(0)) or part of its components as a collective variable. The final term is given by the product of the components of A with the components of B.

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOMS
POINTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the index of the atoms/points A and B.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMPONENT_A
KEYWORD.USAGE: AXIS (XYZ | X | Y | Z | XY| XZ | YZ)
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Define the component of the position vector which will be used as a colvar for atom A.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMPONENT_B
KEYWORD.USAGE: AXIS (XYZ | X | Y | Z | XY| XZ | YZ)
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Define the component of the position vector which will be used as a colvar for atom B.

KEYWORD.NAME: PBC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Whether periodic boundary conditions should be applied on the atomic position before computing the colvar or not.

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of basic information during colvar setup.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

The `ATOMIC_INDEX` refers to the atom the core particle belongs to.

KEYWORD.NAME: UNIT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the unit of measurement for the coordinates in inputAll available CP2K units can be used.

KEYWORD.NAME: SCALED
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify if the coordinates in input are scaled. When true, the coordinates are given in multiples of the lattice vectors.

SECTION.NAME: CORE_VELOCITY
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The velocities of cores for shell-model potentials, in xyz format

DEFAULT_KEYWORD.NAME: DEFAULT_KEYWORD
DEFAULT_KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The core particle velocities in the format: $v_x \ v_y \ v_z$ The same order as for the core particle coordinates is assumed.

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.
