SECTION.NAME: CANONICAL_GRADIENTS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters influencing gradient calculations of canonical RI methods. Ignored if the IM_TIME section is set.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_CANONICAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Threshold under which a given ij or ab pair is considered to be degenerate and its contribution to the density matrix is calculated directly. Ignored in case of energy-only calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: FREE_HFX_BUFFER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Free the buffer containing the 4 center integrals used in the Hartree-Fock exchange calculation. This will be effective only for gradients calculations, since for the energy only case, the buffers are released by default. (Right now debugging only).

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_OLD_GRADIENT_CODE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use the original RI-MP2 gradient code.

KEYWORD.NAME: DOT_PRODUCT_BLKSIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Dot products for the calculation of the RPA/SOS-MP2 density matrices are calculated in batches of the size given by this keyword. Larger block sizes improve the performance but reduce the numerical accuracy. Recommended block sizes are multiples of the number of doubles per cache line (usually 8). Ignored with MP2 gradients. Set it to -1 to prevent blocking.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_PARALLEL_COMM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets the maximum number of parallel communication steps of the non-blocking communication scheme. The number of channels is determined from the available memory. If set to a value smaller than one, CP2K will use all memory for communication. A value of one enforces the blocking communication scheme increasing the communication costs.

SECTION.NAME: CPHF
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters influencing the solution of the Z-vector equations in MP2 gradients calculations.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ITER
MAX_NUM_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of iterations allowed for the solution of the Z-vector equations.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_EVERY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restart iteration every given number of steps.

KEYWORD.NAME: SOLVER_METHOD

ITEM.NAME: POPLE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Pople's method (Default).

ITEM.NAME: CG
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Conjugated gradient method (equivalent to Pople).

ITEM.NAME: RICHARDSON
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Richardson iteration

ITEM.NAME: SD
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Steepest Descent iteration

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Chose solver of the z-vector equations.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_CONV
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence threshold for the solution of the Z-vector equations. The Z-vector equations have the form of a linear system of equations Ax=b, convergence is achieved when |Ax-b|<=EPS_CONV.

KEYWORD.NAME: ENFORCE_DECREASE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts if residual does not decrease.

KEYWORD.NAME: DO_POLAK_RIBIERE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use a Polak-Ribiere update of the search vector in CG instead of the Fletcher Reeves update. Improves the convergence with modified step sizes. Ignored with other methods than CG.

Calculating the pseudoinverse is necessary for very large auxiliary basis sets, but more expensive. Using the pseudoinverse, consistent forces are not guaranteed yet.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_CONDITION_NUM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If AUTOSELECT is chosen for LRI_OVERLAP_MATRIX, this keyword specifies that the pseudoinverse is calculated only if the LOG of the condition number of the lri overlap matrix is larger than the given value.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_O3_INT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Threshold for ABA and ABB integrals in LRI. This is used for screening in the KS and force calculations (tensor contractions).

KEYWORD.NAME: DEBUG_LRI_INTEGRALS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Debug the integrals needed for LRIGPW.

KEYWORD.NAME: EXACT_1C_TERMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Don't use LRI for one center densities.

KEYWORD.NAME: RI_STATISTIC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Print statistical information on the RI calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: DISTANT_PAIR_APPROXIMATION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Calculate distant pairs using an independent atom approximation.

KEYWORD.NAME: DISTANT_PAIR_METHOD
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Method used to separate pair density for distant pairs. Options: EW (equal weights); AW (atomic weights); SW (set weights); LW (shell function weights)

KEYWORD.NAME: DISTANT_PAIR_RADII
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Inner and outer radii used in distant pair separation. Smooth interpolation between inner and outer radius is used.

KEYWORD.NAME: SHG_LRI_INTEGRALS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Uses the SHG (solid harmonic Gaussian) integral scheme instead of Obara-Saika

KEYWORD.NAME: RI_SINV
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Approximation to be used for the inverse of the RI overlap matrix. INVF, INVS: exact inverse, apply directly for solver (F:full matrix, S:sparsematrix). AINV approximate inverse, use with PCG. NONE: no approximation used with CG solver.

SECTION.NAME: LINRES
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: The linear response is used to calculate one of the following properties: nmr, epr, raman, ...

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: target accuracy for the convergence of the conjugate gradient.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Filter threshold for response density matrix.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of conjugate gradient iteration to be performed for one optimization.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_EVERY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restart the conjugate gradient after the specified number of iterations.

KEYWORD.NAME: PRECONDITIONER

ITEM.NAME: FULL_ALL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Most effective state selective preconditioner based on diagonalization, requires the ENERGY_GAP parameter to be an underestimate of the HOMO-LUMO gap. This preconditioner is recommended for almost all systems, except very large systems where make_preconditioner would dominate the total computational cost.

ITEM.NAME: FULL_SINGLE_INVERSE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Based on H-eS cholesky inversion, similar to FULL_SINGLE in preconditioning efficiency but cheaper to construct, might be somewhat less robust. Recommended for large systems.

ITEM.NAME: FULL_SINGLE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Based on H-eS diagonalisation, not as good as FULL_ALL, but somewhat cheaper to apply.

ITEM.NAME: FULL_KINETIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Cholesky inversion of S and T, fast construction, robust, and relatively good, use for very large systems.

ITEM.NAME: FULL_S_INVERSE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Cholesky inversion of S, not as good as FULL_KINETIC, yet equally expensive.

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: skip preconditioning

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Type of preconditioner to be used with all minimization schemes. They differ in effectiveness, cost of construction, cost of application. Properly preconditioned minimization can be orders of magnitude faster than doing nothing.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restart the response calculation if the restart file exists

KEYWORD.NAME: WFN_RESTART_FILE_NAME
RESTART_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Root of the file names where to read the response functions from which to restart the calculation of the linear response

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of the banner for TDDFPT program

SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: BANDSTRUCTURE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters needed to set up a calculation for electronic level energies of molecules and the electronic band structure of materials from post-SCF schemes (GW, perturbative spin-orbit coupling). Also, the density of states (DOS), projected density of states (PDOS), local density of states (LDOS), local valence band maximum (LVBM), local conduction band minimum (LCBM) and local band gap can be calculated. Please note that all methods in this section start from a Gamma-only DFT SCF. You need to make sure that the cell chosen in the DFT SCF is converged in the cell size. Band structures are computed for the primitive cell (i.e. the smallest possible unit cell of the input structure which is detected automatically). Moreover, spin-orbit coupling (SOC) on eigenvalues and band structures is available using Hartwigsen-Goedecker-Hutter pseudopotentials.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Controls the activation of the band structure calculation.

SECTION.NAME: BANDSTRUCTURE_PATH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Specifies a k-point line to be calculated.

KEYWORD.NAME: SPECIAL_POINT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name and coordinates of a special k-point

KEYWORD.NAME: NPOINTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of k-points along the line.

KEYWORD.NAME: UNITS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Special k-points are defined either in units of reciprocal lattice vectors or in Cartesian coordinates in uints of 2Pi/len. B_VECTOR: in multiples of the reciprocal lattice vectors (b). CART_ANGSTROM: In units of 2*Pi/Angstrom. CART_BOHR: In units of 2*Pi/Bohr.

SECTION.NAME: GW
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters needed to set up a GW calculation for electronic level energies of molecules and the band structure of materials (currently only 2D materials tested). For the GW algorithm for molecules, see <https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jctc.0c01282>. For 2D materials, see <http://arxiv.org/abs/2306.16066>.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Controls the activation of the GW calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: NUM_TIME_FREQ_POINTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of discrete points for the imaginary-time grid and the imaginary-frequency grid. The more points, the more precise is the calculation. Typically, 10 points are good for 0.1 eV precision of band structures and molecular energy levels, 20 points for 0.03 eV precision, and 30 points for 0.01 eV precision, see Table I in <https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jctc.0c01282>. GW computation time increases linearly with `NUM_TIME_FREQ_POINTS`.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines a threshold for the DBCSR based sparse multiplications. Normally, `EPS_FILTER` determines accuracy and timing of low-scaling GW calculations. (Lower filter means higher numerical precision, but higher computational cost.)

KEYWORD.NAME: MEMORY_PER_PROC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the available memory per MPI process. Set `MEMORY_PER_PROC` as accurately as possible for good performance. If `MEMORY_PER_PROC` is set lower as the actually available memory per MPI process, the performance will be bad; if `MEMORY_PER_PROC` is set higher as the actually available memory per MPI process, the program might run out of memory. You can calculate `MEMORY_PER_PROC` as follows: Get the memory per node on your machine, mem_per_node (for example, from a supercomputer website, typically between 100 GB and 2 TB), get the number of MPI processes per node, n_MPI_proc_per_node (for example from your run-script; if you use slurm, the number behind '--ntasks-per-node' is the number of MPI processes per node). Then calculate `MEMORY_PER_PROC` = mem_per_node / n_MPI_proc_per_node (typically between 2 GB and 50 GB). Unit of keyword: Gigabyte (GB).

KEYWORD.NAME: APPROX_KP_EXTRAPOL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If true, use only a 4x4 kpoint mesh for frequency points $\omega_j, j \ge 2$ (instead of a 4x4 and 6x6 k-point mesh). The k-point extrapolation of $W_{PQ}(i\omega_j,\mathbf{q})$ is done approximately from $W_{PQ}(i\omega_1,\mathbf{q})$.

SECTION.NAME: SOC
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Switch on or off spin-orbit coupling. Use SOC parameters from non-local pseudopotentials as given in Hartwigsen, Goedecker, Hutter, Eq.(18), (19), <https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevB.58.3641>, $V_{\mu\nu}^{\mathrm{SOC}, (\alpha)} = (\hbar/2) \langle \phi_\mu | \sum_l \Delta V_l^\mathrm{SO}(\mathbf{r},\mathbf{r}') L^{(\alpha)} | \phi_\nu \rangle, \alpha = x, y, z$.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Controls the activation of the SOC calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: ENERGY_WINDOW
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Apply SOC only for states with eigenvalues in the interval $[\varepsilon_\mathrm{VBM}-E_\mathrm{window}/2, \varepsilon_\mathrm{CBM}+E_\mathrm{window}/2]$. Might be necessary to use for large systems to prevent numerical instabilities.

SECTION.NAME: DOS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters needed to calculate the density of states (DOS) and the projected density of states (PDOS).

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Controls the activation of the DOS calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: ENERGY_WINDOW
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Print DOS and PDOS in the energy window $[\varepsilon_\mathrm{VBM}-E_\mathrm{window}/2, \varepsilon_\mathrm{CBM}+E_\mathrm{window}/2]$, where VBM is the valence band maximum (or highest occupied molecular orbital, HOMO, for molecules) and CBM the conduction band minimum (or lowest unoccupied molecular orbital, LUMO, for molecules).

KEYWORD.NAME: ENERGY_STEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Resolution of the energy E when computing the $\rho(E)$.

KEYWORD.NAME: BROADENING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Broadening α in Gaussians used in the DOS; $\rho(E) = \sum_n \exp(((E-\varepsilon_n)/\alpha)^2)/( \sqrt{2\pi} \alpha)$.

KEYWORD.NAME: KPOINTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Monkhorst-Pack k-point mesh of size N_x, N_y, N_z for calculating the density of states (DOS). In GW, the KPOINT_DOS mesh is thus used as k-point mesh for the self-energy. For non-periodic directions α, choose N_α = 1. Automatic choice of the k-point mesh for negative values, e.g. KPOINTS_DOS -1 -1 -1 (automatic choice: N_α = 1 in non-periodic direction, 8 k-points in periodic direction). If you like to compute a band structure along a k-path, you can specify the k-path in &KPOINT_SET.

SECTION.NAME: LDOS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters needed to calculate the local density of states (LDOS). The LDOS is computed as $\rho(\mathbf{r},E) = \sum\limits_{n,\mathbf{k}} |\psi_{n\mathbf{k}}(r)|^2\, w_\mathbf{k}\, g(E-\varepsilon_{n\mathbf{k}})$ using the Gaussian weight function $g(x) = \exp(x^2/\alpha^2)/(\sqrt{2\pi}\alpha)$, $\alpha$ is the broadening from the &DOS section, and the k-point weight $w_\mathbf{k}$. The k-mesh is taken from the &DOS section.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Activates the local VBM CBM gap calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: INTEGRATION

ITEM.NAME: X
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Integrate over x coordinate (not yet implemented).

ITEM.NAME: Y
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Integrate over y coordinate (not yet implemented).

ITEM.NAME: Z
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Integrate over z coordinate.

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: No integration, print cube file as function of x,y,z (not yet implemented).

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines whether the LDOS is integrated along a coordinate. As an example, for INTEGRATION Z, the LDOS $\rho(x,y,E) = \int dz\, \rho(x,y,z,E)$ is computed.

KEYWORD.NAME: BIN_MESH
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Mesh of size n x m for binning the space coordinates x and y of the LDOS $\rho(x,y,E)$. If -1, no binning is performed and the fine x, y resolution of the electron density from SCF is used.

SECTION.NAME: TIP_SCAN
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters needed to set up a Tip Scan. Needs external definition of tip induced field.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Controls the activation of the Tip Scan procedure

KEYWORD.NAME: SCAN_DIRECTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines scan direction and scan type(line, plane).

KEYWORD.NAME: REFERENCE_POINT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The reference point to define the absolute position of the scan.

KEYWORD.NAME: SCAN_POINTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of points calculated for each scan direction.

KEYWORD.NAME: SCAN_STEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Step size for each scan direction.

KEYWORD.NAME: TIP_FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Filename of tip potential defined in cube file format.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: FARMING
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Describes a farming job, in which multiple inputs are executed. The RUN_TYPE in the global section has to be set to NONE for FARMING. The different groups are executed in parallel. The jobs inside the same groups in series.

KEYWORD.NAME: CAPTAIN_MINION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If a captain/minion setup should be employed, in which one process (captain) is used to distribute the tasks. This is most useful to load-balance if not all jobs have the same length, and a lot of CPUs/groups are available.

KEYWORD.NAME: NGROUPS
NGROUP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Gives the preferred number of working groups.

KEYWORD.NAME: GROUP_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Gives the preferred size of a working group, groups will always be equal or larger than this size.

KEYWORD.NAME: STRIDE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Stride to be used when building working groups from the parent MPI comm. Can be used to layout minion groups over nodes in advanced ways (1 rank per node / 2 groups per node).

KEYWORD.NAME: GROUP_PARTITION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: gives the exact number of processors for each group.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_JOBS_PER_GROUP
MAX_JOBS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: maximum number of jobs executed per group

KEYWORD.NAME: CYCLE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If farming should process all jobs in a cyclic way, stopping only if MAX_JOBS_PER_GROUP is exceeded.

KEYWORD.NAME: WAIT_TIME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Time to wait [s] for a new task if no task is currently available, make this zero if no clock is available

KEYWORD.NAME: DO_RESTART
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restart a farming job (and should pick up where the previous left off)

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the restart file to use for restarting a FARMING run. If not specified the name is determined from PROJECT name.

SECTION.NAME: JOB
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: description of the jobs to be executed

KEYWORD.NAME: DIRECTORY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: the directory in which the job should be executed

KEYWORD.NAME: INPUT_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: the filename of the input file

KEYWORD.NAME: OUTPUT_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: the filename of the output file, if not specified will use the project name in the &GLOBAL section.

KEYWORD.NAME: JOB_ID
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: An ID used to indentify a job in DEPENDENCIES. JOB_IDs do not need to be unique, dependencies will be on all jobs with a given ID. If no JOB_ID is given, the index of the &JOB section in the input file will be used.

KEYWORD.NAME: DEPENDENCIES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: specifies a list of JOB_IDs on which the current job depends. The current job will not be executed before all the dependencies have finished. The keyword requires a CAPTAIN_MINION farming run. Beyond the default case, some special cases might arise: 1) circular dependencies will lead to a deadlock. 2) This keyword is not compatible with CYCLE. 3) MAX_JOBS_PER_GROUP is ignored (though only a total of MAX_JOBS_PER_GROUP*NGROUPS jobs will be executed) 4) dependencies on jobs that will not be executed (due to RESTART or MAX_JOBS_PER_GROUP) are ignored. Additionally, note that, on some file systems, output (restart) files might not be immediately available on all compute nodes, potentially resulting in unexpected failures.

SECTION.NAME: OPTIMIZE_INPUT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: describes an input optimization job, in which parameters in input files get optimized.

KEYWORD.NAME: METHOD

ITEM.NAME: FORCE_MATCHING
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Perform a force matching minimization.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: What kind of input optimization to perform.

KEYWORD.NAME: STEP_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial step size for search algorithm (RHOBEG)

KEYWORD.NAME: ITER_START_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Used for restarting, starting value of the iteration

KEYWORD.NAME: RANDOMIZE_VARIABLES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Percentage randomization of the free variables applied initially

SECTION.NAME: VARIABLE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Defines initial values for variables and their labels

KEYWORD.NAME: FIXED
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Is this variable fixed or should it be optimized.

KEYWORD.NAME: LABEL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The label used in the input file, i.e. ${LABEL} will be replaced by the VALUE specified.

KEYWORD.NAME: OPTIMIZE_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: the filename of the input file which contains the parameters to be optimized

KEYWORD.NAME: REF_TRAJ_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: the filename of the reference coordinates.

KEYWORD.NAME: REF_FORCE_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: the filename of the reference forces, should also contain the energy

KEYWORD.NAME: REF_CELL_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: the filename of the reference cell

KEYWORD.NAME: GROUP_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Gives the preferred size of a working group, groups will always be equal or larger than this size. Usually this should take the number of cores per socket into account for good performance.

KEYWORD.NAME: FRAME_START
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: starting frame to be used from the reference trajectory

KEYWORD.NAME: FRAME_STOP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: final frame to be used from the reference trajectory (all=-1)

KEYWORD.NAME: FRAME_STRIDE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: stride when using the reference trajectory

KEYWORD.NAME: FRAME_COUNT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Use at most FRAME_COUNT frames from the reference trajectory, adjusting the stride to have them as fas apart as possible (all=-1).

KEYWORD.NAME: ENERGY_WEIGHT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Relative weight of the energy RMSD vs the force RMSD

KEYWORD.NAME: SHIFT_AVERAGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Shift averages of the energies before computing energy RMSD.

KEYWORD.NAME: SHIFT_QM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Shift of the reference energies applied before computing energy RMSD.

KEYWORD.NAME: SHIFT_MM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Shift of the fit energies applied before computing energy RMSD.

SECTION.NAME: COMPARE_ENERGIES
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: A comparison of energies between fit and reference

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: OPTIMIZE_BASIS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: describes a basis optimization job, in which an ADMM like approach is used to find the best exponents and/or coefficients to match a given training set.

KEYWORD.NAME: BASIS_TEMPLATE_FILE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the basis set file, containing the structure of the new basis set

KEYWORD.NAME: BASIS_WORK_FILE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the basis set file which is created to be read as initial guess

KEYWORD.NAME: BASIS_OUTPUT_FILE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the basis set file containing the optimized basis

KEYWORD.NAME: WRITE_FREQUENCY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Frequency at which the intermediate results should be written

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_CONDITION_NUMBER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines whether condition number should be part of optimization or not

KEYWORD.NAME: BASIS_COMBINATIONS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If multiple atomic kinds are fitted at the same time, this keyword allows to specify which basis sets should be used together in optimization (underived set ID=0). If skipped all combinations are used. The order is taken as the kinds and sets are specified in the input

KEYWORD.NAME: RESIDUUM_WEIGHT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keyword allows to give different weight factors to the residuum of the different basis combinations. The first entry corresponds to the original basis sets. Every further value is assigned to the combinations in the order given for BASIS_COMBINATIONS.

KEYWORD.NAME: CONDITION_WEIGHT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keyword allows to give different weight factors to the condition number of different basis combinations (LOG(cond) is used). The first entry corresponds to the original basis sets. Every further value is assigned to the combinations in the order given for BASIS_COMBINATIONS.

KEYWORD.NAME: GROUP_PARTITION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Allows the specification of the group mpi group sizes in parallel runs. If less Groups than tasks are speciefied, consecutive calculations Will be assigned to one group (derived basis sets and then training sets) If keyword is skipped, equal group sizes will be generated trying to fit all calculations.

SECTION.NAME: FIT_KIND
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: specicifies the atomic kinds to be fitted and the basis sets associated with the kind.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the kind described in this section.

KEYWORD.NAME: BASIS_SET
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The name of the basis set for the kind. Has to be specified in BASIS_TEMPLATE_FILE.

KEYWORD.NAME: INITIAL_DEGREES_OF_FREEDOM

ITEM.NAME: ALL
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Set all parameters in the basis to be variable.

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Set all parameters in the basis to be fixed.

ITEM.NAME: COEFFICIENTS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Set all coefficients in the basis set to be variable.

ITEM.NAME: EXPONENTS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Set all exponents in the basis to be variable.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the initial degrees of freedom in the basis optimization. This can be used to make further specifications easier

KEYWORD.NAME: SWITCH_COEFF_STATE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Allows to switch the state of a given coefficient from current state (varibale/fixed)) to the opposite state. The three integers indicate the set number, the angular momentum i'th contraction and i'th coefficient

KEYWORD.NAME: SWITCH_CONTRACTION_STATE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Allows to switch the state of a given contraction from current state (varibale/fixed)) to the opposite state. The three integers indicate the set number, the angular momentum and i'th contraction

KEYWORD.NAME: SWITCH_EXP_STATE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Allows to switch the state of a given exponent from current state (varibale/fixed)) to the opposite state. The two integers indicate the set number and i'th exponent

KEYWORD.NAME: SWITCH_SET_STATE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Allows to switch the states of in a set from current state (varibale/fixed)) to the opposite state. The two integers indicate the affected part (0=ALL,1=EXPS,2=COEFF) and i'th set

SECTION.NAME: CONSTRAIN_EXPONENTS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: specicifies constraints for the exponents to be fitted. Only a single constraint can be applied to an exponent

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_EXP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the exponent to be constraint. The two integers indicate the set number and i'th exponent. The value -1 can be used to mark all sets/exponents in a set.

KEYWORD.NAME: BOUNDARIES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the boundaries to which the optimization is restricted. First value is the lower bound, second value is the upper bound.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_VAR_FRACTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the maximum fractionr by which the exponent is allowed to vary. e.g. 0.5 allows the exp to vary by 0.5*exp in both directions.

SECTION.NAME: DERIVED_BASIS_SETS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section can be used to create subsets of a basis which will be fitted at the same time. This is especially useful if connected bsis sets e.g. TZVP, DZVP, SZV should be fitted.

KEYWORD.NAME: BASIS_SET_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the name of the derived basis set, which will be automatically generated otherwise.

KEYWORD.NAME: REFERENCE_SET
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the reference basis ID which is used as template to create the new set. The original basis has ID 0. All following sets are counted in order as specified in the Input. The descriptors always assume the structure of the input basis set.

KEYWORD.NAME: REMOVE_CONTRACTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Can be used to remove a contraction from the reference basis set. The contraction is speciefied by set number, angular momentum and number of contraction. The descriptors always assume the structure of the input basis set.

KEYWORD.NAME: REMOVE_SET
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Can be used to remove a set from the reference basis set.

SECTION.NAME: TRAINING_FILES
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: specicifies the location in which the files necessary for fitting procedure are located. Each Training set needs a repetition of this section.

KEYWORD.NAME: DIRECTORY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: the directory in which the files are placed

KEYWORD.NAME: INPUT_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: the filename of the input file used to run the original calculation

SECTION.NAME: OPTIMIZATION
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: sets the parameters for optimizition, output frequency and restarts

KEYWORD.NAME: STEP_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial step size for search algorithm (RHOBEG)

SECTION.NAME: SWARM
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section to control swarm runs. The swarm framework provides a common ground for master/worker algorithms.

KEYWORD.NAME: BEHAVIOR

ITEM.NAME: GLOBAL_OPT
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Runs global geometry optimisation

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Which behaviour should control the swarm.

KEYWORD.NAME: NUMBER_OF_WORKERS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of workers used for swarm. Of the total number of processors one is used for the master, the remaining processors should be divisible by the number of workers.

KEYWORD.NAME: REPLAY_COMMUNICATION_LOG
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Filename of communication log of previous run. Use this to restart a swarm.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ITER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The maximum number iterations the master should perform

SECTION.NAME: PRINT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing properties during a global optimization run

SECTION.NAME: WORKER_RUN_INFO
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of the worker's basic information during the global optimization

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the difference of two energies is below this threshold they are considert equal.

KEYWORD.NAME: FINGERPRINT_PRECISION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the euclidean distance of two fingerprints is below this threshold, they are considert equal.

SECTION.NAME: MINIMA_HOPPING
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section controlling the Minima Hopping method.

KEYWORD.NAME: BETA_1
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Factor used to increase temperature when escape failed, should be larger than 1.

KEYWORD.NAME: BETA_2
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Factor used to increase temperature when escape found known minima, should be larger than 1.

KEYWORD.NAME: BETA_3
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Factor used to decrease temperature when escape succeeded, should be smaller than 1.

KEYWORD.NAME: ALPHA_1
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Factor used to decrease acceptance energy, when minima was accepted, should be smaller than 1.

KEYWORD.NAME: ALPHA_2
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Factor used to increase acceptance energy, when minima was rejected, should be larger than 1.

KEYWORD.NAME: SHARE_HISTORY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If set all worker will use a single share history of visited minima.

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMPSTEP_BASE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Base used to calculate temperature steps base**n

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMPDIST_UPDATE_WIDTH
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Width of gaussian used to update temperature distribution.

KEYWORD.NAME: TEMPDIST_UPDATE_HEIGHT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Height of gaussian used to update temperature distribution.

KEYWORD.NAME: WORKER_PER_MINIMA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of active workers per Minima.

KEYWORD.NAME: ESCAPE_HISTORY_LENGTH
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of escapes averaged for scoring of minima.

KEYWORD.NAME: BINARY_RESTART_FILE_NAME
BINARY_RESTART_FILE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the name of an additional restart file from which selected input sections are read in binary format (see SPLIT_RESTART_FILE).

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keyword controls the default value for all possible restartable keywords, unless explicitly defined. For example setting this keyword to .FALSE. does not restart any quantity. If, at the same time, one keyword is set to .TRUE. only that quantity will be restarted.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_COUNTERS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts the counters in MD schemes and optimization STEP

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_POS

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_VEL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Takes the velocities from the external file

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_RANDOMG

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_CORE_POS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Takes the positions of the cores from the external file (only if shell-model)

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_OPTIMIZE_INPUT_VARIABLES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restart with the optimize input variables

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_SHELL_VELOCITY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Takes the velocities of the shells from the external file (only if shell-model)

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_CORE_VELOCITY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Takes the velocities of the shells from the external file (only if shell-model)

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_BAROSTAT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts the barostat from the external file

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_BAROSTAT_THERMOSTAT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts the barostat thermostat from the external file

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_SHELL_THERMOSTAT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts the shell thermostat from the external file

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_THERMOSTAT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts the nose thermostats of the particles from the EXTERNAL file

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_TEMPERATURE_ANNEALING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts external temperature when using TEMPERATURE_ANNEALING.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_CELL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts the cell (and cell_ref) from the EXTERNAL file

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_METADYNAMICS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts hills from a previous metadynamics run from the EXTERNAL file

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_WALKERS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts walkers informations from a previous metadynamics run from the EXTERNAL file

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_BAND
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts positions and velocities of the Band.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_QMMM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts the following specific QMMM info: translation vectors.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_CONSTRAINT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts constraint section. It's necessary when doing restraint calculation to have a perfect energy conservation. For constraints only its use is optional.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_DIMER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts information for DIMER geometry optimizations.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_RTP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts information for REAL TIME PROPAGATION and EHRENFEST DYNAMICS.

KEYWORD.NAME: CUSTOM_PATH
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts the given path from the EXTERNAL file. Allows a major flexibility for restarts.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_PINT_NOSE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restart Nose thermostat for beads from PINT%NOSE.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_PINT_GLE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restart GLE thermostat for beads from PINT%GLE.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_HELIUM_PERMUTATION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restart helium permutation state from PINT%HELIUM%PERM.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_HELIUM_FORCE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restart helium forces exerted on the solute from PINT%HELIUM%FORCE.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_HELIUM_RNG
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts helium random number generators from PINT%HELIUM%RNG_STATE.

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_HELIUM_DENSITIES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restarts helium density distributions from PINT%HELIUM%RHO.

SECTION.NAME: VIBRATIONAL_ANALYSIS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section to setup parameters to perform a Normal Modes, vibrational, or phonon analysis. Vibrations are computed using finite differences, which implies a very tight (e.g. 1E-8) threshold is needed for EPS_SCF to get accurate low frequencies. The analysis assumes a stationary state (minimum or TS), i.e. tight geometry optimization (MAX_FORCE) is needed as well.

KEYWORD.NAME: DX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the increment to be used to construct the HESSIAN with finite difference method

KEYWORD.NAME: NPROC_REP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the number of processors to be used per replica environment (for parallel runs). In case of mode selective calculations more than one replica will start a block Davidson algorithm to track more than only one frequency

KEYWORD.NAME: PROC_DIST_TYPE

ITEM.NAME: INTERLEAVED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Interleaved distribution

ITEM.NAME: BLOCKED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Blocked distribution

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specify the topology of the mapping of processors into replicas.

KEYWORD.NAME: FULLY_PERIODIC
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Avoids to clean rotations from the Hessian matrix.

KEYWORD.NAME: INTENSITIES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Calculation of the IR/Raman-Intensities. Calculation of dipoles and/or polarizabilities have to be specified explicitly in DFT/PRINT/MOMENTS and/or PROPERTIES/LINRES/POLAR

KEYWORD.NAME: THERMOCHEMISTRY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Calculation of the thermochemical data. Valid for molecules in the gas phase.

KEYWORD.NAME: TC_TEMPERATURE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Temperature for the calculation of the thermochemical data

KEYWORD.NAME: TC_PRESSURE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Pressure for the calculation of the thermochemical data

SECTION.NAME: MODE_SELECTIVE
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: All parameters needed for to run a mode selective vibrational analysis. The keywords FREQUENCY, RANGE, and the subsection INVOLVED_ATOMS are mutually exclusive.

KEYWORD.NAME: FREQUENCY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: value close to the expected value of the frequency to look for. If the block Davidson algorithm is applied, the nrep closest frequencies are tracked.

KEYWORD.NAME: RANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Track modes in a given range of frequencies. No warranty that the set of frequencies is complete.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOWEST_FREQUENCY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Lowest frequency mode to include when writing output. Use a negative value to print imaginary frequencies. Useful for visualizing the imaginary frequency along a reaction path coordinate Depending on accuracy settings, the output might include spurious low frequency imaginary modes which should be visually checked (see MOLDEN_VIB).

KEYWORD.NAME: ATOMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the list of atoms which should be displaced for the Initial guess

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_MAX_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the davidson algorithm. Specifies the maximal value in the residuum vectors

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_NORM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Convergence criterion for the davidson algorithm. Specifies the maximal value of the norm of the residuum vectors

KEYWORD.NAME: INITIAL_GUESS

ITEM.NAME: BFGS_HESS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: get the first displacement vector out of the BFGS approximate Hessian

ITEM.NAME: ATOMIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: use random displacements for a set of atoms specified

ITEM.NAME: RESTART
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: use data from MS_RESTART as initial guess

ITEM.NAME: RESTART_VEC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: use a vector from MS_RESTART, useful if you want to increase accurcy by changing functionals or basis

ITEM.NAME: MOLDEN_RESTART
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: use the .mol file of a former run, to restart a vector (similar to Restart_vec, but a different file FORMAT is used)

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The type of initial guess for the normal modes

KEYWORD.NAME: RESTART_FILE_NAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the name of the file used to create the restarted vectors

SECTION.NAME: INVOLVED_ATOMS
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: All parameters needed for the tracking of modes dominated by the motion of selected atoms. Warning, if many atoms are involved, only low frequency modes are detected, since they are more delocalized and match the tracked eigenvector.

KEYWORD.NAME: RANGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the range of wavenumbers in which the modes related to the ATOMS have to be tracked. If not specified frequencies >400cm-1 will be used to avoid tracking of translational or rotational modes

KEYWORD.NAME: INVOLVED_ATOMS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the list of atoms on which the tracked eigenvector should have the highest value similar to looking for the vibration of a set of atoms

SECTION.NAME: PRINT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing mode selective vibrational analysis

SECTION.NAME: MS_RESTART
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing of the Mode Selective Restart file.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: NEGF
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters which control quantum transport calculation based on Non-Equilibrium Green's Function method.

KEYWORD.NAME: DISABLE_CACHE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Do not keep contact self-energy matrices for future reuse

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_GREEN
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Target accuracy for surface Green's functions.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_GEO
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Accuracy in mapping atoms between different force environments.

KEYWORD.NAME: ENERGY_LBOUND
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Lower bound energy of the conductance band.

KEYWORD.NAME: ETA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Infinitesimal offset from the real axis.

KEYWORD.NAME: HOMO_LUMO_GAP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The gap between the HOMO and some fictitious LUMO. This option is used as an initial offset to determine the actual Fermi level of bulk contacts. It does not need to be exact HOMO-LUMO gap, just some value to start with.

KEYWORD.NAME: DELTA_NPOLES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of poles of Fermi function to consider.

KEYWORD.NAME: GAMMA_KT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Offset from the axis (in terms of k*T) where poles of the Fermi function reside.

KEYWORD.NAME: INTEGRATION_METHOD

ITEM.NAME: CLENSHAW-CURTIS
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Adaptive Clenshaw-Curtis quadrature method. Requires FFTW3 library.

ITEM.NAME: SIMPSON
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Adaptive Simpson method. Works without FFTW3.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Method to integrate Green's functions along a closed-circuit contour.

KEYWORD.NAME: INTEGRATION_MIN_POINTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial (minimal) number of grid point for adaptive numerical integration.

KEYWORD.NAME: INTEGRATION_MAX_POINTS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximal number of grid point for adaptive numerical integration.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_SCF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of SCF iterations to be performed.

KEYWORD.NAME: NPROC_POINT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of MPI processes to be used per energy point. Default is to use all processors (0).

KEYWORD.NAME: V_SHIFT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial value of the Hartree potential shift

KEYWORD.NAME: V_SHIFT_OFFSET
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Initial offset to determine the optimal shift in Hartree potential.

KEYWORD.NAME: V_SHIFT_MAX_ITERS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximal number of iteration to determine the optimal shift in Hartree potential.

SECTION.NAME: CONTACT
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Section defining the contact region of NEGF setup.

KEYWORD.NAME: FORCE_EVAL_SECTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Index of the FORCE_EVAL section which will be used for bulk calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: ELECTRIC_POTENTIAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: External electrostatic potential applied to the given contact.

KEYWORD.NAME: FERMI_LEVEL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Contact Fermi level at the given temperature. If this keyword is not given explicitly, the Fermi level will be automatically computed prior the actual NEGF calculation.

KEYWORD.NAME: REFINE_FERMI_LEVEL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Compute the Fermi level using the value from the FERMI_LEVEL keyword as a starting point. By default the Fermi level is computed only when the keyword FERMI_LEVEL is not given explicitly.

SECTION.NAME: BULK_REGION
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Atoms belonging to the bulk contact adjacent to the screening region.

KEYWORD.NAME: MOLNAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies a list of named molecular fragments.

SECTION.NAME: CELL
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Atoms belonging to a single bulk contact unit cell. Bulk Hamiltonian will be contstructed using two such unit cells instead of performing k-point bulk calculation. FORCE_EVAL_SECTION must be 0.

KEYWORD.NAME: MOLNAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies a list of named molecular fragments.

SECTION.NAME: SCREENING_REGION
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Atoms belonging to the given contact adjacent to the scattering region.

KEYWORD.NAME: MOLNAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies a list of named molecular fragments.

SECTION.NAME: MIXING
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Define type and parameters for mixing procedures to be applied to the density matrix. Normally, only one type of mixing method should be accepted. The mixing procedures activated by this section are only active for diagonalization methods and linear scaling SCF, i.e. not with minimization methods based on OT.

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Controls the activation of the mixing procedure

ITEM.NAME: NONE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: No mixing is applied

ITEM.NAME: DIRECT_P_MIXING
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Direct mixing of new and old density matrices

ITEM.NAME: KERKER_MIXING
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mixing of the potential in reciprocal space using the Kerker damping

ITEM.NAME: PULAY_MIXING
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Pulay mixing

ITEM.NAME: BROYDEN_MIXING
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Broyden mixing

ITEM.NAME: BROYDEN_MIXING_NEW
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Broyden mixing second version

ITEM.NAME: MULTISECANT_MIXING
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Multisecant scheme for mixing

KEYWORD.NAME: ALPHA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Fraction of new density to be included

KEYWORD.NAME: BETA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Denominator parameter in Kerker damping introduced to suppress charge sloshing: rho_mix(g) = rho_in(g) + alpha*g^2/(g^2 + beta^2)*(rho_out(g)-rho_in(g))

KEYWORD.NAME: PULAY_ALPHA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Fraction of new density to be added to the Pulay expansion

KEYWORD.NAME: PULAY_BETA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Fraction of residual contribution to be added to Pulay expansion

KEYWORD.NAME: NMIXING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Minimal number of density mixing (should be greater than 0), before starting DIIS

KEYWORD.NAME: NBUFFER
NPULAY
NBROYDEN
NMULTISECANT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of previous steps stored for the actual mixing scheme

KEYWORD.NAME: BROY_W0
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: w0 parameter used in Broyden mixing

KEYWORD.NAME: REGULARIZATION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Regularization parameter to stabilize the inversion of the residual matrix {Yn^t Yn} in the multisecant mixing scheme (noise)

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_STEP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Upper bound for the magnitude of the unpredicted step size in the update by the multisecant mixing scheme

KEYWORD.NAME: R_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Control factor for the magnitude of the unpredicted step size in the update by the multisecant mixing scheme

KEYWORD.NAME: NSKIP
NSKIP_MIXING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of initial iteration for which the mixing is skipped

KEYWORD.NAME: N_SIMPLE_MIX
NSIMPLEMIX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of kerker damping iterations before starting other mixing procedures

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_GVEC_EXP
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Restricts the G-space mixing to lower part of G-vector spectrum, up to a G0, by assigning the exponent of the Gaussian that can be represented by vectors smaller than G0 within a certain accuracy.

KEYWORD.NAME: GMIX_P
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Activate the mixing of the density matrix, using the same mixing coefficient applied for the g-space mixing.

ITEM.NAME: ANALYTIC

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use numerical method

ITEM.NAME: ANALYTIC

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Use numerical method

KEYWORD.USAGE: CORE 1s2 ... or CORE [Ne] or CORE none for 0 electron cores
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the core electrons for a pseudopotential

KEYWORD.NAME: ELECTRON_CONFIGURATION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the electron configuration. Optional the multiplicity (m) and a core state [XX] can be declared

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_ANGULAR_MOMENTUM
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the largest angular momentum calculated [0-3]

KEYWORD.NAME: CALCULATE_STATES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Specifies the number of states calculated per l value

KEYWORD.NAME: USE_GAUSS_HERMITE

KEYWORD.NAME: GRID_POINTS_GH
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of grid points for Gauss-Hermite grid

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: HF
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Sets up the Hartree-Fock parameters if requested

KEYWORD.NAME: FRACTION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The fraction of Hartree-Fock to add to the total energy. 1.0 implies standard Hartree-Fock if used with XC_FUNCTIONAL NONE. NOTE: In a mixed potential calculation this should be set to 1.0, otherwise all parts are multiplied with this factor.

KEYWORD.NAME: TREAT_LSD_IN_CORE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines how spin densities are taken into account. If true, the beta spin density is included via a second in core call. If false, alpha and beta spins are done in one shot

KEYWORD.NAME: PW_HFX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Compute the Hartree-Fock energy also in the plane wave basis. The value is ignored, and intended for debugging only.

KEYWORD.NAME: PW_HFX_BLOCKSIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Improve the performance of pw_hfx at the cost of some additional memory by storing the realspace representation of PW_HFX_BLOCKSIZE states.

SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Controls the printing basic info about hf method

SECTION_PARAMETERS.NAME: SECTION_PARAMETERS
SECTION_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: Level starting at which this property is printed

KEYWORD.NAME: __CONTROL_VAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: hidden parameter that controls storage, printing,... of the print_key

KEYWORD.NAME: ADD_LAST

ITEM.NAME: NO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.NAME: NUMERIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

ITEM.NAME: SYMBOLIC
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with lowercase letter l

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number. Not every iteration level is able to identify the last iteration early enough to be able to output. When this keyword is activated all iteration levels are checked for the last iteration step.

KEYWORD.NAME: COMMON_ITERATION_LEVELS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: How many iterations levels should be written in the same file (no extra information about the actual iteration level is written to the file)

KEYWORD.NAME: FILENAME
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: controls part of the filename for output. use __STD_OUT__ (exactly as written here) for the screen or standard logger. use filename to obtain projectname-filename. use ./filename to get filename. A middle name (if present), iteration numbers and extension are always added to the filename. if you want to avoid it use =filename, in this case the filename is always exactly as typed. Please note that this can lead to clashes of filenames.

KEYWORD.NAME: LOG_PRINT_KEY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This keywords enables the logger for the print_key (a message is printed on screen everytime data, controlled by this print_key, are written)

SECTION.NAME: EACH
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: This section specifies how often this property is printed. Each keyword inside this section is mapping to a specific iteration level and the value of each of these keywords is matched with the iteration level during the calculation. How to handle the last iteration is treated separately in ADD_LAST (this mean that each iteration level (MD, GEO_OPT, etc..), though equal to 0, might print the last iteration). If an iteration level is specified that is not present in the flow of the calculation it is just ignored.

SECTION.NAME: PERIODIC
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Sets up periodic boundary condition parameters if requested

KEYWORD.NAME: NUMBER_OF_SHELLS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Number of shells taken into account for periodicity. By default, cp2k tries to automatically evaluate this number. This algorithm might be to conservative, resulting in some overhead. You can try to adjust this number in order to make a calculation cheaper.

SECTION.NAME: SCREENING
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Sets up screening parameters if requested

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_SCHWARZ
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Screens the near field part of the electronic repulsion integrals using the Schwarz inequality for the given threshold.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_SCHWARZ_FORCES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Screens the near field part of the electronic repulsion integrals using the Schwarz inequality for the given threshold. This will be approximately the accuracy of the forces, and should normally be similar to EPS_SCF

KEYWORD.NAME: SCREEN_P_FORCES
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Screens the electronic repulsion integrals for the forces using the density matrix. This results in a significant speedup for large systems, but might require a somewhat tigher EPS_SCHWARZ_FORCES.

KEYWORD.NAME: SCREEN_ON_INITIAL_P
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Screen on an initial density matrix. For the first MD step this matrix must be provided by a Restart File.

KEYWORD.NAME: P_SCREEN_CORRECTION_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Recalculates integrals on the fly if the actual density matrix is larger by a given factor than the initial one. If the factor is set to 0.0_dp, this feature is disabled.

SECTION.NAME: MEMORY
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Sets up memory parameters for the storage of the ERI's if requested

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_STORAGE_SCALING
EPS_STORAGE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scaling factor to scale eps_schwarz. Storage threshold for compression will be EPS_SCHWARZ*EPS_STORAGE_SCALING.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_MEMORY
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the maximum amount of memory [MiB] to be consumed by the full HFX module. All temporary buffers and helper arrays are subtracted from this number. What remains will be used for storage of integrals. NOTE: This number is assumed to represent the memory available to one MPI process. When running a threaded version, cp2k automatically takes care of distributing the memory among all the threads within a process.

KEYWORD.NAME: STORAGE_LOCATION
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Loaction where ERI's are stored if MAX_DISK_SPACE /=0 Expects a path to a directory.

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_DISK_SPACE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Defines the maximum amount of disk space [MiB] used to store precomputed compressed four-center integrals. If 0, nothing is stored to disk

KEYWORD.NAME: TREAT_FORCES_IN_CORE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Determines whether the derivative ERI's should be stored to RAM or not. Only meaningful when performing Ehrenfest MD. Memory usage is defined via MAX_MEMORY, i.e. the memory is shared wit the energy ERI's.

SECTION.NAME: RI
SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Parameters for RI method in HFX (experimental, forces not yet implemented).

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Filter threshold for DBCSR tensor contraction.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER_2C
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Filter threshold for 2c integrals. Default should be kept.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_STORAGE_SCALING
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Scaling factor to scale EPS_FILTER for storage of 3-center integrals. Storage threshold will be EPS_FILTER*EPS_STORAGE_SCALING.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_FILTER_MO
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Filter threshold for contraction of 3-center integrals with MOs. Default should be kept.

KEYWORD.NAME: OMEGA
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The range parameter for the short range operator (in 1/a0). Default is OMEGA from INTERACTION_POTENTIAL.

KEYWORD.NAME: CUTOFF_RADIUS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The cutoff radius (in Angstroms) for the truncated Coulomb operator. Default is CUTOFF_RADIUS from INTERACTION_POTENTIAL.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_NGROUPS
NGROUPS
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The number of MPI subgroup that work in parallel during the SCF. The default value is 1. Using N subgroups should speed up the calculation by a factor ~N, at the cost of N times more memory usage.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_USE_DELTA_P
USE_DELTA_P
KP_USE_P_DIFF
USE_P_DIFF
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: This kweyword controls whether the KS matrix at each SCF cycle is built by adding the contribution of the denisty difference (wrt to previous step) to the KS matrix of the previous step. As the SCF converges, the density fluctuations get smaller and sparsity increases, leading to faster SCF steps. Not always numerically stable => turn off if SCF struggles to converge.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_STACK_SIZE
STACK_SIZE
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: When doing contraction over periodic cells of the type: T_mu^a,nu^b,P^c = (mu^a nu^b | Q^d) * (Q^d | P^c), with a,b,c,d labeling cells, there are in principle Ncells contractions taking place. Because a smaller number of contractions involving larger tensors is more efficient, the tensors can be stacked along the d direction. STCK_SIZE controls the size of this stack. Larger stacks are more efficient, but required more memory.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_RI_EXTENSION_FACTOR
RI_EXTENSION_FACTOR
RI_EXT
RI_EXT_FACT
KP_RI_EXT
KP_RI_EXT_FACT
KP_RI_BASIS_EXT
RI_BASIS_EXT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: In KP-RI-HFX, each atom has its own local RI basis. The RI basis is defined by a sphere of radius R centered on the atom, whereby all neighboring atoms within that sphere contribute their RI basis elements. The radius of that sphere is calculated based on the systems' most diffuse orbital PGF (with exponant alpha), such that EPS_PGF_ORB * KP_RI_EXTENSION_FACTOR = exp(-alpha*R^2). The default value of 1.0 is safe. More accurate results can be obtained with a value < 1.0, at greated computational cost.

KEYWORD.NAME: KP_RI_BUMP_FACTOR
RI_BUMP
BUMP
BUMP_FACTOR
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: In KP-RI-HFX, the extended RI basis set has a bump radius. All basis elements within that radius contribute with full weight. All basis elements beyond that radius have decaying weight, from 1 at the bump radius, to zero at the RI extension radius. The bump radius is calculated as a fraction of the RI extension radius: bump radius = KP_RI_NUMP_FACTOR * RI extension radius

KEYWORD.NAME: RI_METRIC

ITEM.NAME: HFX
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Same as HFX operator

ITEM.NAME: COULOMB
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Standard Coulomb operator: 1/r

ITEM.NAME: IDENTITY
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Overlap

ITEM.NAME: TRUNCATED
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Truncated Coulomb operator: 1/r if (r<R_c), 0 otherwise

ITEM.NAME: SHORTRANGE
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Short range: erfc(omega*r)/r

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: The type of RI operator. Default is POTENTIAL_TYPE from INTERACTION_POTENTIAL. The standard Coulomb operator cannot be used in periodic systems.

KEYWORD.NAME: 2C_MATRIX_FUNCTIONS

ITEM.NAME: DIAG
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Diagonalization with eigenvalue quenching: stable

ITEM.NAME: CHOLESKY
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Cholesky: not stable in case of ill-conditioned RI basis

ITEM.NAME: ITER
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Iterative algorithms: linear scaling Hotelling's method for inverse and Newton-Schulz iteration for matrix square root

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Methods for matrix inverse and matrix square root.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_EIGVAL
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Throw away linear combinations of RI basis functions with a small eigenvalue, this is applied only if 2C_MATRIX_FUNCTIONS DIAG

KEYWORD.NAME: CHECK_2C_MATRIX
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Report accuracy for the inverse/sqrt of the 2-center integral matrix.

KEYWORD.NAME: CALC_COND_NUM
CALC_CONDITION_NUMBER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Calculate the condition number of integral matrices.

KEYWORD.NAME: SQRT_ORDER
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Order of the iteration method for the calculation of the sqrt of 2-center integral matrix.

KEYWORD.NAME: EPS_PGF_ORB
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Sets precision of the integral tensors.

KEYWORD.NAME: RI_FLAVOR

ITEM.NAME: MO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: with MO coefficients

ITEM.NAME: RHO
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: with density matrix

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Flavor of RI: how to contract 3-center integrals

KEYWORD.NAME: MAX_BLOCK_SIZE_MO
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum tensor block size for MOs.

KEYWORD.NAME: MEMORY_CUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Memory reduction factor. This keyword controls the batching of tensor contractions into smaller, more manageable chunks. The details vary depending on the RI_FLAVOR.

KEYWORD.NAME: FLAVOR_SWITCH_MEMORY_CUT
KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: Memory reduction factor to be applied upon RI_FLAVOR switching from MO to RHO. The RHO flavor typically requires more memory, and depending on the ressources available, a higher MEMORY_CUT.

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Do not mark last iteration specifically

ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Mark last iteration with its iteration number

KEYWORD.DESCRIPTION: If the last iteration should be added, and if it should be marked symbolically (with lowercase letter l) or with the iteration number.
